```dart
  /// Runs [object]'s hooks once, in isolation, and returns the first error
  /// any of them throws, or null (spec 2a E2). Mutates nothing. It is
  /// guarded like [drift], so a hook that calls `execute` gets the guard's
  /// `StateError`, which is returned.
  ///
  /// The hooks are every one an edit, [drift] or [diagnostics] can call for
  /// one object, in an edit's order:
  /// - its `reach` and `references`, in the survey;
  /// - its type's `pageKey` of the root's page;
  /// - `placeBox` and `placeInput`, for a contributor;
  /// - `readBox`, for a reader;
  /// - `dissolves` and `generate`, through the planner's dry run (so a
  ///   region or a fill it cannot plan counts too);
  /// - then `diagnose`.
  ///
  /// Each runs with a view over a survey of this system's live objects, as
  /// an edit's after-view.
  ///
  /// In isolation: another live object whose own `reach` or `references`
  /// throws is left out of that survey, as it will be once frozen, so its
  /// error is never reported as [object]'s. Finding them takes one `reach`
  /// and one `references` call per live object before the survey's own. A
  /// probe is O(live objects), and is on neither the frame nor the edit path.
  ///
  /// Null, with no hook called, for a handle that is not a live object of
  /// this system: not a root-level group named by a registered type, or
  /// frozen.
  Object? probe(Handle object) {
    final registration = _naming(document, _types, object, _frozen);
    if (registration == null) return null;
    final was = _applying;
    _applying = true;
    try {
      final broken = <Handle>{};
      for (final r in _types) {
        for (final h in r.handles(document)) {
          if (!identical(_naming(document, _types, h, _frozen), r)) continue;
          try {
            r.reachOf(r.componentOf(document, h), _worldOf(document, h));
            r.referencesOf(document, h).toList();
          } catch (error) {
            if (h == object) return error;
            broken.add(h);
          }
        }
      }
      final frozen = _frozen;
      final s = _survey(
          document,
          _types,
          broken.isEmpty
              ? frozen
              : (Handle h) =>
                  broken.contains(h) || (frozen != null && frozen(h)));
      final view = ParametricView._(document, s);
      final type = registration.type;
      type.pageKey(view.page);
      if (type.contributesPlace && view.placeBoxOf(object) != null) {
        type.placeInput(view, object);
      }
      if (type.readsPlaces) {
        registration.readBoxOf(s.params[object]!, s.toWorld[object]!,
            _storedBox(document, s, object));
      }
      _plan(document, [object], s, view);
      registration.diagnose(view, object);
      return null;
    } catch (error) {
      return error;
    } finally {
      _applying = was;
    }
  }
```

### Task 3: Contract — property specs, `PropertyField`, `PlanGate`, `ColourTarget` (spec P3)

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/lib/src/kit/properties.dart`, `lib/src/kit/colour.dart`
- Modify: `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/lib/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart` (two exports), `test/invariants/purity_test.dart` (P9), `CHANGELOG.md` (one bullet)
- Test: `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/test/kit/properties_test.dart`, `test/support/code_fixtures.dart` (shared with Tasks 4 and 5's tests)

(All paths below are under `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/` unless they start at the repository root.)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Component` (`package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart`, `lib/src/document/component.dart:16-19`), in the test fixtures only; `walkImports` (`test/support/import_walker.dart`) and its allow-list (`:11-21`: `dart:async|collection|convert|core|math|typed_data`, `jet_cad_2d`, `meta`, `vector_math`).
- Produces (exported from `package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart` only, never from `authoring.dart`):
  - `enum PlanGate { move, rotate, mirror, reshape, delete, changeLayer, recolor, editLayers, editPage }`.
  - `enum ValueUnit { length, area, angle, none }`.
  - `sealed class PropertySpec<T>`: `String get id`, `bool Function(T)? get enabled`, `PlanGate? get gate`, and `PropertyField bind(Object? value, {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit})`.
  - Its eight `final` kinds, each `({required String id, ..., bool Function(T)? enabled, PlanGate? gate})`:
    - `LengthProperty<T>({read: double Function(T), write: T Function(T, double), double? min, double? max})`;
    - `AngleProperty<T>({read, write})` (radians);
    - `NumberProperty<T>({read, write, double? min, double? max, int decimals = 0})`;
    - `ChoiceProperty<T, V>({required List<V> values, read: V Function(T), write: T Function(T, V)})` with `static String segmentOf(Object? value)`;
    - `ToggleProperty<T>({read: bool Function(T), write: T Function(T, bool)})`;
    - `TextProperty<T>({read: String Function(T), write: T Function(T, String), int? maxLength})`;
    - `ValueDisplay<T>({read: double Function(T), required ValueUnit unit})`;
    - `ActionProperty<T>({required T Function(T) apply})`.
  - `abstract interface class PropertyField { PropertySpec<Object?> get spec; String get wordId; bool get enabled; Object? get value; Object? Function(Object? input)? get commit; }` — exactly the Shared interface; its implementation `_BoundField<T>` is private.
  - `final class ColourTarget<T> { const ColourTarget({required String? Function(T) read, required T Function(T, String?) write}); }`.

Plan decision: **the binding entry point is `PropertySpec.bind`, an instance method each kind overrides.** The Shared interfaces name no way to make a `PropertyField`; Task 4's `PlanType.fieldsOf` and `PlanToolSettings.fieldsOf` need one. It must be virtual: inside a kind's own `bind`, `this` has its real `T`, so reading `read`, `write` and `enabled` passes the VM's covariance check. A top-level `bindProperty<T>(PropertySpec<T>, T)` called with a spec held as `PropertySpec<Component>` infers `T = Component` and throws a `TypeError` on the first `read` (checked under Dart 3.13.5 before writing this task). `bind` takes the owner as `Object?` and refuses a wrong one with `ArgumentError` (name `value`), never a `TypeError`.
Plan decision: **lengths are millimetres, angles radians, both ways.** `PropertyField.value` and `commit`'s input for an `AngleProperty` are radians; the panel (Task 17) shows and parses degrees and converts at its edge. No conversion happens in the contract.
Plan decision: **`commit` refuses with `ArgumentError`, named by the spec id,** for an input of the wrong type, not finite, outside `[min, max]` (inclusive; a null bound is open), not one of a choice's values (`==`, a stored-value comparison), or longer than `maxLength` code points. A **disabled** field (its `enabled` false for the bound owner) still reads, and its `commit` throws `StateError`: a disabled field is not an argument problem.
Plan decision: **a `NumberProperty` rounds to `decimals` on commit, then range-checks** (`double.parse(v.toStringAsFixed(decimals))`), so what is stored is what the panel shows. `decimals` is 0 to 10.
Plan decision: **`onCommit` sees the changed owner once, and only after the change succeeded.** Task 4's tool settings pass their `store` there; a type's fields pass none (`PlanType.commitField` builds the command).
Plan decision: a choice value's word segment is `ChoiceProperty.segmentOf(v)`: an enum's `name`, else `'$v'`. Two values with the same segment, an empty segment, or no value at all are refused when the spec is made (name `values`). The spec copies `values` unmodifiable.
Plan decision: **`properties.dart` and `colour.dart` import no Flutter** (P9 in the purity test): nothing in them draws, so a pure-Dart consumer could use them. They live under `lib/src/kit/` and are exported from the Flutter barrel only, as the scope says.

```dart
// Fixtures for the contract's code side (spec 2a P3): two component types of
// a kit "test", so a list can hold specs of two different owner types, and
// the specs of every property kind. Not degenerate: every value is away from
// its default and from zero, the turn is not a multiple of a right angle.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

enum Finish { oiled, waxed, raw }

/// A slab: one field per property kind.
@immutable
final class Slab implements Component {
  const Slab({
    this.width = 1250.5,
    this.depth = 640.25,
    this.turn = 0.35,
    this.grade = 2.5,
    this.finish = Finish.waxed,
    this.raised = true,
    this.label = 'Bar top',
    this.flipped = false,
    this.swatch = 'teal',
  });

  static const String id = 'test.slab';

  final double width;
  final double depth;
  final double turn;
  final double grade;
  final Finish finish;
  final bool raised;
  final String label;
  final bool flipped;
  final String? swatch;

  Slab copyWith({
    double? width,
    double? turn,
    double? grade,
    Finish? finish,
    bool? raised,
    String? label,
    bool? flipped,
    String? swatch,
    bool clearSwatch = false,
  }) =>
      Slab(
        width: width ?? this.width,
        depth: depth,
        turn: turn ?? this.turn,
        grade: grade ?? this.grade,
        finish: finish ?? this.finish,
        raised: raised ?? this.raised,
        label: label ?? this.label,
        flipped: flipped ?? this.flipped,
        swatch: clearSwatch ? null : swatch ?? this.swatch,
      );

  @override
  String get typeId => id;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
        'depth': depth,
        'finish': finish.name,
        'flipped': flipped,
        'grade': grade,
        'label': label,
        'raised': raised,
        'swatch': swatch,
        'turn': turn,
        'width': width,
      };

  static Slab fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) => Slab(
        width: (j['width']! as num).toDouble(),
        depth: (j['depth']! as num).toDouble(),
        turn: (j['turn']! as num).toDouble(),
        grade: (j['grade']! as num).toDouble(),
        finish: Finish.values.byName(j['finish']! as String),
        raised: j['raised']! as bool,
        label: j['label']! as String,
        flipped: j['flipped']! as bool,
        swatch: j['swatch'] as String?,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is Slab &&
      other.width == width &&
      other.depth == depth &&
      other.turn == turn &&
      other.grade == grade &&
      other.finish == finish &&
      other.raised == raised &&
      other.label == label &&
      other.flipped == flipped &&
      other.swatch == swatch;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
      width, depth, turn, grade, finish, raised, label, flipped, swatch);

  @override
  String toString() => 'Slab($width x $depth, $label, $swatch)';
}

/// A post: a second owner type. Its `width` shares the slab's spec id on
/// purpose, so a field can be offered to the wrong type.
@immutable
final class Post implements Component {
  const Post({this.width = 180.75, this.shape = 'round', this.swatch});

  static const String id = 'test.post';

  final double width;
  final String shape;
  final String? swatch;

  @override
  String get typeId => id;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() =>
      {'shape': shape, 'swatch': swatch, 'width': width};

  static Post fromJson(Map<String, Object?> j) => Post(
        width: (j['width']! as num).toDouble(),
        shape: j['shape']! as String,
        swatch: j['swatch'] as String?,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is Post &&
      other.width == width &&
      other.shape == shape &&
      other.swatch == swatch;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(width, shape, swatch);

  @override
  String toString() => 'Post($width, $shape, $swatch)';
}

/// The slab's specs: all eight kinds, in panel order. `turn` needs the
/// rotate gate; `grade` is enabled only while the slab is raised.
List<PropertySpec<Slab>> slabSpecs() => [
      LengthProperty<Slab>(
        id: 'width',
        read: (s) => s.width,
        write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(width: v),
        min: 300,
        max: 4800,
      ),
      AngleProperty<Slab>(
        id: 'turn',
        read: (s) => s.turn,
        write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(turn: v),
        gate: PlanGate.rotate,
      ),
      NumberProperty<Slab>(
        id: 'grade',
        read: (s) => s.grade,
        write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(grade: v),
        min: 0.5,
        max: 9,
        decimals: 1,
        enabled: (s) => s.raised,
      ),
      ChoiceProperty<Slab, Finish>(
        id: 'finish',
        values: Finish.values,
        read: (s) => s.finish,
        write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(finish: v),
      ),
      ToggleProperty<Slab>(
        id: 'raised',
        read: (s) => s.raised,
        write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(raised: v),
      ),
      TextProperty<Slab>(
        id: 'label',
        read: (s) => s.label,
        write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(label: v),
        maxLength: 12,
      ),
      ValueDisplay<Slab>(
        id: 'area',
        read: (s) => s.width * s.depth,
        unit: ValueUnit.area,
      ),
      ActionProperty<Slab>(
        id: 'flip',
        apply: (s) => s.copyWith(flipped: !s.flipped),
      ),
    ];

/// The post's specs.
List<PropertySpec<Post>> postSpecs() => [
      LengthProperty<Post>(
        id: 'width',
        read: (p) => p.width,
        write: (p, v) => Post(width: v, shape: p.shape, swatch: p.swatch),
        min: 50,
        enabled: (p) => p.shape == 'round',
      ),
      ChoiceProperty<Post, String>(
        id: 'shape',
        values: const ['round', 'square'],
        read: (p) => p.shape,
        write: (p, v) => Post(width: p.width, shape: v, swatch: p.swatch),
      ),
    ];
```

```dart
            id: id, read: (s) => s.grade, write: (s, _) => s),
        'choice': (id) => ChoiceProperty<Slab, Finish>(
            id: id,
            values: Finish.values,
            read: (s) => s.finish,
            write: (s, _) => s),
        'toggle': (id) => ToggleProperty<Slab>(
            id: id, read: (s) => s.raised, write: (s, _) => s),
        'text': (id) => TextProperty<Slab>(
            id: id, read: (s) => s.label, write: (s, _) => s),
        'display': (id) => ValueDisplay<Slab>(
            id: id, read: (s) => s.depth, unit: ValueUnit.length),
        'action': (id) => ActionProperty<Slab>(id: id, apply: (s) => s),
      };
      for (final MapEntry(key: kind, value: make) in makers.entries) {
        for (final ok in ['width', 'a', 'seat-count', 'w2']) {
          expect(make(ok).id, ok, reason: '$kind $ok');
        }
        // M-PS1: drop the id check from the base constructor.
        for (final bad in [
          '',
          'Width',
          '2width',
          '-width',
          'wid th',
          'width.x',
          'width_x',
          'width\n',
        ]) {
          expect(() => make(bad), refusedOn('id'), reason: '$kind "$bad"');
        }
      }
    });

    test('PS2 bounds: min above max, a bound not finite', () {
      LengthProperty<Slab> length(double? min, double? max) =>
          LengthProperty<Slab>(
              id: 'width',
              read: (s) => s.width,
              write: (s, _) => s,
              min: min,
              max: max);
      NumberProperty<Slab> number(double? min, double? max) =>
          NumberProperty<Slab>(
              id: 'grade',
              read: (s) => s.grade,
              write: (s, _) => s,
              min: min,
              max: max);
      // M-PS2a: drop the min > max check.
      expect(() => length(500.5, 300.25), refusedOn('min'));
      expect(() => number(9.5, 0.5), refusedOn('min'));
      // M-PS2b: drop the finiteness checks.
      expect(() => length(double.negativeInfinity, 300), refusedOn('min'));
      expect(() => number(0.5, double.nan), refusedOn('max'));
      expect(length(300.25, 300.25).max, 300.25);
      expect(length(null, null).min, isNull);
    });

    test('PS3 decimals 0 to 10', () {
      NumberProperty<Slab> number(int decimals) => NumberProperty<Slab>(
          id: 'grade',
          read: (s) => s.grade,
          write: (s, _) => s,
          decimals: decimals);
      // M-PS3: drop the decimals check.
      expect(() => number(-1), refusedOn('decimals'));
      expect(() => number(11), refusedOn('decimals'));
      expect(number(0).decimals, 0);
      expect(number(10).decimals, 10);
    });

    test('PS4 a choice of no value, or of a word segment twice', () {
      ChoiceProperty<Slab, Object?> choice(List<Object?> values) =>
          ChoiceProperty<Slab, Object?>(
              id: 'finish',
              values: values,
              read: (s) => s.finish,
              write: (s, _) => s);
      // M-PS4a: drop the empty check.
      expect(() => choice(const []), refusedOn('values'));
      // M-PS4b: drop the repeated-segment check. 'oiled' the string and
      // Finish.oiled share a segment.
      expect(() => choice(const ['oiled', Finish.oiled]), refusedOn('values'));
      expect(() => choice(const ['a', '']), refusedOn('values'));
      final values = <Object?>[Finish.raw, 'square'];
      final c = choice(values);
      values.add('round');
      expect(c.values, [Finish.raw, 'square']);
      expect(() => c.values.add('x'), throwsUnsupportedError);
      expect(ChoiceProperty.segmentOf(Finish.waxed), 'waxed');
      expect(ChoiceProperty.segmentOf(3), '3');

          () => TextProperty<Slab>(
              id: 'label',

              write: (s, _) => s,
              maxLength: 0),

  group('the bound field', () {
    test('PS6 a length: value, word, commit inside the bounds, inclusive', () {

      expect(() => f.commit!(299.5), refusedOn('width'));

      expect(() => spec.bind(const Post(), wordId: 'w'), refusedOn('value'));

  test('PS17 two owner types in one list, used only through PropertyField', () {
    // Review Focus 3. The list's static type erases each spec's owner.
    final List<PropertySpec<Component>> specs = [

    final fields = [

    expect(fields[0].commit!(600), slab.copyWith(width: 600));

    expect(() => fields[8].commit!(200), throwsStateError);

  test('PS18 a colour target holds its two hooks; PlanGate lists the flags',

    const target = ColourTarget<Slab>(read: _swatch, write: _recolour);
    expect(target.read(slab), 'teal');

      'rotate',
      'mirror',
      'reshape',
      'delete',
      'changeLayer',
      'recolor',
      'editLayers',
      'editPage',

  });
}
```

```dart
// Property specs (spec 2a P3, umbrella A4): the fields a kit's type or a
// tool's settings show in the plan library's property panel, as data. Each
// spec reads one value of its owner `T` and writes a changed copy.
//
// Free of Flutter: nothing here draws. The panel (the plan library) turns a
// spec into a widget through the erased PropertyField.

/// A PlanPermissions flag a field needs (spec 2a P2, P3). A field whose gate
/// is off is shown read-only.
enum PlanGate {
  move,
  rotate,
  mirror,
  reshape,
  delete,
  changeLayer,
  recolor,
  editLayers,
  editPage,
}

/// How a [ValueDisplay] prints its number: a length in mm, an area in mm²,
/// an angle in radians, or a plain number.
enum ValueUnit { length, area, angle, none }

final RegExp _specId = RegExp(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$');

/// One field of an owner `T`: a type's component or a tool's settings.
///
/// Its word is `property:<owner id>.<id>` (a choice's values:
/// `property:<owner id>.<id>.<value>`).
///
/// **Covariance.** The plan library holds specs of many `T`s at once. A
/// member whose type takes a `T` ([enabled], a kind's `read` and `write`)
/// throws a `TypeError` when it is read through a supertype such as
/// `PropertySpec<Object?>`. Only [id], [gate], a kind's bounds and [bind]
/// are safe there; [bind] is how the plan library uses a spec.
sealed class PropertySpec<T> {
  PropertySpec._(this.id, this.enabled, this.gate) {
    if (!_specId.hasMatch(id)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'id',
          'must be a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters, digits and hyphens');
    }
  }

  /// Unique within its owner's specs.
  final String id;

  /// False greys the field out and its commit throws [StateError]. Null:
  /// always enabled.
  final bool Function(T)? enabled;

  /// The permission the field needs, or null for none.
  final PlanGate? gate;

  /// This spec bound to [value], an owner `T`, under [wordId]: the erased
  /// form the plan library uses (spec 2a P1, erased operations). A kit never
  /// calls it.
  ///
  /// The field's `commit` returns the changed owner and, when it is not
  /// null, passes it to [onCommit] first. Throws [ArgumentError] when
  /// [value] is not a `T`.
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit});
}

/// A length in millimetres, within [min] and [max] (inclusive; null:
/// unbounded).
final class LengthProperty<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  LengthProperty({
    required String id,
    required this.read,
    required this.write,
    this.min,
    this.max,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate) {
    _checkBounds(min, max);
  }

  final double Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, double) write;
  final double? min;
  final double? max;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(
        this,
        owner,
        wordId,
        read(owner),
        (input) => write(owner, _inRange(_finite(input, id), min, max, id)),
        onCommit);
  }
}

/// An angle, stored in radians. The field's value and its commit's input
/// are radians; the panel shows and parses degrees (spec 2a Task 17).
final class AngleProperty<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  AngleProperty({
    required String id,
    required this.read,
    required this.write,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate);

  final double Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, double) write;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(this, owner, wordId, read(owner),
        (input) => write(owner, _finite(input, id)), onCommit);
  }
}

/// A plain number within [min] and [max], rounded on commit to [decimals]
/// places (0 to 10), so what is stored is what the panel shows.
final class NumberProperty<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  NumberProperty({
    required String id,
    required this.read,
    required this.write,
    this.min,
    this.max,
    this.decimals = 0,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate) {
    _checkBounds(min, max);
    if (decimals < 0 || decimals > 10) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(decimals, 'decimals', 'must be 0 to 10');
    }
  }

  final double Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, double) write;
  final double? min;
  final double? max;
  final int decimals;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(this, owner, wordId, read(owner), (input) {
      final rounded =
          double.parse(_finite(input, id).toStringAsFixed(decimals));
      return write(owner, _inRange(rounded, min, max, id));
    }, onCommit);
  }
}

/// One of [values], compared with `==`. A value's word segment is
/// [segmentOf] it: an enum's name, else its `toString`.
final class ChoiceProperty<T, V> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  ChoiceProperty({
    required String id,
    required List<V> values,
    required this.read,
    required this.write,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  })  : values = List.unmodifiable(values),
        super._(id, enabled, gate) {
    if (this.values.isEmpty) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(values, 'values', 'must not be empty');
    }
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final v in this.values) {
      final segment = segmentOf(v);
      if (segment.isEmpty || !seen.add(segment)) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(
            v, 'values', 'gives the word segment "$segment" twice or empty');
      }
    }
  }

  /// The word segment of [value]: an enum's name, else `'$value'`.
  static String segmentOf(Object? value) =>
      value is Enum ? value.name : '$value';

  final List<V> values;
  final V Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, V) write;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(this, owner, wordId, read(owner), (input) {
      if (input is! V || !values.contains(input)) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(input, id, 'is not one of $values');
      }
      return write(owner, input);
    }, onCommit);
  }
}

/// A yes or no.
final class ToggleProperty<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  ToggleProperty({
    required String id,
    required this.read,
    required this.write,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate);

  final bool Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, bool) write;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(this, owner, wordId, read(owner), (input) {
      if (input is! bool) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(input, id, 'is not a bool');
      }
      return write(owner, input);
    }, onCommit);
  }
}

/// A text of at most [maxLength] code points (null: any length).
final class TextProperty<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  TextProperty({
    required String id,
    required this.read,
    required this.write,
    this.maxLength,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate) {
    final m = maxLength;
    if (m != null && m < 1) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(m, 'maxLength', 'must be at least 1');
    }
  }

  final String Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, String) write;
  final int? maxLength;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(this, owner, wordId, read(owner), (input) {
      if (input is! String) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(input, id, 'is not a String');
      }
      final m = maxLength;
      if (m != null && input.runes.length > m) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(input, id, 'is longer than $m');
      }
      return write(owner, input);
    }, onCommit);
  }
}

/// A read-only number: a room's area, a dimension's value. Its field's
/// commit is null.
final class ValueDisplay<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  ValueDisplay({
    required String id,
    required this.read,
    required this.unit,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate);

  final double Function(T) read;
  final ValueUnit unit;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(this, owner, wordId, read(owner), null, onCommit);
  }
}

/// A button: a door's Flip hinge. Its field's value is null and its commit
/// ignores its input and returns [apply] of the owner.
final class ActionProperty<T> extends PropertySpec<T> {
  ActionProperty({
    required String id,
    required this.apply,
    bool Function(T)? enabled,
    PlanGate? gate,
  }) : super._(id, enabled, gate);

  final T Function(T) apply;

  @override
  PropertyField bind(Object? value,
      {required String wordId, void Function(T next)? onCommit}) {
    final owner = _owner<T>(value);
    return _BoundField<T>(
        this, owner, wordId, null, (_) => apply(owner), onCommit);
  }
}

/// A spec bound to one owner value: one object's component or one tool's
/// settings (spec 2a P3). Erased: the plan library holds fields of many
/// owner types in one list and never sees a `T`.
abstract interface class PropertyField {
  /// For [PropertySpec.id], [PropertySpec.gate], the kind (a type test) and
  /// a kind's bounds or values only: see [PropertySpec]'s covariance note.
  PropertySpec<Object?> get spec;

  /// `property:<owner id>.<spec id>`.
  String get wordId;

  /// The spec's `enabled` of the bound owner; true when it has none.
  bool get enabled;

  /// The bound owner's value: a `double` for a length (mm), an angle
  /// (radians), a number and a display; the value for a choice; a `bool`;
  /// a `String`; null for an action.
  Object? get value;

  /// Null for a [ValueDisplay]. Otherwise: the owner changed by [input]
  /// (an action ignores it). Throws [ArgumentError] for an input of the
  /// wrong type, not finite, out of range, not among a choice's values or
  /// too long, and [StateError] while the field is not [enabled].
  Object? Function(Object? input)? get commit;
}

final class _BoundField<T> implements PropertyField {
  factory _BoundField(
      PropertySpec<T> spec,
      T owner,
      String wordId,
      Object? value,
      T Function(Object? input)? change,
      void Function(T next)? onCommit) {
    final enabled = spec.enabled?.call(owner) ?? true;
    return _BoundField._(
        spec,
        wordId,
        value,
        enabled,
        change == null
            ? null
            : (input) {
                if (!enabled) throw StateError('$wordId is not enabled');
                final next = change(input);
                onCommit?.call(next);
                return next;
              });
  }

  _BoundField._(this.spec, this.wordId, this.value, this.enabled, this.commit);

  @override
  final PropertySpec<T> spec;

  @override
  final String wordId;

  @override
  final Object? value;

  @override
  final bool enabled;

  @override
  final Object? Function(Object? input)? commit;
}

T _owner<T>(Object? value) {
  if (value is T) return value;
  throw ArgumentError.value(value, 'value', 'is not a $T');
}

double _finite(Object? input, String id) {
  if (input is num && input.isFinite) return input.toDouble();
  throw ArgumentError.value(input, id, 'is not a finite number');
}

double _inRange(double v, double? min, double? max, String id) {
  if ((min != null && v < min) || (max != null && v > max)) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
        v, id, 'is outside [${min ?? '-∞'}, ${max ?? '∞'}]');
  }
  return v;
}

void _checkBounds(double? min, double? max) {
  if (min != null && !min.isFinite) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(min, 'min', 'is not finite');
  }
  if (max != null && !max.isFinite) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(max, 'max', 'is not finite');
  }
  if (min != null && max != null && min > max) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(min, 'min', 'is above max ($max)');
  }
}
```

```dart
// Colour targets (spec 2a P3, umbrella A3): how a type's component carries
// its colour, so the panel's colour row recolours a multiple selection of
// any kits' objects in one command.
//
// Free of Flutter: a swatch is a name from the plan's palette, not a Color.
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

/// A type's colour: [read] gives its swatch (null: no colour of its own),
/// [write] a copy carrying another (null clears it). The plan library uses
/// it only through `PlanType.colourOf` and `PlanType.recolour`.
@immutable
final class ColourTarget<T> {
  const ColourTarget({required this.read, required this.write});

  final String? Function(T) read;
  final T Function(T, String?) write;
}
```

  - `PlanKit` gains `List<PlanType<Component>> types`, `List<PlanTool> tools`, `List<AttachmentProvider Function(PlanServices)> attachments` (all `const []` by default; the constructor stays `const`) and `List<String> get propertyIds`.
  - `KitProblemCode` gains `duplicateKit, duplicateType, duplicateTool, reservedKitId, typeOutsideKit, toolOutsideKit, typePlaceConflict`, appended after `localeUndeclared` (no exhaustive `switch` over it exists in the repository: `grep -rn KitProblemCode --include='*.dart' packages tool apps` outside tests shows only `plan_kit.dart`, `conformance.dart` and `kit_problem.dart`).
  - `bool isCodeId(String id)` (exported with the model, so both barrels carry it; Task 5's `conformance` uses it).

Plan decision: **`PlanType` keeps every member whose type takes `T` contravariantly private** (`section`, `title`, `colour`, through a `const` initializer list). Read through `PlanType<Component>`, such a member fails the VM's covariance check (spec P1). The members left public (`fromJson`, `parametric`, `grips`, `properties`) only return `T`, so reading them is safe: Task 6 reads `type.parametric.contributesPlace`/`readsPlaces` for `typePlaceConflict`, and `PlanKit.propertyIds` reads `properties`. Every `T`-typed use goes through the erased operations, which run inside the class over its real `T`.
Plan decision: **`registerInto` calls `catalog.register<T>` with the class's `T`,** through `guard.wrap<T>(kitOfKey(id), id, parametric)` when a guard is given. PT1 pins `T` by `catalog.objectsOf<Slab>`, which matches the registration's type argument exactly (`parametric_system.dart:521-525`).
Plan decision: **`commitField` binds the field's spec again to the object's current value** (found by `identical(spec, field.spec)` among this type's own specs), so a field read before another edit never writes back what that edit changed (the panel pins a field on focus, Task 17). A field of another type, a display, or a handle without a `T` is an `ArgumentError`; the spec's own refusals pass through unchanged. The result is one `SetComponentCommand<T>`.
Plan decision: `recolour` answers null when the type has no colour target, the handle no `T`, or the swatch is already the one asked (stored-value `==`), so the colour row's compound never holds a no-op.
Plan decision: `titleWordOf` answers the type's `title(value)` word id, or `type:<id>` when it has no hook or the handle no `T`.
Plan decision: `KitNamesWords.word` falls back locale → English → the word id itself (a missing word is visible, never blank); `maybe` answers null instead of the id. The locale is read from the callback on every call, so a language change shows at once (spec P5).
Plan decision: **`AttachmentQuery` and `Attachment` are identity-equal.** `Transform2` has no `operator ==` by design (`transform2.dart:124-126`), and a provider compares `keep.token`, its own object. Both copy their `Vector2`s and `exclude` (unmodifiable), and refuse with `ArgumentError` a capture or edge capture that is negative or not finite, a non-finite pointer, marker or transform.
Plan decision: **`PlanKit.validate` checks the code side within the kit**: a type or tool id that is not `isCodeId` with this kit's id first (`typeOutsideKit`, `toolOutsideKit`), an id given twice (`duplicateType`, `duplicateTool`), and English for every word id the code side needs: `type:<id>`, `tool:<id>`, `property:<owner>.<spec>` for each type's and tool settings' spec, and `property:<owner>.<spec>.<segment>` for each choice value (`missingEnglish`, one problem per word id, even when a locale's word also needs it). The words of an id refused as outside or repeated are not required. Kit-set problems (duplicates across kits, reserved ids, `typePlaceConflict`) are Task 6's. A property id repeated within one type is not reported (no code for it; the field list then shows two fields with the same word).
Plan decision: the `missingEnglish` message becomes `"<word id>" has no English word` (it named the locale before); K6 asserts only that it contains the word id, and still holds.
Plan decision: `propertyIds` is public: Task 5's `conformance` takes it as `propertyIds:` (R3), and a kit cannot list its choice values' segments without `ChoiceProperty.segmentOf`.

```dart
// Fixtures for PlanType and PlanKit (spec 2a P1): engine types for the slab
// and the post of code_fixtures.dart, their PlanTypes, and a document with
// one live object of each, in rotated groups off the origin.
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ObjectGripProvider;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import 'code_fixtures.dart';

/// An engine type that generates nothing and logs every object it is asked
/// to generate.
final class LoggingType<T extends Component> extends ParametricType<T> {
  LoggingType();

  final List<Handle> generated = [];

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.components;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(T params, Transform2 toWorld) => Aabb2.empty();

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    generated.add(self);
    return const [];
  }
}

String? slabSwatch(Slab s) => s.swatch;

Slab slabRecolour(Slab s, String? swatch) =>
    s.copyWith(swatch: swatch, clearSwatch: swatch == null);

String? postSwatch(Post p) => p.swatch;

Post postRecolour(Post p, String? swatch) =>
    Post(width: p.width, shape: p.shape, swatch: swatch);

/// The slab type: every property kind, a title hook, a colour target, an
/// optional section and grips.
PlanType<Slab> slabType({
  ParametricType<Slab>? engine,
  PropertySectionBuilder<Slab>? section,
  ObjectGripProvider Function(PlanServices)? grips,
}) =>
    PlanType<Slab>(
      id: Slab.id,
      fromJson: Slab.fromJson,
      parametric: engine ?? LoggingType<Slab>(),
      properties: slabSpecs(),
      title: (s) => s.raised ? 'type:test.slab.raised' : 'type:test.slab',
      colour: const ColourTarget<Slab>(read: slabSwatch, write: slabRecolour),
      section: section,
      grips: grips,
    );

/// The post type: a colour target, no title, no section, not exported.
PlanType<Post> postType({ParametricType<Post>? engine}) => PlanType<Post>(
      id: Post.id,
      fromJson: Post.fromJson,
      parametric: engine ?? LoggingType<Post>(),
      properties: postSpecs(),
      colour: const ColourTarget<Post>(read: postSwatch, write: postRecolour),
      exported: false,
    );

const Handle hSlab = Handle(4100);
const Handle hPost = Handle(4200);
const Handle hBare = Handle(4300);

final Transform2 slabAt = Transform2.translation(2150.5, -730.25)
    .multiply(Transform2.rotation(math.pi / 7));
final Transform2 postAt =
    Transform2.translation(-1840.75, 960.5).multiply(Transform2.rotation(-0.4));

DraftCommand addObject<T extends Component>(
        DraftDocument doc, Handle h, Transform2 at, T value) =>
    CompoundCommand([
      AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
          handle: h,
          parent: doc.rootHandle,
          transform: at,
          children: const [])),
      SetComponentCommand<T>(h, value),
    ], label: 'Add object');

/// A document whose catalog holds [types] (registered through
/// `registerInto`, with [guard] when given), a slab at [hSlab], a post at
/// [hPost] and a plain group at [hBare]. The caller disposes the document.
({DraftDocument doc, ParametricCatalog catalog}) objectDocument(
    List<PlanType<Component>> types,
    {TypeGuard? guard,
    Slab slab = const Slab(),
    Post post = const Post()}) {
  final catalog = ParametricCatalog();
  for (final type in types) {
    type.registerInto(catalog, guard: guard);
  }
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
  ParametricSystem(doc, catalog).install();
  doc.commands
    ..execute(addObject(doc, hSlab, slabAt, slab))
    ..execute(addObject(doc, hPost, postAt, post))
    ..execute(AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: hBare,
        parent: doc.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.translation(400.5, 300.25),
        children: const [])))
    ..clearHistory();
  return (doc: doc, catalog: catalog);
}
```

```dart
// component types `T` (a slab and a post) are held as PlanType<Component>,
// as the plan library holds them, and registered, edited, recoloured and

/// Records what it is asked to wrap and swaps in [replacements] by type id.
final class RecordingGuard implements TypeGuard {
  RecordingGuard([this.replacements = const {}]);

  final Map<String, ParametricType<Component>> replacements;
  final List<(String, String, Type)> calls = [];

  @override
  ParametricType<T> wrap<T extends Component>(
      String kitId, String typeId, ParametricType<T> type) {
    calls.add((kitId, typeId, T));
    final replacement = replacements[typeId];
    return replacement == null ? type : replacement as ParametricType<T>;
  }
}

final class FakeServices implements PlanServices {
  @override
  Object? noSuchMethod(Invocation invocation) =>
      throw UnimplementedError('${invocation.memberName}');
}

final class FakeGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  FakeGrips(this.services);

  final PlanServices services;

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) => const [];

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) =>
      null;

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
          DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) =>
      const [];

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) => true;
}
```

```dart
// Spec 2a P1, P3: PlanTool and its settings. Two tools whose settings are of

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import '../support/code_fixtures.dart';

void main() {
  test('PT12 a tool settings field: its word, its value, its store', () {
    final tool = slabTool();
    final stored = <Object>[];
    final fields = tool.settings!
        .fieldsOf(tool.settings!.initial, stored.add, toolId: tool.id);
    expect([for (final f in fields) f.wordId],
        ['property:test.slab.width', 'property:test.slab.finish']);
    expect([for (final f in fields) f.value], [900.5, Finish.oiled]);
    final next = fields[0].commit!(1200.25);
    expect(next, const SlabSettings(width: 1200.25));
    // M-PT12: drop `onCommit: store`: nothing is stored.
    expect(stored, [const SlabSettings(width: 1200.25)]);
    expect(() => fields[1].commit!(Finish.waxed), throwsArgumentError);
    expect(() => fields[0].commit!(299), throwsArgumentError);
    expect(stored, hasLength(1));
    expect(
        () => tool.settings!
            .fieldsOf(const PostSettings(), stored.add, toolId: tool.id),
        throwsArgumentError);
  });

  test('PT13 two settings types in one list of tools', () {
    // Review Focus 3, a positive control: the settings are reached only
    // through the erased PlanToolSettings<Object> and PropertyField.
    final tools = [slabTool(), postTool()];
    final values = <String, Object>{
      for (final t in tools) t.id: t.settings!.initial,
    };
    for (final tool in tools) {
      final fields = tool.settings!.fieldsOf(
          values[tool.id]!, (v) => values[tool.id] = v,
          toolId: tool.id);
      final first = fields.first;
      first.commit!(first.value is bool ? true : 1500.0);
    }
    expect(values, {
      'test.slab': const SlabSettings(width: 1500),
      'test.post': const PostSettings(round: true),
    });
    expect(tools[0].letter, 'S');
    expect(tools[0].needs, {Capability.structure, Capability.geometry});
    expect(tools[1].letter, isNull);
    expect(tools[1].needs, isEmpty);
    expect('${tools[0]}', 'PlanTool(test.slab)');
  });
}
```

```dart
// Spec 2a P5: a kit's words at the plan's locale, read live.
import 'dart:ui' show Locale;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

/// A kit's shared cache, written against the barrel alone.
final class Bands implements Disposable {
  int disposed = 0;

  @override
  void dispose() => disposed++;
}

const KitNames names = KitNames({
  'en': {'type:test.slab': 'Slab', 'tool:test.slab': 'Slab'},
  'tr': {'type:test.slab': 'Tezgâh'},
});

void main() {
  test('PT19 the locale, then English, then the id or null', () {
    var locale = const Locale('tr', 'TR');
    final words = KitNamesWords(names, () => locale);
    expect(words.word('type:test.slab'), 'Tezgâh');
    expect(words.word('tool:test.slab'), 'Slab');
    // M-PT19a: `word` answers '' for a missing word.
    expect(words.word('property:test.slab.width'), 'property:test.slab.width');
    expect(words.maybe('property:test.slab.width'), isNull);
    expect(words.maybe('tool:test.slab'), 'Slab');
    // M-PT19b: read the locale once, in the constructor.
    locale = const Locale('de');
    expect(words.locale, const Locale('de'));
    expect(words.word('type:test.slab'), 'Slab');
    expect(identical(words.names, names), isTrue);
  });

  test('PT24 Disposable is exported for kits to implement', () {
    // A premise of the export list, exempt from the mutation rule: without
    // the export this file does not compile.
    final Disposable bands = Bands()..dispose();
    expect((bands as Bands).disposed, 1);
  });
}
```

```dart
// Spec 2a P3: the attachment value types. A query and an answer never change
// after they are made, and refuse what no provider can use.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

final Transform2 turned =
    Transform2.translation(1520.5, -640.25).multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.6));

AttachmentQuery query({
  Vector2? pointer,
  double capture = 120.5,
  double edgeCapture = 40.25,
  Set<Handle> exclude = const {Handle(5100)},
  Attachment? keep,
}) =>
    AttachmentQuery(
      footprint: const Aabb2.raw(-450.5, -300.25, 450.5, 300.25),
      current: turned,
      pointer: pointer ?? Vector2(1610.75, -580.5),
      capture: capture,
      edgeCapture: edgeCapture,
      mirrored: true,
      mayRotate: false,
      exclude: exclude,
      keep: keep,
    );

Matcher refusedOn(String name) =>
    throwsA(isA<ArgumentError>().having((e) => e.name, 'name', name));

void main() {
  test('PT20 a query copies its pointer and its exclusions', () {
    final pointer = Vector2(1610.75, -580.5);
    final exclude = {const Handle(5100)};
    final q = query(pointer: pointer, exclude: exclude);
    pointer.x = 0;
    exclude.add(const Handle(5200));
    // M-PT20a: keep the caller's vector. M-PT20b: keep the caller's set.
    expect(q.pointer, Vector2(1610.75, -580.5));
    expect(q.exclude, {const Handle(5100)});
    expect(() => q.exclude.add(const Handle(5300)), throwsUnsupportedError);
    expect(q.mirrored, isTrue);
    expect(q.mayRotate, isFalse);
    expect(q.keep, isNull);
  });

  test('PT21 a query refuses a capture it cannot use', () {
    // M-PT21a: drop the capture check. M-PT21b: drop the pointer check.
    expect(() => query(capture: -0.5), refusedOn('capture'));
    expect(() => query(capture: double.nan), refusedOn('capture'));
    expect(() => query(edgeCapture: double.infinity), refusedOn('edgeCapture'));
    expect(() => query(pointer: Vector2(double.nan, 2)), refusedOn('pointer'));
    expect(query(capture: 0, edgeCapture: 0).capture, 0);
  });

  test('PT22 an answer copies its marker and refuses non-finite values', () {
    final marker = Vector2(1702.5, -515.25);
    final a = Attachment(transform: turned, marker: marker, token: 'run 3');
    marker.y = 0;
    // M-PT22a: keep the caller's vector.
    expect(a.marker, Vector2(1702.5, -515.25));
    expect(a.token, 'run 3');
    expect(query(keep: a).keep, same(a));
    // M-PT22b: drop the marker check. M-PT22c: drop the transform check.
    expect(
        () => Attachment(
            transform: turned, marker: Vector2(double.infinity, 1), token: 1),
        refusedOn('marker'));
    expect(
        () => Attachment(
            transform: Transform2(1, 0, 0, 1, double.nan, 0),
            marker: Vector2(1, 1),
            token: 1),
        refusedOn('transform'));
  });
}
```

- [ ] **Step 6: Diagnostics, attachment, services.** Create `lib/src/kit/kit_diagnostic.dart` (pure Dart):

```dart
// A kit's runtime diagnostic (spec 2a P4): what the plan library reports
// when a kit's code fails, a kit is missing or newer, a letter is taken or a
// symbol library cannot be used. Unlike a KitProblem, never a refusal: the
// plan goes on.
//
// Pure Dart: no Flutter, no dart:io.
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

enum KitDiagnosticCode {
  /// A kit's hook threw: a type's, a tool's, a grip provider's, an
  /// attachment provider's or a section's.
  hookFailed,

  /// A rolled-back edit could not be rolled back; the plan is damaged.
  rollbackFailed,

  /// A damaged plan does not encode and decode; it cannot be saved.
  damagedUnsavable,

  /// A component's `fromJson` threw on load; it is kept raw and its object
  /// is locked.
  componentUnreadable,

  /// A tool's letter is already taken, or is F; the tool has none.
  letterTaken,

  /// A symbol attaches to a kind no loaded kit's provider offers.
  attachmentKindUnoffered,

  /// A symbol library cannot be read or decoded; it is skipped.
  libraryUnreadable,

  /// A symbol library holds another kit's id; it is refused.
  libraryKitMismatch,

  /// A `key@N` an earlier kit already gave; the later one is dropped.
  symbolDuplicate,

  /// The plan names a kit the host did not load; its objects are locked.
  kitMissing,

  /// The plan was saved by a newer version of a loaded kit.
  kitNewer,
}

/// One diagnostic: the kit it concerns, the type, tool, library or object it
/// names ([subject], null for the kit itself), its [code], a message a
/// person can act on, and the [error] caught, if any.
///
/// Equal by kit, subject, code and message; the error is not compared.
@immutable
final class KitDiagnostic {
  const KitDiagnostic({
    required this.kitId,
    this.subject,
    required this.code,
    required this.message,
    this.error,
  });

  final String kitId;
  final String? subject;
  final KitDiagnosticCode code;
  final String message;
  final Object? error;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is KitDiagnostic &&
      other.kitId == kitId &&
      other.subject == subject &&
      other.code == code &&
      other.message == message;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(kitId, subject, code, message);

  @override
  String toString() =>
      '${code.name} [$kitId${subject == null ? '' : ' $subject'}]: $message';
}
```

Create `lib/src/kit/attachment.dart`:

```dart
// Attachment (spec 2a P3, umbrella A5): a kit's provider offers where a
// symbol may attach (a wall's face, a room's corner); the plan library asks
// every provider of the kinds a symbol's `attachTo` names and keeps the
// answer whose marker is nearest the pointer.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// A kit's attachment provider: one target [kind], made once per document
/// from the kit's `attachments` factories.
abstract interface class AttachmentProvider {
  /// A target kind (K2's kind pattern): `wall-face`.
  String get kind;

  /// Where the symbol in [query] attaches, or null for nowhere near. Must
  /// not mutate the document.
  Attachment? attach(AttachmentQuery query);
}

/// What a provider is asked: the symbol, where it is, where the pointer is.
///
/// [pointer] and [exclude] are copied: the query never changes after it is
/// made.
@immutable
final class AttachmentQuery {
  /// Throws [ArgumentError] for a capture or an edge capture that is
  /// negative or not finite, and for a pointer that is not finite.
  AttachmentQuery({
    required this.footprint,
    required this.current,
    required Vector2 pointer,
    required this.capture,
    required this.edgeCapture,
    required this.mirrored,
    required this.mayRotate,
    Set<Handle> exclude = const {},
    this.keep,
  })  : pointer = Vector2.copy(pointer),
        exclude = Set.unmodifiable(exclude) {
    _checkDistance(capture, 'capture');
    _checkDistance(edgeCapture, 'edgeCapture');
    if (!pointer.x.isFinite || !pointer.y.isFinite) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(pointer, 'pointer', 'is not finite');
    }
  }

  /// The symbol's box in its own frame.
  final Aabb2 footprint;

  /// The symbol's transform now (while placing: the ghost's).
  final Transform2 current;

  /// The raw world point under the pointer.
  final Vector2 pointer;

  /// World distances: how far from a target the pointer may be, and how
  /// near an end of a target the symbol may slide.
  final double capture;
  final double edgeCapture;

  /// Whether the symbol is mirrored now.
  final bool mirrored;

  /// False (the `rotate` permission is off): offer only targets the
  /// symbol's current turn already fits.
  final bool mayRotate;

  /// Objects not to attach to: the one being moved.
  final Set<Handle> exclude;

  /// The previous answer, for hysteresis; null at first.
  final Attachment? keep;
}

/// Where a symbol attaches: its new [transform], the world point the plan
/// library draws its marker at, and the provider's own [token] (a face run),
/// which it reads back from [AttachmentQuery.keep].
///
/// [marker] is copied.
@immutable
final class Attachment {
  /// Throws [ArgumentError] for a transform or a marker that is not finite.
  Attachment({
    required this.transform,
    required Vector2 marker,
    required this.token,
  }) : marker = Vector2.copy(marker) {
    final t = transform;
    if (![t.a, t.b, t.c, t.d, t.e, t.f].every((v) => v.isFinite)) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(transform, 'transform', 'is not finite');
    }
    if (!marker.x.isFinite || !marker.y.isFinite) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(marker, 'marker', 'is not finite');
    }
  }

  final Transform2 transform;
  final Vector2 marker;
  final Object token;
}

/// The plan library's registry over every loaded kit's providers.
abstract interface class AttachmentRegistry {
  /// The answer of the providers of [kinds] nearest the pointer, or null.
  Attachment? attach(List<String> kinds, AttachmentQuery query);

  /// The kinds some provider offers.
  Set<String> get kinds;
}

void _checkDistance(double v, String name) {
  if (!v.isFinite || v < 0) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(v, name, 'must be finite and not negative');
  }
}
```

Create `lib/src/kit/plan_services.dart`:

```dart
// The live view a kit's tools, grip providers and attachment providers get
// of one plan (spec 2a P1): one per kit per controller, implemented by the
// plan library. And a kit's words at the plan's locale.
import 'dart:ui' show Locale;

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show CameraController;

import '../model/kit_names.dart';
import 'attachment.dart';

/// A kit's words at the plan's current locale (spec 2a P5).
abstract interface class KitWords {
  /// The word [wordId] in the locale, else in English, else [wordId] itself
  /// (a missing word shows its id, never nothing).
  String word(String wordId);

  /// The word [wordId] in the locale, else in English, else null.
  String? maybe(String wordId);

  /// The locale the words are in now.
  Locale get locale;
}

/// [KitWords] over a kit's [names], at the locale [locale] answers each
/// time it is read: a change of the plan's language shows at once.
final class KitNamesWords implements KitWords {
  KitNamesWords(this.names, Locale Function() locale) : _locale = locale;

  final KitNames names;
  final Locale Function() _locale;

  @override
  Locale get locale => _locale();

  @override
  String? maybe(String wordId) => names.word(locale.languageCode, wordId);

  @override
  String word(String wordId) => maybe(wordId) ?? wordId;
}

/// What a kit's `shared` object implements to be released with its
/// document (spec 2a P1, lifetimes).
abstract interface class Disposable {
  void dispose();
}

/// One plan, as a kit's code sees it. Every member reads the current
/// document: a kit's factories run once per document (spec 2a P1,
/// lifetimes), so what they keep never outlives it.
abstract interface class PlanServices {
  /// The current document.
  DraftDocument get document;

  /// Its spatial index.
  SpatialIndex get index;

  /// The camera, for apertures in world units.
  CameraController get camera;

  /// The effective object-snap flag: F3 and the editor's snapping option.
  bool get objectSnap;

  /// Every loaded kit's attachment providers.
  AttachmentRegistry get attachments;

  /// This kit's words at the plan's locale.
  KitWords get words;

  /// The current settings of the tool [toolId] (one of this kit's tools
  /// with settings). Throws [ArgumentError] for another id or an `S` the
  /// settings are not.
  S settingsOf<S extends Object>(String toolId);

  /// This kit's one [T] for the current document: [create] runs on the
  /// first call, later calls return the same instance. A [T] that is a
  /// [Disposable] is disposed with its document. Keyed by (kit, `T`), so two
  /// kits asking for the same type get one each.
  T shared<T extends Object>(T Function(PlanServices) create);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The type and the tool.** Create `lib/src/kit/plan_type.dart`:

```dart
// A kit's parametric type (spec 2a P1): the engine's ParametricType and its
// component factory, wrapped with the type's property specs, colour target,
// grips, title and escape-hatch section.
//
// Covariance: the plan library holds every type as PlanType<Component>. A
// member whose type takes a `T` would fail the VM's covariance check when
// read through that static type, and `catalog.register` would infer
// `T = Component`. So those members are private, and the plan library calls
// only the erased operations below, which run over the class's own `T`, as
// the engine's own registration does.
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show BuildContext, Widget;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ObjectGripProvider;
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

import '../model/kit_ids.dart';
import 'colour.dart';
import 'plan_services.dart';
import 'properties.dart';

/// A type's escape hatch (umbrella A4): its own panel section over [value],
/// committing a changed copy through [commit], one undo step.
typedef PropertySectionBuilder<T> = Widget Function(
    BuildContext context, T value, void Function(T) commit, KitWords words);

/// Wraps a kit's engine type at the contract's boundary (spec 2a P4, the
/// failure boundary). Implemented by the plan library; [wrap] keeps `T`.
abstract interface class TypeGuard {
  ParametricType<T> wrap<T extends Component>(
      String kitId, String typeId, ParametricType<T> type);
}

@immutable
final class PlanType<T extends Component> {
  const PlanType({
    required this.id,
    required this.fromJson,
    required this.parametric,
    this.grips,
    this.properties = const [],
    PropertySectionBuilder<T>? section,
    String Function(T)? title,
    ColourTarget<T>? colour,
    this.exported = true,
  })  : _section = section,
        _title = title,
        _colour = colour;

  /// `<kit id>.<type>`, equal to the component's codec type id: the
  /// manifest finds the plan's kits by it.
  final String id;

  final ComponentFactory<T> fromJson;
  final ParametricType<T> parametric;

  /// Made once per document (spec 2a P1, lifetimes).
  final ObjectGripProvider Function(PlanServices)? grips;

  /// The panel's fields, in order. Safe to list through
  /// `PlanType<Component>`; use them through [fieldsOf].
  final List<PropertySpec<T>> properties;

  /// False leaves the type's objects out of every export.
  final bool exported;

  final PropertySectionBuilder<T>? _section;
  final String Function(T)? _title;
  final ColourTarget<T>? _colour;

  bool get hasColour => _colour != null;
  bool get hasSection => _section != null;

  /// Registers this type into [catalog] under [id], with `T` kept: through
  /// [guard]'s wrapper when one is given (the plan library's).
  void registerInto(ParametricCatalog catalog, {TypeGuard? guard}) {
    final type = guard == null
        ? parametric
        : guard.wrap<T>(kitOfKey(id), id, parametric);
    catalog.register<T>(id, fromJson, type);
  }

  /// The fields of [group]'s `T`, bound to its current value, each under
  /// `property:<id>.<spec id>`; empty when [group] carries no `T`.
  List<PropertyField> fieldsOf(CommandTarget target, Handle group) {
    final value = target.components.get<T>(group);
    if (value == null) return const [];
    return [
      for (final spec in properties)
        spec.bind(value, wordId: 'property:$id.${spec.id}'),
    ];
  }

  /// The word id of [group]'s section title: `type:<id>`, unless the
  /// type's `title` names another for its current value.
  String titleWordOf(CommandTarget target, Handle group) {
    final value = target.components.get<T>(group);
    final title = _title;
    if (value == null || title == null) return 'type:$id';
    return title(value);
  }

  /// [group]'s swatch; null without a colour target, a `T`, or a swatch.
  String? colourOf(CommandTarget target, Handle group) {
    final value = target.components.get<T>(group);
    final colour = _colour;
    if (value == null || colour == null) return null;
    return colour.read(value);
  }

  /// The one command that gives [group] [swatch] (null clears it); null
  /// without a colour target or a `T`, or when the swatch is already it.
  DraftCommand? recolour(CommandTarget target, Handle group, String? swatch) {
    final value = target.components.get<T>(group);
    final colour = _colour;
    if (value == null || colour == null) return null;
    final next = colour.write(value, swatch);
    if (next == value) return null;
    return SetComponentCommand<T>(group, next);
  }

  /// The one command that commits [input] through [field], one of this
  /// type's fields: bound again to [group]'s current value, so a field
  /// read before another edit never writes back what that edit changed.
  ///
  /// Throws [ArgumentError] when [field] is not one of this type's specs,
  /// [group] carries no `T` or the field is a display, and what the
  /// field's commit throws (spec 2a P3: out of range, disabled).
  DraftCommand commitField(
      CommandTarget target, Handle group, PropertyField field, Object? input) {
    final spec = properties.firstWhere((s) => identical(s, field.spec),
        orElse: () => throw ArgumentError.value(
            field.wordId, 'field', 'is not a field of $id'));
    final value = target.components.get<T>(group);
    if (value == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(group, 'group', 'carries no $id');
    }
    final commit = spec.bind(value, wordId: field.wordId).commit;
    if (commit == null) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(field.wordId, 'field', 'is read-only');
    }
    return SetComponentCommand<T>(group, commit(input) as T);
  }

  /// [group]'s escape-hatch section, or null without one or a `T`. Its
  /// commit hands [execute] one `SetComponentCommand<T>`.
  Widget? sectionFor(BuildContext context, CommandTarget target, Handle group,
      void Function(DraftCommand) execute, KitWords words) {
    final value = target.components.get<T>(group);
    final section = _section;
    if (value == null || section == null) return null;
    return section(context, value,
        (next) => execute(SetComponentCommand<T>(group, next)), words);
  }

  /// This type's grip provider over [services], or null without one.
  ObjectGripProvider? gripsFor(PlanServices services) => grips?.call(services);

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanType($id)';
}
```

```dart
// A kit's tool (spec 2a P1): a palette entry whose `create` makes the
// Flutter layer's Tool over a plan's services, with optional settings the
// property panel edits while the tool is active (spec 2a P3).
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show IconData;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Capability;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show Tool;
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

import 'plan_services.dart';
import 'properties.dart';

/// A tool's settings: one value of `S` per tool and controller, starting at
/// [initial], edited through [specs], read by the tool through
/// `PlanServices.settingsOf`.
@immutable
final class PlanToolSettings<S extends Object> {
  const PlanToolSettings({required this.initial, required this.specs});

  final S initial;
  final List<PropertySpec<S>> specs;

  /// The fields of [value], an `S`, each under
  /// `property:<toolId>.<spec id>`; a field's commit hands the changed
  /// settings to [store] and returns them. Binding throws [ArgumentError]
  /// when [value] is not an `S`.
  List<PropertyField> fieldsOf(Object value, void Function(Object) store,
          {required String toolId}) =>
      [
        for (final spec in specs)
          spec.bind(value,
              wordId: 'property:$toolId.${spec.id}', onCommit: store),
      ];
}

@immutable
final class PlanTool {
  const PlanTool({
    required this.id,
    required this.icon,
    this.letter,
    this.needs = const {},
    this.settings,
    required this.create,
  });

  /// `<kit id>.<tool>`; its word is `tool:<id>`.
  final String id;

  final IconData icon;

  /// A suggested shortcut letter; the plan library gives it unless an
  /// earlier tool took it (spec 2a P2, the keyboard).
  final String? letter;

  /// What the tool's commits need; empty for a tool that only reads. The
  /// palette disables a tool whose needs the document's permissions deny.
  final Set<Capability> needs;

  final PlanToolSettings<Object>? settings;

  /// Made once per document (spec 2a P1, lifetimes).
  final Tool Function(PlanServices) create;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanTool($id)';
}
```

```dart
// A kit's descriptor (spec K5, grown by spec 2a P1): its symbols, its
// parametric types, its tools, its attachment providers and its words.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Component;
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

import '../model/kit_ids.dart';
import '../model/kit_names.dart';
import '../model/kit_problem.dart';
import 'attachment.dart';
import 'plan_services.dart';
import 'plan_tool.dart';
import 'plan_type.dart';
import 'properties.dart';
import 'symbol_library_source.dart';

@immutable
final class PlanKit {
  const PlanKit({
    required this.id,
    required this.version,
    this.symbols = const [],
    this.types = const [],
    this.tools = const [],
    this.attachments = const [],
    this.names = KitNames.empty,
  });

  /// A kit id (K2): the first segment of the kit's keys, type and tool ids.
  final String id;

  /// The kit package's version, for the plan manifest.
  final String version;

  final List<SymbolLibrarySource> symbols;
  final List<PlanType<Component>> types;
  final List<PlanTool> tools;

  /// Made once per document (spec 2a P1, lifetimes).
  final List<AttachmentProvider Function(PlanServices)> attachments;

  final KitNames names;

  /// Every property word id of the kit without its `property:` prefix, in
  /// declaration order: `<type id>.<spec id>` for each type's specs,
  /// `<tool id>.<spec id>` for each tool's settings, and for a choice also
  /// `<owner id>.<spec id>.<value>` per value. Pass it to `conformance`.
  List<String> get propertyIds => [
        for (final type in types) ..._specIds(type.id, type.properties),
        for (final tool in tools)
          if (tool.settings case final settings?)
            ..._specIds(tool.id, settings.specs),
      ];

  /// The descriptor's problems: a bad id, an empty version, a word under
  /// another kit's id or in no known namespace; a type or tool id that is not
  /// `<this kit's id>.<name>` or is repeated; a word with no stored English
  /// missing from English, for every word a type, tool or property needs.
  /// Empty when sound. Problems across kits are the plan library's.
  List<KitProblem> validate() {
    final problems = <KitProblem>[];
    if (!isKitId(id)) {
      problems.add(KitProblem(
          KitProblemCode.badKitId,
          '"$id" is not a kit id: a lower-case letter, then lower-case '
          'letters and digits'));
    }
    if (version.trim().isEmpty) {
      problems.add(KitProblem(
          KitProblemCode.emptyVersion, 'the kit "$id" has no version'));
    }
    // Word ids under this kit that need an English word, in order.
    final needEnglish = <String>{};
    for (final MapEntry(key: locale, value: words) in names.words.entries) {
      for (final wordId in words.keys) {
        final colon = wordId.indexOf(':');
        final namespace = colon < 0 ? '' : wordId.substring(0, colon);
        final rest = wordId.substring(colon + 1);
        var foreign = false;
        switch (namespace) {
          case 'category':
            final slash = rest.indexOf('/');
            foreign = slash < 0 || rest.substring(0, slash) != id;
          case 'symbol' || 'tool' || 'type' || 'property':
            foreign = !rest.contains('.') || kitOfKey(rest) != id;
            if (!foreign && namespace != 'symbol') needEnglish.add(wordId);
          default:
            problems.add(KitProblem(KitProblemCode.unknownWordId,
                '$locale: "$wordId" is in no known namespace'));
        }
        if (foreign) {
          problems.add(KitProblem(KitProblemCode.foreignWordId,
              '$locale: "$wordId" is not under the kit "$id"'));
        }
      }
    }
    bool declared(String what, String declaredId, Set<String> seen,
        KitProblemCode outside, KitProblemCode twice) {
      if (!isCodeId(declaredId) || kitOfKey(declaredId) != id) {
        problems.add(KitProblem(outside,
            'the $what "$declaredId" is not "$id.<name>" (lower-case segments)'));
        return false;
      }
      if (!seen.add(declaredId)) {
        problems.add(KitProblem(twice, 'the $what "$declaredId" is repeated'));
        return false;
      }
      needEnglish.add('$what:$declaredId');
      return true;
    }

    final typeIds = <String>{};
    for (final type in types) {
      if (declared('type', type.id, typeIds, KitProblemCode.typeOutsideKit,
          KitProblemCode.duplicateType)) {
        for (final p in _specIds(type.id, type.properties)) {
          needEnglish.add('property:$p');
        }
      }
    }
    final toolIds = <String>{};
    for (final tool in tools) {
      if (declared('tool', tool.id, toolIds, KitProblemCode.toolOutsideKit,
              KitProblemCode.duplicateTool) &&
          tool.settings != null) {
        for (final p in _specIds(tool.id, tool.settings!.specs)) {
          needEnglish.add('property:$p');
        }
      }
    }
    final english = names.words[KitNames.english] ?? const <String, String>{};
    for (final wordId in needEnglish) {
      if (!english.containsKey(wordId)) {
        problems.add(KitProblem(
            KitProblemCode.missingEnglish, '"$wordId" has no English word'));
      }
    }
    return problems;
  }
}

List<String> _specIds(String owner, List<PropertySpec<Object?>> specs) => [
      for (final spec in specs) ...[
        '$owner.${spec.id}',
        if (spec case ChoiceProperty(:final values))
          for (final v in values)
            '$owner.${spec.id}.${ChoiceProperty.segmentOf(v)}',
      ],
    ];
```

### Task 5: Contract inputs R2, R3, R5, R7 (spec P6)

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/example/cafe_code.dart`
- Modify: `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/lib/src/model/json_fields.dart` (`optionalField`), `lib/src/model/symbol_component.dart` (R2), `lib/src/authoring/catalog.dart` (R2), `lib/src/authoring/builder.dart` (R2), `lib/src/model/symbol_library.dart` (R7), `lib/src/authoring/conformance.dart` (R3), `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`; `docs/kits.md` (repository root; R5 and the code side)
- Test: create `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/test/kit/example_code_test.dart`; modify `test/model/symbol_component_test.dart`, `test/authoring/builder_test.dart`, `test/authoring/snapshot_test.dart`, `test/model/symbol_library_test.dart`, `test/authoring/conformance_test.dart`, `test/invariants/doc_snippets_test.dart` (the block count)

(All paths below are under `packages/jet_cad_2d_kit/` unless they start at the repository root.)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 4's `PlanKit.types`/`tools`/`propertyIds`, `PlanType` (`registerInto`, `fieldsOf`, `commitField`, `recolour`, `colourOf`), `isCodeId`, `KitProblemCode.typeOutsideKit`/`toolOutsideKit`; Task 3's specs and `ColourTarget`. Existing: `SymbolComponent` (`lib/src/model/symbol_component.dart:19-150`, keys alphabetical at `:107-115`, every field required by `fromJson` at `:120-131`), `field<T>` (`lib/src/model/json_fields.dart:8-17`), `CatalogSymbol` (`lib/src/authoring/catalog.dart:66-93`), `buildLibraryDocument` (`lib/src/authoring/builder.dart:31-106`), `geometrySnapshot` (`lib/src/authoring/snapshot.dart:13-29`: base, shapes, unit only), rule 11 (`lib/src/model/symbol_library.dart:311-334`, the area test at `:323-333`), `conformance` (`lib/src/authoring/conformance.dart:25-68`, `_wordProblems` `:139-188`), `doc_snippets_test.dart` DOC1 (`:56`, `docs/kits.md` pinned at 4 blocks), the committed `test/fixtures/sample_kit/sample.jetlib` (held byte-equal by conformance F0).
- Produces:
  - `SymbolComponent({…, bool retired = false})`, `final bool retired`; `CatalogSymbol({…, bool retired = false})`, `final bool retired` (the Shared interfaces' R2 line).
  - `conformance({…, Iterable<String> typeIds = const [], Iterable<String> toolIds = const [], Iterable<String> propertyIds = const []})` (R3, additive).
  - Rule 11 refuses a closed-polyline outline whose `2·area/perimeter` is at or under `Tolerance.standard.linear` (R7).
  - Not exported: `T optionalField<T>(Map<String, Object?> json, String key, String type, T absent)` in `json_fields.dart`.
  - `docs/kits.md` §10, the code side (R5); `example/cafe_code.dart` (`CafeSign`, `CafeSignType`, `signProperties`, `signColour`, `cafeCodeKit`, `cafeCodeNames`), whose two blocks the document shows verbatim.

Plan decision: **`retired` is written only when true and read as false when absent** (contract R2). Writing it always would change the bytes of every library and plan: the committed `test/fixtures/sample_kit/sample.jetlib`, which conformance F0 holds byte-equal to `encodeLibrary(sampleCatalog)` (K7.1), and every kit's committed library after it. Written only when true, its key sits in its alphabetical place (between `name` and `tags`), so K2's fixed key order holds for every text that has it. A present value must be a `bool` (`FormatException` otherwise, as every other field); `retired: false` written by hand reads as false. This departs from K2's plan decision "every field is required": a field added after the format was first written must be optional when read (R2's own words).
Plan decision: **retiring changes no snapshot entry.** `geometrySnapshot` holds geometry and the unit (K7); a retired `key@N` keeps both. The library's bytes change (the definition carries the mark), so conformance reports `builtDiffers` until the generator runs, and conforms after (R2-7).
Plan decision: **R7's width is `2 · area / perimeter`,** the area by the existing shoelace (relative to the first vertex) and the perimeter over the stored points, the closing pair included (a closed polyline repeats its first point, `jet_cad_2d/lib/src/document/drafting.dart:102-116`). Rule 15 runs first and refuses a polyline whose points all lie within the tolerance (`symbol_library.dart:444-449`), so the perimeter is never zero. Checked numerically before writing: the 600 mm × 1e-9 mm sliver at y = 560 has width ≈ 9.99989e-10 (refused); 600 × 2e-9 has ≈ 1.99998e-9 (loads; without the factor 2 it would be ≈ 9.99989e-10 and refused, M-R7c); 600 × 1 has ≈ 0.998.
Plan decision: **V11d and V11e are replaced, V11c's message part changes.** They are this package's own tests of the K3 amendment R7 replaces, not ported tests. V11e's triangle (area 2·linear², about 2e-15 mm wide) loaded under the area test and is refused under the width test: it becomes R7-2, refused. V11d (area linear²/2) is refused under both rules, so it can no longer tell them apart and is dropped. V11c's diagonal is still refused; its message part becomes `is too thin (width 0.0)`.
Plan decision: **R3 codes:** a type id that is not `isCodeId` under the kit is `typeOutsideKit`, a tool id `toolOutsideKit` (Task 4's codes); a property id not under the kit (or without a dot) is `foreignWordId`, since a property id exists only as the word `property:<id>`. A code word without English is `missingEnglish`; with English, it is held to every declared locale by the existing check (`wordMissing`, `wordUntranslated`, `sameAsEnglish`). A code word naming none of the given ids is not an orphan: a kit may pass part of its ids, and a kit calling without them (as before 2a) is held to nothing new (R3-5).
Plan decision: **R5 in `docs/kits.md` is a new §10 plus edits of §§2-9,** and the code it shows is `example/cafe_code.dart`'s (DOC1 requires every ```` ```dart ```` block verbatim in `example/`; the count goes from 4 to 6). The example is a real code-side kit: `example_code_test.dart` validates, registers, edits and regenerates it.
