```dart
// A kit's code side (docs/kits.md section 10): a parametric type, its
// property specs, its colour target and its descriptor. Analysed with the
// package; test/kit/example_code_test.dart runs it.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

enum SignFace { chalk, board }

/// A cafe's menu board: its width in millimetres, its face and its colour.
final class CafeSign implements Component {
  const CafeSign({required this.width, required this.face, this.swatch});

  static const String id = 'cafe.sign';

  final double width;
  final SignFace face;
  final String? swatch;

  CafeSign copyWith({double? width, SignFace? face}) => CafeSign(
      width: width ?? this.width, face: face ?? this.face, swatch: swatch);

  CafeSign withSwatch(String? swatch) =>
      CafeSign(width: width, face: face, swatch: swatch);

  @override
  String get typeId => id;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() =>
      {'face': face.name, 'swatch': swatch, 'width': width};

  static CafeSign fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) => CafeSign(
        width: (json['width']! as num).toDouble(),
        face: SignFace.values.byName(json['face']! as String),
        swatch: json['swatch'] as String?,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is CafeSign &&
      other.width == width &&
      other.face == face &&
      other.swatch == swatch;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(width, face, swatch);
}

/// The sign's geometry: a closed outline, its width by 80 mm, centred on
/// its group's origin.
final class CafeSignType extends ParametricType<CafeSign> {
  const CafeSignType();

  static List<Vector2> outline(CafeSign sign) => [
        Vector2(-sign.width / 2, -40),
        Vector2(sign.width / 2, -40),
        Vector2(sign.width / 2, 40),
        Vector2(-sign.width / 2, 40),
      ];

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.geometry;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(CafeSign params, Transform2 toWorld) => Aabb2.fromPoints(
      [for (final p in outline(params)) toWorld.transformPoint(p)]);

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    final sign = view.paramsOf<CafeSign>(self)!;
    return [
      Generated(
          EntityKind.polyline, polylinePayload(outline(sign), closed: true)),
    ];
  }
}

final List<PropertySpec<CafeSign>> signProperties = [
  LengthProperty<CafeSign>(
    id: 'width',
    read: (s) => s.width,
    write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(width: v),
    min: 300,
    max: 2400,
  ),
  ChoiceProperty<CafeSign, SignFace>(
    id: 'face',
    values: SignFace.values,
    read: (s) => s.face,
    write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(face: v),
  ),
  ValueDisplay<CafeSign>(
    id: 'area',
    read: (s) => s.width * 80,
    unit: ValueUnit.area,
  ),
];

final ColourTarget<CafeSign> signColour = ColourTarget<CafeSign>(
  read: (s) => s.swatch,
  write: (s, swatch) => s.withSwatch(swatch),
);

final PlanKit cafeCodeKit = PlanKit(
  id: 'cafe',
  version: '0.1.0',
  types: [
    PlanType<CafeSign>(
      id: CafeSign.id,
      fromJson: CafeSign.fromJson,
      parametric: const CafeSignType(),
      properties: signProperties,
      colour: signColour,
    ),
  ],
  names: cafeCodeNames,
);

const KitNames cafeCodeNames = KitNames({
  'en': {
    'type:cafe.sign': 'Menu board',
    'property:cafe.sign.width': 'Width',
    'property:cafe.sign.face': 'Face',
    'property:cafe.sign.face.chalk': 'Chalk',
    'property:cafe.sign.face.board': 'Board',
    'property:cafe.sign.area': 'Area',
  },
  'tr': {
    'type:cafe.sign': 'Menü panosu',
    'property:cafe.sign.width': 'Genişlik',
    'property:cafe.sign.face': 'Yüzey',
    'property:cafe.sign.face.chalk': 'Tebeşir',
    'property:cafe.sign.face.board': 'Pano',
    'property:cafe.sign.area': 'Alan',
  },
});
```

Create `test/kit/example_code_test.dart`:

```dart
// Spec 2a P6 (R5): the code side docs/kits.md shows is the example's, and it
// validates, registers, edits and regenerates.
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';

import '../../example/cafe_code.dart';

void main() {
  test('R5-1 the documented code kit validates, edits and regenerates', () {
    expect(cafeCodeKit.validate(), isEmpty);
    expect(cafeCodeKit.propertyIds, [
      'cafe.sign.width',
      'cafe.sign.face',
      'cafe.sign.face.chalk',
      'cafe.sign.face.board',
      'cafe.sign.area',
    ]);
    final type = cafeCodeKit.types.single;
    final catalog = ParametricCatalog();
    type.registerInto(catalog);
    final doc = DraftDocument.empty();
    addTearDown(doc.dispose);
    ParametricSystem(doc, catalog).install();
    const sign = Handle(3100);
    doc.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
      AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
          handle: sign,
          parent: doc.rootHandle,
          transform: Transform2.translation(1820.5, 640.25)
              .multiply(Transform2.rotation(math.pi / 5)),
          children: const [])),
      SetComponentCommand<CafeSign>(
          sign, const CafeSign(width: 900, face: SignFace.chalk)),
    ], label: 'Add sign'));
    final width = type.fieldsOf(doc, sign).first;
    expect(width.value, 900.0);
    // M-R5: the example's `min: 300` lowered to 200.
    expect(() => type.commitField(doc, sign, width, 250), throwsArgumentError);
    doc.commands.execute(type.commitField(doc, sign, width, 1500));
    final outline = [
      for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots)
        if (doc.entities.ownerAt(slot) == sign)
          doc.geometry.read(doc.entities.geomIndexAt(slot)).coords,
    ].single;
    expect(outline.sublist(0, 4), [-750.0, -40.0, 750.0, -40.0]);
    doc.commands.execute(type.recolour(doc, sign, 'ochre')!);
    expect(type.colourOf(doc, sign), 'ochre');
  });
}
```

 | Component | On | Fields |

+## 10. The code side
+
+A kit contributes the engine's own types and the Flutter layer's own tools,
+each wrapped in a contract descriptor. The plan library composes them: it
+registers the types, arms the tools, shows the fields, and calls every hook
+through a guard. A kit never registers into the engine itself.
+
+The snippets of this section are `example/cafe_code.dart`'s: a cafe's menu
+board, `CafeSign`, a component with a width, a face and a colour, drawn by
+`CafeSignType`, the engine's `ParametricType<CafeSign>`.
+
+### 10.1 The descriptor
+
+```dart
+final PlanKit cafeCodeKit = PlanKit(
+  id: 'cafe',
+  version: '0.1.0',
+  types: [
+    PlanType<CafeSign>(
+      id: CafeSign.id,
+      fromJson: CafeSign.fromJson,
+      parametric: const CafeSignType(),
+      properties: signProperties,
+      colour: signColour,
+    ),
+  ],
+  names: cafeCodeNames,
+);
+```
+
+`PlanKit` carries `types` (`PlanType`), `tools` (`PlanTool`) and
+`attachments` (factories of `AttachmentProvider`) beside its symbols and
+words. Its factories (a tool's `create`, a type's `grips`, the
+`attachments`) run **once per document**: when the plan is replaced
+(`load`, `newPlan`, an import), the plan library disposes what they made
+and runs them again, so nothing a kit holds outlives its document.
+
+### 10.2 A parametric type
+
+| `PlanType` field | What it is |
+|---|---|
+| `id` | `<kit id>.<name>`, equal to the component's `typeId`: a plan's manifest finds its kits by it |
+| `fromJson` | the component's factory |
+| `parametric` | the engine's `ParametricType<T>`: `reach`, `generate`, `references`, the place hooks |
+| `grips` | `ObjectGripProvider Function(PlanServices)?`: the Flutter layer's grips for its objects |
+| `properties` | the panel's fields (§10.3) |
+| `section` | the escape hatch: `(context, value, commit, words) => Widget`, for what specs cannot say; `commit(T)` is one undo step |
+| `title` | a word id for the section's title, from the value; default `type:<id>` |
+| `colour` | a `ColourTarget` (§10.4) |
+| `exported` | false leaves the type's objects out of every export |
+
+**Covariance.** The plan library holds every type as `PlanType<Component>`.
+A member whose type takes a `T` (a section builder, a spec's `read`) fails
+Dart's runtime type check when read through that supertype, and
+`register` would infer `T = Component`. So `PlanType` keeps those members
+private and offers erased operations that run over its own `T`:
+`registerInto`, `fieldsOf`, `commitField`, `titleWordOf`, `colourOf`,
+`recolour`, `sectionFor`, `gripsFor`. The plan library calls only these. A
+kit calls none of them, and never reads a spec's `read`, `write` or
+`enabled` through a supertype either.
+
+### 10.3 Property specs
+
+```dart
+final List<PropertySpec<CafeSign>> signProperties = [
+  LengthProperty<CafeSign>(
+    id: 'width',
+    read: (s) => s.width,
+    write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(width: v),
+    min: 300,
+    max: 2400,
+  ),
+  ChoiceProperty<CafeSign, SignFace>(
+    id: 'face',
+    values: SignFace.values,
+    read: (s) => s.face,
+    write: (s, v) => s.copyWith(face: v),
+  ),
+  ValueDisplay<CafeSign>(
+    id: 'area',
+    read: (s) => s.width * 80,
+    unit: ValueUnit.area,
+  ),
+];
+
+final ColourTarget<CafeSign> signColour = ColourTarget<CafeSign>(
+  read: (s) => s.swatch,
+  write: (s, swatch) => s.withSwatch(swatch),
+);
+```
+
+| Kind | Holds | The panel |
+|---|---|---|
+| `LengthProperty` | `read`, `write`, `min`, `max` | millimetres, with the plan's decimal separator |
+| `AngleProperty` | `read`, `write` | radians stored, degrees shown |
+| `NumberProperty` | `read`, `write`, `min`, `max`, `decimals` (0 to 10) | rounded to `decimals` on commit |
+| `ChoiceProperty<T, V>` | `values`, `read`, `write` | one of `values`, compared with `==` |
+| `ToggleProperty` | `read`, `write` | a switch |
+| `TextProperty` | `read`, `write`, `maxLength` (code points) | a text field |
+| `ValueDisplay` | `read`, `unit` (`length`, `area`, `angle`, `none`) | read-only: a room's area |
+| `ActionProperty` | `apply` | a button: a door's Flip hinge |
+
+- Every spec has an `id` (a lower-case letter, then lower-case letters,
+  digits and hyphens), an optional `enabled(T)` that greys the field out,
+  and an optional `gate`, the `PlanGate` permission it needs.
+- `write` and `apply` return a changed copy; the plan library commits it
+  as one `SetComponentCommand<T>`, the parametric system regenerates, and
+  the edit is one undo step.
+- Out of range, not finite, not one of the values, too long: the input is
+  refused and the field shows its stored value again. A bad `min`, `max`,
+  `decimals`, `maxLength`, `values` or `id` is an `ArgumentError` when the
+  spec is made.
+- Words: `property:<type id>.<id>`, a choice's values
+  `property:<type id>.<id>.<value>`.
+
+### 10.4 Colour
+
+A `ColourTarget` reads a component's swatch, a name from the plan's palette,
+and writes a copy with another (null clears it). The panel's colour row
+recolours every selected object whose type has one, of any kit, in one
+command; the `recolor` permission gates it.
+
+### 10.5 Tools
+
+| `PlanTool` field | What it is |
+|---|---|
+| `id` | `<kit id>.<name>`; its word is `tool:<id>` |
+| `icon` | the palette's icon |
+| `letter` | a suggested shortcut. The plan library's tools keep V, L, P, R, C, A and T; F is reserved; kits' letters follow in load order, and a letter already taken goes to no later tool (a `letterTaken` diagnostic) |
+| `needs` | the `Capability`s its commits need; the palette disables it where the document's permissions deny one |
+| `settings` | `PlanToolSettings<S>(initial: ..., specs: [...])`: one `S` per tool, edited in the panel with the same specs while the tool is active (words `property:<tool id>.<id>`), read by the tool through `PlanServices.settingsOf` |
+| `create` | `Tool Function(PlanServices)`: the Flutter layer's `Tool` |
+
+### 10.6 The services
+
+`PlanServices` is a live view of one plan, one per kit:
+
+| Member | |
+|---|---|
+| `document`, `index`, `camera` | the current document, its spatial index, the camera (apertures in world units) |
+| `objectSnap` | the effective object-snap flag: F3 and the editor's snapping |
+| `attachments` | every loaded kit's attachment providers (§10.7) |
+| `words` | `KitWords`: this kit's words at the plan's locale, falling back to English, read live |
+| `settingsOf<S>(toolId)` | a tool's current settings |
+| `shared<T>(create)` | one `T` per kit and document, made on first use: what a kit's tools, grips and providers share (a wall's bands). A `T` that implements `Disposable` is disposed with its document |
+
+### 10.7 Attachment
+
+An `AttachmentProvider` offers one target kind (`wall-face`). Asked with an
+`AttachmentQuery` (the symbol's footprint and transform, the pointer, the
+capture distances, whether it is mirrored, whether it may rotate, what to
+exclude, the previous answer), it answers an `Attachment` (where the symbol
+goes, where the plan library draws its marker, a token of its own) or null.
+The plan library asks the providers of every kind in a symbol's `attachTo`
+and keeps the answer whose marker is nearest the pointer. Under
+`rotate: false`, a provider offers only targets the symbol's current turn
+already fits.
+
+### 10.8 When a kit's code fails
+
+Every hook is called through a guard. A failure never stops the plan; it
+becomes a `KitDiagnostic` (kit, subject, `KitDiagnosticCode`, message),
+once per subject and code:
+
+| What throws | What happens |
+|---|---|
+| a `ParametricType` hook | the edit is rolled back; the type's objects are probed, and each one whose hooks throw is frozen (treated as a plain group) and locked; the edit is tried once more. One broken object blocks one edit, once |
+| a component's `fromJson`, on load | the component is kept as stored, and its object is locked |
+| grips, an attachment provider | none for that object; no attachment |
+| a tool's `create` | the tool is disabled |
+| a tool's event or painting | the tool is cancelled and selection is armed |
+| a spec's `write` or `apply` | the field shows its stored value |
+| a section | a small "section failed" box in its place |
+
+A plan that names a kit the host did not load opens: that kit's objects
+draw, are locked, and are saved back unchanged (`kitMissing`). A plan saved
+by a newer version of a loaded kit opens with a warning (`kitNewer`).
+
+### 10.9 The engine's types, and byte equality
+
+**The engine's types bind the contract.** A `PlanType` takes the engine's
+`ParametricType<T>` and `Component`; a tool commits the engine's
+`DraftCommand`s to its `DraftDocument`; a library's `SymbolLeaf` exposes
+`EntityRecord` and `GeometryPayload`, a `SymbolEntry` its `Definition`.
+Wrapping them in contract types would rewrite the parametric and grip
+layers, so the contract uses them as they are. A breaking change of one of
+them in `jet_cad_2d` 0.x is a breaking change of the contract and of every
+kit that uses it.
+
+**Byte equality ties a kit's CI to the codec.** The conformance test
+compares the committed `.jetlib` with `encodeLibrary(catalog)` byte for
+byte, and those bytes are the engine codec's `encodeToString`. An engine
+release that changes that output (a key order, a number's spelling, a new
+field) turns every kit's conformance test red with `builtDiffers` until the
+kit runs its generator again. That is a regeneration, not a change of
+geometry: the snapshot is unaffected and every published `key@N` keeps its
+shapes. A kit that raises its `jet_cad_2d` constraint runs its generator
+and commits the new library in the same change.
````

### Task 6: The `jet_cad_2d_plan` package, kit-set validation, the test kits and CI (spec P4 "The kit set", "Tests")

#### Test kit API

Every later task imports these from `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/support/`. Names are fixed here; later tasks only **add** to these files (Task 7 adds `planText` to `harness.dart`, Task 8 adds `controllerFor`).

`test/support/test_kit.dart`:
- ids: `const String slabTypeId = 'test.slab'`, `const String slabToolId = 'test.slab'`, `const String discTypeId = 'disc.round'`, `const String readerTypeId = 'test.reader'`, `const String testEdgeKind = 'test-edge'`.
- kits (a fresh descriptor per call, so no state leaks between tests): `PlanKit testKit({String version = '1.2.0', KitLog? log})` (id `test`: type `test.slab`, tool `test.slab` with settings, one `test-edge` provider, words `en` + `tr`, no `de`); `PlanKit discKit({String version = '0.4.0'})` (id `disc`: type `disc.round`, a second component type for the covariance tests); `PlanKit conflictKit()` (id `test`: type `test.reader`, which both contributes and reads places).
- descriptors: `PlanType<SlabComponent> slabType({KitLog? log})`, `PlanTool slabTool({KitLog? log})`, `List<PropertySpec<SlabComponent>> slabProperties()`, `List<PropertySpec<SlabSettings>> slabSettingSpecs()`, `Widget slabSection(BuildContext, SlabComponent, void Function(SlabComponent), KitWords)`, `String slabTitle(SlabComponent)`.
- components: `SlabComponent` (`width`, `height`, `angle`, `thickness`, `finish`, `labelled`, `label`, `flipped`, `swatch`; `copyWith`, `withSwatch`, `fromJson`), `SlabSettings` (`width`, `height`), `DiscComponent` (`radius`, `swatch`), `ReaderComponent` (`size`).
- engine and Flutter-layer parts: `SlabType`, `DiscType`, `ReaderType` (`ParametricType`s), `SlabGrips` (`ObjectGripProvider`, `Disposable`), `SlabTool` (`PlacementTool`: first press anchors, second commits), `SlabCache` (`Disposable`, what the tool and the grips share through `PlanServices.shared`), `TestEdge` (`AttachmentProvider`, `Disposable`; a horizontal edge at world `y`, kind configurable, hysteresis through `keep`, `mayRotate: false` honoured).
- geometry: `List<Vector2> slabCorners(SlabComponent)`, `List<Vector2> discOutline(DiscComponent)`.
- words: `const KitNames testWords`, `const KitNames discWords`.
- lifecycle log: `KitLog` (`events`, `int created(String what)`, `void disposed(String what, int serial)`): products log `tool+N`/`tool-N`, `grips+N`/`grips-N`, `cache+N`/`cache-N`, `edge+N`/`edge-N`.
- placement: `CompoundCommand placeObjectCommand<T extends Component>(DraftDocument d, T component, {required Vector2 at, Handle? handle})`, `Handle addObject<T extends Component>(DraftDocument d, T component, {required Vector2 at})`. **`T` must be the concrete component type** (pass a value whose static type is `SlabComponent`, not `Component`): `SetComponentCommand<T>` stores by `T`.

#### Contract signatures this task assumes (Tasks 3 and 4)

The shared interfaces name the property kinds and the attachment value types but not their constructors. The code below assumes named parameters spelled as spec P3 spells the fields. **If Tasks 3-4 landed other spellings, adapt only the constructor calls in `test_kit.dart` and `throwing_kit.dart`; never the kits' behaviour.**
- `LengthProperty<T>({required String id, required double Function(T) read, required T Function(T, double) write, double? min, double? max, bool Function(T)? enabled, PlanGate? gate})`; `AngleProperty<T>` the same without `min`/`max` (radians); `NumberProperty<T>` the same plus `int decimals`; `ChoiceProperty<T, V>({required String id, required List<V> values, required V Function(T) read, required T Function(T, V) write, ...})`; `ToggleProperty<T>` over `bool`; `TextProperty<T>` over `String` plus `int? maxLength`; `ValueDisplay<T>({required String id, required double Function(T) read, required ValueUnit unit, ...})`; `ActionProperty<T>({required String id, required T Function(T) apply, ...})`.
- `Attachment({required Transform2 transform, required Vector2 marker, required Object token})`; `AttachmentQuery` read through its fields `footprint`, `current`, `pointer`, `capture`, `edgeCapture`, `mirrored`, `mayRotate`, `exclude`, `keep`.
- `PlanType` exposes public `fromJson`, `parametric`, `grips` and `properties` (confirmed by Task 4); `validateKitSet` reads `type.parametric.contributesPlace` and `readsPlaces`, which are not `T`-typed. `AttachmentQuery` requires `mirrored` and `mayRotate`; angles in a `PropertyField` are radians.
- `PlanKit.validate()` (Task 4) reports a duplicate type or tool id **within** one kit as `duplicateType` / `duplicateTool`. `validateKitSet` reports only duplicates **across** kits, so nothing is reported twice.
- `Disposable` (`abstract interface class Disposable { void dispose(); }`) is Task 4's, in `jet_cad_2d_kit`'s `plan_services.dart`; this task's kits implement it.

- Modify: `pubspec.yaml` (root, the `workspace:` list), `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (the `package` matrix and the `publishable` matrix)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes (contract, Tasks 3-4, exactly as the plan's Shared interfaces): `PlanKit` (`id`, `version`, `types`, `tools`, `attachments`, `names`, `validate()`), `PlanType`, `PlanTool`, `PlanToolSettings`, `PropertySpec` and its eight kinds, `PlanGate`, `ValueUnit`, `ColourTarget`, `KitWords`, `PlanServices`, `AttachmentProvider`, `AttachmentQuery`, `Attachment`, `KitProblem`, `KitProblemCode` (with `duplicateKit`, `duplicateType`, `duplicateTool`, `reservedKitId`, `typeOutsideKit`, `toolOutsideKit`, `typePlaceConflict`), `KitNames`, `registerKitComponents`, `Disposable` (Task 4). Engine: `ParametricCatalog`, `ParametricSystem(document, catalog)` (E2's `isFrozen` is optional and not used here), `ParametricType`. Flutter layer: `PlacementTool`, `Tool`, `ToolContext`, `ToolPointerEvent`, `ObjectGripProvider`, `Grip`.
- Produces (exported from `package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart`):
  - `final class KitSet` — `List<PlanKit> get kits` (load order), `PlanKit? kitOf(String id)`, plus `List<PlanType<Component>> get types` and `List<PlanTool> get tools` (kit by kit in load order) and `PlanType<Component>? typeOf(String typeId)`.
  - `KitSet validateKitSet(List<PlanKit> kits)` — throws `KitSetError` listing every problem.
  - `final class KitSetError extends ArgumentError` — `List<KitProblem> problems`; `name == 'kits'`; `message` has one line `  <code>: <message>` per problem.
  - `const Set<String> reservedKitIds = {'plan', 'jetcad'}`.
  - The package itself, resolvable in the workspace, in CI's `package` and `publishable` matrices.
  - The test kit API above.

Plan decision: `validateKitSet` reports, per kit in load order: a reserved id, a duplicate kit id (at the later kit), the kit's own `validate()` problems (each message prefixed `<kit id>: `), then per type a type id another kit already gave (`duplicateType`) and a place conflict (`typePlaceConflict`), then per tool a tool id another kit already gave (`duplicateTool`). A duplicate inside one kit is `validate()`'s, so it is reported once. A type id repeated by a kit with a duplicate kit id is covered by `duplicateKit` and is not reported again.
Plan decision: the conflict is read from the descriptor (`type.parametric.contributesPlace && type.parametric.readsPlaces`), the same flags `ParametricCatalog.register` refuses (`parametric_system.dart:497-505`), so the set is refused before any catalog exists.
Plan decision: the publishable dry run joins CI in this task, as `jet_cad_2d_kit`'s did in sub-project 1's Task 11: a later task that breaks it is red on that task's push.

```dart
// The test kit of the plan library (spec 2a "Tests"): one parametric type,
// `test.slab`, with all eight property kinds, a gate, a title hook, a
// colour target, grips and an escape-hatch section; one tool with
// settings; a `test-edge` attachment provider; English and Turkish words,
// no German (the fallback). `discKit` gives a second kit whose type has
// another component type (the covariance tests); `conflictKit` a type that
// both contributes and reads places (the kit-set refusal).
//
// Fixtures sit off the origin, turned, with non-default attributes
// (CLAUDE.md): a slab's outline is turned by its own `angle` inside a group
// placed by translation.
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

const String slabTypeId = 'test.slab';
const String slabToolId = 'test.slab';
const String discTypeId = 'disc.round';
const String readerTypeId = 'test.reader';
const String testEdgeKind = 'test-edge';

/// What the kits' factories made and disposed, in order: `tool+1`,
/// `cache+1`, `grips+1`, ..., `tool-1`. A serial per kind of product.
final class KitLog {
  final List<String> events = [];
  final Map<String, int> _serials = {};

  /// Logs `<what>+<n>` and returns `n`, this product's serial.
  int created(String what) {
    final n = (_serials[what] ?? 0) + 1;
    _serials[what] = n;
    events.add('$what+$n');
    return n;
  }

  void disposed(String what, int serial) => events.add('$what-$serial');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The slab.

/// A rectangle [width] x [height] (mm) centred on its group's origin and
/// turned by [angle] (radians), with the attributes the eight property
/// kinds edit.
@immutable
final class SlabComponent implements Component {
  SlabComponent({
    required this.width,
    required this.height,
    this.angle = 0,
    this.thickness = 120,
    this.finish = 'plain',
    this.labelled = false,
    this.label = '',
    this.flipped = false,
    this.swatch,
  }) {
    if (!width.isFinite || width <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(width, 'width', 'must be finite and above 0');
    }
    if (!height.isFinite || height <= 0) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(height, 'height', 'must be finite and above 0');
    }
    if (!angle.isFinite) {
      throw ArgumentError.value(angle, 'angle', 'must be finite');
    }
  }

  static const String componentTypeId = slabTypeId;

  final double width;
  final double height;
  final double angle;
  final double thickness;
  final String finish;
  final bool labelled;
  final String label;
  final bool flipped;
  final String? swatch;

  @override
  String get typeId => componentTypeId;

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
        'angle': angle,
        'finish': finish,
        'flipped': flipped,
        'height': height,
        'label': label,
        'labelled': labelled,
        'swatch': swatch,
        'thickness': thickness,
        'width': width,
      };

  static SlabComponent fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) => SlabComponent(
        width: (json['width']! as num).toDouble(),
        height: (json['height']! as num).toDouble(),
        angle: ((json['angle'] as num?) ?? 0).toDouble(),
        thickness: ((json['thickness'] as num?) ?? 120).toDouble(),
        finish: json['finish'] as String? ?? 'plain',
        labelled: json['labelled'] as bool? ?? false,
        label: json['label'] as String? ?? '',
        flipped: json['flipped'] as bool? ?? false,
        swatch: json['swatch'] as String?,
      );

  SlabComponent copyWith({
    double? width,
    double? height,
    double? angle,
    double? thickness,
    String? finish,
    bool? labelled,
    String? label,
    bool? flipped,
  }) =>
      SlabComponent(
        width: width ?? this.width,
        height: height ?? this.height,
        angle: angle ?? this.angle,
        thickness: thickness ?? this.thickness,
        finish: finish ?? this.finish,
        labelled: labelled ?? this.labelled,
        label: label ?? this.label,
        flipped: flipped ?? this.flipped,
        swatch: swatch,
      );

  /// This slab in the plan's swatch [swatch] (null: none).
  SlabComponent withSwatch(String? swatch) => SlabComponent(
        width: width,
        height: height,
        angle: angle,
        thickness: thickness,
        finish: finish,
        labelled: labelled,
        label: label,
        flipped: flipped,
        swatch: swatch,
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is SlabComponent &&
      other.width == width &&
      other.height == height &&
      other.angle == angle &&
      other.thickness == thickness &&
      other.finish == finish &&
      other.labelled == labelled &&
      other.label == label &&
      other.flipped == flipped &&
      other.swatch == swatch;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(width, height, angle, thickness, finish,
      labelled, label, flipped, swatch);

  @override
  String toString() => 'SlabComponent($width x $height @ $angle)';
}

/// The slab's corners in its group's space, counter-clockwise.
List<Vector2> slabCorners(SlabComponent s) {
  final c = math.cos(s.angle), n = math.sin(s.angle);
  final hw = s.width / 2, hh = s.height / 2;
  return [
    for (final (x, y) in [(-hw, -hh), (hw, -hh), (hw, hh), (-hw, hh)])
      Vector2(x * c - y * n, x * n + y * c),
  ];
}

/// The slab's engine type: its outline, one closed polyline.
final class SlabType extends ParametricType<SlabComponent> {
  const SlabType();

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.geometry;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(SlabComponent params, Transform2 toWorld) => Aabb2.fromPoints(
      [for (final c in slabCorners(params)) toWorld.transformPoint(c)]);

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    final p = view.paramsOf<SlabComponent>(self)!;
    return [
      Generated(
          EntityKind.polyline, polylinePayload(slabCorners(p), closed: true)),
    ];
  }
}

/// What the slab tool and the slab grips share, through
/// `PlanServices.shared`: one per document.
final class SlabCache implements Disposable {
  SlabCache({this.log}) : serial = log?.created('cache') ?? 0;

  final KitLog? log;
  final int serial;
  bool disposed = false;

  @override
  void dispose() {
    disposed = true;
    log?.disposed('cache', serial);
  }
}

/// One stretch grip, at the middle of the slab's right edge; dragging it
/// sets the width to twice the drop's distance along the slab's axis.
final class SlabGrips implements ObjectGripProvider, Disposable {
  SlabGrips(this.cache, {this.log}) : serial = log?.created('grips') ?? 0;

  final SlabCache cache;
  final KitLog? log;
  final int serial;

  static Transform2? _toWorld(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    final node = d.tree[group];
    return node is GroupNode ? node.transform : null;
  }

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    final s = d.components.get<SlabComponent>(group);
    final t = _toWorld(d, group);
    if (s == null || t == null) return const [];
    final p = t.transformPoint(Vector2(math.cos(s.angle) * s.width / 2,
        math.sin(s.angle) * s.width / 2));
    return [Grip(GripRole.stretch, 0, p.x, p.y)];
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    final s = d.components.get<SlabComponent>(group);
    final t = _toWorld(d, group);
    if (s == null || t == null) return null;
    final local = t.invert().transformPoint(world);
    final width =
        2 * (local.x * math.cos(s.angle) + local.y * math.sin(s.angle));
    if (width <= Tolerance.standard.linear) return null;
    return SetComponentCommand<SlabComponent>(group, s.copyWith(width: width));
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    final command = drag(d, group, grip, world);
    if (command is! SetComponentCommand<SlabComponent>) return const [];
    final t = _toWorld(d, group)!;
    return [
      (
        EntityKind.polyline,
        polylinePayload(
            [for (final c in slabCorners(command.value!)) t.transformPoint(c)],
            closed: true)
      ),
    ];
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) => true;

  @override
  void dispose() => log?.disposed('grips', serial);
}

/// The slab tool's settings: the size of the next slab, in mm.
@immutable
final class SlabSettings {
  const SlabSettings({required this.width, required this.height});

  final double width;
  final double height;

  SlabSettings copyWith({double? width, double? height}) =>
      SlabSettings(width: width ?? this.width, height: height ?? this.height);

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is SlabSettings && other.width == width && other.height == height;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(width, height);
}

/// Two presses: the first anchors the slab's centre, the second turns it
/// towards the press and commits a slab of the tool's settings' size.
final class SlabTool extends PlacementTool {
  SlabTool(this.services, {this.log})
      : cache = services.shared<SlabCache>((_) => SlabCache(log: log)),
        serial = log?.created('tool') ?? 0;

  final PlanServices services;
  final KitLog? log;
  final SlabCache cache;
  final int serial;

  @override
  String get name => 'Slab';

  @override
  void accept(Vector2 point, ToolContext ctx) {
    if (points.isEmpty) {
      points.add(point);
      return;
    }
    final start = points.first;
    final d = point - start;
    if (d.length <= Tolerance.standard.linear) return;
    final size = services.settingsOf<SlabSettings>(slabToolId);
    commit(
        ctx,
        () => placeObjectCommand<SlabComponent>(
            ctx.document,
            SlabComponent(
                width: size.width,
                height: size.height,
                angle: math.atan2(d.y, d.x)),
            at: start),
        needs: const {
          Capability.structure,
          Capability.components,
          Capability.geometry,
        });
    clearShape();
  }

  @override
  void paintRubberBand(Canvas canvas, Vector2 origin, double scale) {}

  @override
  void dispose() {
    log?.disposed('tool', serial);
    super.dispose();
  }
}

// The test edge.

/// A horizontal edge at world [y], of kind [kind]: a symbol whose pointer
/// comes within `capture` of it (within `edgeCapture` while it is already
/// attached here, `keep`) sits unturned with its local `minY` on the edge,
/// mirrored when asked. With `mayRotate` false it attaches only a symbol
/// whose turn already fits (unturned, or the plain mirror).
class TestEdge implements AttachmentProvider, Disposable {
  TestEdge({this.kind = testEdgeKind, this.y = 3000, this.log})
      : serial = log?.created('edge') ?? 0;

  @override
  final String kind;
  final double y;
  final KitLog? log;
  final int serial;

  @override
  Attachment? attach(AttachmentQuery query) {
    final kept = identical(query.keep?.token, this);
    final reach = kept ? query.edgeCapture : query.capture;
    if ((query.pointer.y - y).abs() > reach) return null;
    final x = query.mirrored ? -1.0 : 1.0;
    if (!query.mayRotate) {
      final t = query.current;
      const tol = Tolerance.standard;
      if ((t.a - x).abs() > tol.angular || t.b.abs() > tol.angular) {
        return null;
      }
    }
    return Attachment(
        transform: Transform2(x, 0, 0, 1, query.pointer.x, y - query.footprint.minY),
        marker: Vector2(query.pointer.x, y),
        token: this);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() => log?.disposed('edge', serial);
}

/// A 24-gon of the disc's radius, centred on its group's origin.
List<Vector2> discOutline(DiscComponent d) => [
      for (var i = 0; i < 24; i++)
        Vector2(d.radius * math.cos(i * math.pi / 12),
            d.radius * math.sin(i * math.pi / 12)),
    ];

final class DiscType extends ParametricType<DiscComponent> {
  const DiscType();

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.geometry;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(DiscComponent params, Transform2 toWorld) => Aabb2.fromPoints(
      [for (final p in discOutline(params)) toWorld.transformPoint(p)]);

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    final p = view.paramsOf<DiscComponent>(self)!;
    return [
      Generated(
          EntityKind.polyline, polylinePayload(discOutline(p), closed: true)),
    ];
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Placing objects.

/// A root-level group at [at] carrying [component] and the drawing layer:
/// one undo step. [T] must be the component's concrete type: the store is
/// chosen by it.
CompoundCommand placeObjectCommand<T extends Component>(
    DraftDocument d, T component,
    {required Vector2 at, Handle? handle}) {
  final h = handle ?? d.handleSeed.next();
  return CompoundCommand([
    AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
        handle: h,
        parent: d.rootHandle,
        transform: Transform2.translation(at.x, at.y),
        children: const [])),
    SetComponentCommand<T>(h, component),
    SetComponentCommand<ObjectLayer>(h, ObjectLayer(drawingLayer(d))),
  ], label: 'Add ${component.typeId}');
}

/// [placeObjectCommand], executed; the new object's handle.
Handle addObject<T extends Component>(DraftDocument d, T component,
    {required Vector2 at}) {
  final h = d.handleSeed.next();
  d.commands.execute(placeObjectCommand<T>(d, component, at: at, handle: h));
  return h;
}

import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'test_kit.dart';

/// Every hook the throwing kit can fail.
const Set<String> boomHooks = {
  // The engine's ParametricType.
  'reach', 'references', 'pageKey', 'placeBox', 'placeInput', 'readBox',
  'dissolves', 'generate', 'diagnose',
  // The component's factory.
  'fromJson',
  // The grip provider: its factory, then each call.
  'gripsCreate', 'gripsOf', 'gripsDrag', 'gripsPreview', 'gripsMovable',
  // The tool: its factory, its events, its painting.
  'toolCreate', 'toolDown', 'toolMove', 'toolUp', 'toolExit', 'toolKey',
  'toolCancel', 'toolPaint',
  // The attachment provider: its factory, then attach.
  'attachCreate', 'attach',
  // Properties, the section (its builder, then the widget it returns), the
  // colour target and the title.
  'read', 'write', 'apply', 'section', 'sectionWidget', 'colourRead',
  'colourWrite', 'title',

/// What a failing hook throws: not an `Error`, as a kit's own exception
/// would not be.
final class BoomFailure implements Exception {
  const BoomFailure(this.hook);

  final String hook;

  @override

}

final class ThrowingKit {
  /// [failing] names hooks of [boomHooks]; any other name is an
  /// [ArgumentError].
  ThrowingKit({Iterable<String> failing = const []}) : failing = {} {
    for (final hook in failing) {

        throw ArgumentError.value(hook, 'failing', 'is no hook of the kit');
      }

/// The three boom components: a square of [size] (mm) centred on the
/// group's origin, a plan swatch, and the objects it references.
@immutable
sealed class BoomComponent implements Component {
  const BoomComponent({required this.size, this.swatch, this.refs = const []});

  final double size;
  final String? swatch;
  final List<Handle> refs;

  BoomComponent copyWith({double? size, List<Handle>? refs});
  BoomComponent withSwatch(String? swatch);

  @override
  Map<String, Object?> toJson() => {
        'refs': [for (final h in refs) h.value],
        'size': size,
        'swatch': swatch,
      };

  static ({double size, String? swatch, List<Handle> refs}) read(
          Map<String, Object?> json) =>
      (
        size: (json['size']! as num).toDouble(),
        swatch: json['swatch'] as String?,
        refs: [
          for (final v in (json['refs'] as List<Object?>?) ?? const <Object?>[])
            Handle.fromJson(v),
        ],
      );

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is BoomComponent &&
      other.runtimeType == runtimeType &&
      other.size == size &&
      other.swatch == swatch &&
      listEquals(other.refs, refs);

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(runtimeType, size, swatch, Object.hashAll(refs));
}

  static ZoneComponent fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json) {
    final r = BoomComponent.read(json);
    return ZoneComponent(size: r.size, swatch: r.swatch, refs: r.refs);
  }
}

/// The square's corners in its group's space.
List<Vector2> boomSquare(double size) => [
      Vector2(-size / 2, -size / 2),
      Vector2(size / 2, -size / 2),
      Vector2(size / 2, size / 2),
      Vector2(-size / 2, size / 2),
    ];

Aabb2 _boxOf(double size, Transform2 toWorld) => Aabb2.fromPoints(
    [for (final c in boomSquare(size)) toWorld.transformPoint(c)]);

/// Every engine hook calls [ThrowingKit.check] with its own name first. A
/// reference that dangles orphans (keeps) the referrer, so a fixture never
/// cascades by accident.
final class BoomType<T extends BoomComponent> extends ParametricType<T> {
  const BoomType(this.kit, {this.contributes = false, this.reads = false});

  final ThrowingKit kit;
  final bool contributes;
  final bool reads;

  @override
  Capability get editCapability => Capability.geometry;

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(T params, Transform2 toWorld) {
    kit.check('reach');
    return _boxOf(params.size, toWorld);
  }

  @override
  Iterable<Handle> references(T params) {
    kit.check('references');
    return params.refs;
  }

  @override
  ReferencePolicy get referencePolicy => ReferencePolicy.orphan;

  @override
  Object? pageKey(PageComponent? page) {
    kit.check('pageKey');
    return null;
  }

  @override
  bool dissolves(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    kit.check('dissolves');
    return false;
  }

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    kit.check('generate');
    final p = view.paramsOf<T>(self)!;
    if (reads) view.placedIn(_boxOf(p.size, view.toWorld(self)));
    return [
      Generated(
          EntityKind.polyline, polylinePayload(boomSquare(p.size), closed: true)),
    ];
  }

  @override
  List<Diagnostic> diagnose(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    kit.check('diagnose');
    return const [];
  }

  @override
  bool get contributesPlace => contributes;

  @override
  Aabb2? placeBox(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    kit.check('placeBox');
    final p = view.paramsOf<T>(self);
    return p == null ? null : _boxOf(p.size, view.toWorld(self));
  }

  @override
  Object placeInput(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    kit.check('placeInput');
    final p = view.paramsOf<T>(self);
    final b = p == null ? null : _boxOf(p.size, view.toWorld(self));
    return (b?.minX, b?.minY, b?.maxX, b?.maxY);
  }

  @override
  bool get readsPlaces => reads;

  @override
  Aabb2 readBox(T params, Transform2 toWorld, Aabb2 stored) {
    kit.check('readBox');
    return _boxOf(params.size, toWorld);
  }
}

/// One stretch grip at the block's right edge; a drag sets the size.
final class BoomGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  BoomGrips(this.kit);

  final ThrowingKit kit;

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    kit.check('gripsOf');
    final b = d.components.get<BlockComponent>(group);
    final node = d.tree[group];
    if (b == null || node is! GroupNode) return const [];
    final p = node.transform.transformPoint(Vector2(b.size / 2, 0));
    return [Grip(GripRole.stretch, 0, p.x, p.y)];
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    kit.check('gripsDrag');
    final b = d.components.get<BlockComponent>(group);
    final node = d.tree[group];
    if (b == null || node is! GroupNode) return null;
    final size = 2 * node.transform.invert().transformPoint(world).x.abs();
    if (size <= Tolerance.standard.linear) return null;
    return SetComponentCommand<BlockComponent>(group, b.copyWith(size: size));
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    kit.check('gripsPreview');
    return const [];
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    kit.check('gripsMovable');
    return true;
  }
}

/// A press places a 400 mm block at the press; every other call only
/// checks its hook.
final class BoomTool extends Tool {
  BoomTool(this.kit);

  final ThrowingKit kit;

  @override
  String get name => 'Boom';

  @override
  ToolPhase get phase => ToolPhase.idle;

  @override
  void onPointerDown(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {
    kit.check('toolDown');
    if (e.buttons & kPrimaryButton == 0) return;
    ctx.execute(placeObjectCommand<BlockComponent>(
        ctx.document, const BlockComponent(size: 400),
        at: e.world));
  }

  @override
  void onPointerMove(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) =>
      kit.check('toolMove');

  @override
  void onPointerUp(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) => kit.check('toolUp');

  @override
  void onPointerExit(ToolContext ctx) => kit.check('toolExit');

  @override
  KeyEventResult onKey(KeyEvent event, ToolContext ctx) {
    kit.check('toolKey');
    return KeyEventResult.ignored;
  }

  @override
  void cancel(ToolContext ctx) => kit.check('toolCancel');

  @override
  void paintOverlay(Canvas canvas, ViewportTransform camera, Size viewport,
          PaperPalette paper) =>
      kit.check('toolPaint');

  @override
  void paintWorldOverlay(
          Canvas canvas, Vector2 origin, double scale, PaperPalette paper) =>
      kit.check('toolPaint');
}

/// The test edge at `y = -2000`, kind `boom-edge`, whose attach can throw.
final class BoomEdge extends TestEdge {
  BoomEdge(this.kit) : super(kind: 'boom-edge', y: -2000);

  final ThrowingKit kit;

  @override
  Attachment? attach(AttachmentQuery query) {
    kit.check('attach');
    return super.attach(query);
  }
}

/// The block's section: its build checks `sectionWidget`.
final class BoomSection extends StatelessWidget {
  const BoomSection({super.key, required this.kit});

  final ThrowingKit kit;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    kit.check('sectionWidget');
    return const Text('boom', key: Key('boom-section'));
  }
}

```dart
// The plan library's test helpers (spec 2a "Tests"): plan documents over a
// list of kits and their parametric system, pointer events for driving a
// tool without a canvas, and a pump that puts a widget in an app. Later
// tasks add to it: Task 7 `planText`, Task 8 `controllerFor`.
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// Every kit's types registered, in load order, without a guard.
ParametricCatalog catalogOf(List<PlanKit> kits) {
  final catalog = ParametricCatalog();
  for (final kit in kits) {
    for (final type in kit.types) {
      type.registerInto(catalog);
    }
  }
  return catalog;
}

/// The page, the contract's four components and [catalog]'s: what a plan
/// document registers. Once per registry (`PageComponent.register` wipes
/// a live page).
void registerPlanComponents(
    ComponentRegistry registry, ParametricCatalog catalog) {
  PageComponent.register(registry);
  registerKitComponents(registry);
  catalog.registerComponents(registry);
}

/// A new plan's document over [kits]: millimetres, the default page (A4
/// landscape at 1:50, origin (-7425, -5250)) printing [separator], no
/// history. No system is installed.
DraftDocument planDocument(List<PlanKit> kits,
    {TextMeasurer measurer = const InsertionPointMeasurer(),
    DecimalSeparator separator = DecimalSeparator.point}) {
  final d = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: measurer);
  registerPlanComponents(d.components, catalogOf(kits));
  d.header.units = DrawingUnits.millimeters;
  d.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
      d.rootHandle,
      PageComponent(
          originX: -7425, originY: -5250, decimalSeparator: separator)));
  d.commands.clearHistory();
  return d;
}

/// [kits]' parametric system on [d], installed now and disposed at
/// tear-down. Call inside a test.
ParametricSystem installSystem(DraftDocument d, List<PlanKit> kits) {
  final system = ParametricSystem(d, catalogOf(kits))..install();
  addTearDown(system.dispose);
  return system;
}

/// A root line from [a] to [b] on layer 0, executed; its handle.
Handle addLine(DraftDocument d, Vector2 a, Vector2 b) {
  final command = addDrafted(d, EntityKind.line, linePayload(a, b),
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero);
  d.commands.execute(command);
  return command.record.handle;
}

/// The handles of the entities [owner] holds, ascending by slot.
List<Handle> leavesOf(DraftDocument d, Handle owner) => [
      for (final slot in d.entities.liveSlots)
        if (d.entities.ownerAt(slot) == owner) d.entities.handleAt(slot),
    ];

/// [leaf]'s stored coordinates.
Float64List coordsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle leaf) {
  final slot = d.entities.slotOf(leaf)!;
  return d.geometry.read(d.entities.geomIndexAt(slot)).coords;
}

/// A primary-button event at [world], for driving a tool directly.
ToolPointerEvent pointerAt(Vector2 world,
        {int buttons = kPrimaryButton,
        Offset screen = Offset.zero,
        double pickRadiusWorld = 1}) =>
    ToolPointerEvent(
        screen: screen,
        world: world,
        pointer: 1,
        buttons: buttons,
        shift: false,
        control: false,
        meta: false,
        alt: false,
        pickRadiusWorld: pickRadiusWorld);

/// [child] in a Material app of [size] logical pixels.
Future<void> pumpApp(WidgetTester tester, Widget child,
    {Size size = const Size(1440, 900)}) async {
  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(size);
  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: child)));
  await tester.pump();
}

- [ ] **Step 9: The kit set.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/kits/kit_set.dart`:

```dart
// The kit set (spec 2a P4, umbrella A3): the kits a controller loads,
// validated together. Every problem is found before one ArgumentError
// lists them all; a set that passes is held in load order.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Component;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

/// The kit ids no kit may take (spec P1): the plan library's own tools are
/// `plan.*`, and the contract's components are `jetcad.*`.
const Set<String> reservedKitIds = {'plan', 'jetcad'};

/// The kits a controller loads, validated by [validateKitSet], in load
/// order.
@immutable
final class KitSet {
  KitSet._(List<PlanKit> kits)
      : kits = List.unmodifiable(kits),
        types = List.unmodifiable([for (final k in kits) ...k.types]),
        tools = List.unmodifiable([for (final k in kits) ...k.tools]),
        _byId = {for (final k in kits) k.id: k},
        _types = {
          for (final k in kits)
            for (final t in k.types) t.id: t,
        };

  /// The kits, in load order.
  final List<PlanKit> kits;

  /// Every kit's types, kit by kit in load order.
  final List<PlanType<Component>> types;

  /// Every kit's tools, kit by kit in load order.
  final List<PlanTool> tools;

  final Map<String, PlanKit> _byId;
  final Map<String, PlanType<Component>> _types;

  /// The kit [id], or null when it is not loaded.
  PlanKit? kitOf(String id) => _byId[id];

  /// The type [typeId] of a loaded kit, or null.
  PlanType<Component>? typeOf(String typeId) => _types[typeId];
}

/// A refused kit set (spec P4): one [ArgumentError] naming every problem,
/// one line each, `  <code>: <message>`.
final class KitSetError extends ArgumentError {
  KitSetError(List<KitProblem> problems)
      : problems = List.unmodifiable(problems),
        super(_describe(problems), 'kits');

  final List<KitProblem> problems;

  static String _describe(List<KitProblem> problems) => [
        'the kit set has ${problems.length} problem(s):',
        for (final p in problems) '  $p',
      ].join('\n');
}

/// [kits] validated together (spec P4), or a [KitSetError] listing, kit by
/// kit in load order: a reserved id; a kit id an earlier kit has; the
/// kit's own `validate()` problems, each prefixed by its id; a type id an
/// earlier kit gave, and a type that both contributes and reads places;
/// a tool id an earlier kit gave. A duplicate inside one kit is that kit's
/// `validate()`'s to report. Symbol keys are not checked here: the symbol
/// loader drops a later kit's duplicate key (spec P2).
KitSet validateKitSet(List<PlanKit> kits) {
  final problems = <KitProblem>[];
  final kitIds = <String>{};
  final typeKits = <String, String>{};
  final toolKits = <String, String>{};
  for (final kit in kits) {
    if (reservedKitIds.contains(kit.id)) {
      problems.add(KitProblem(KitProblemCode.reservedKitId,
          'the kit id "${kit.id}" is reserved for the plan library'));
    }
    if (!kitIds.add(kit.id)) {
      problems.add(KitProblem(KitProblemCode.duplicateKit,
          'two kits have the id "${kit.id}"'));
    }
    for (final p in kit.validate()) {
      problems.add(KitProblem(p.code, '${kit.id}: ${p.message}'));
    }
    for (final type in kit.types) {
      final first = typeKits.putIfAbsent(type.id, () => kit.id);
      if (first != kit.id) {
        problems.add(KitProblem(
            KitProblemCode.duplicateType,
            'the type "${type.id}" of the kit "${kit.id}" is already the '
            'kit "$first"\'s'));
      }
      final parametric = type.parametric;
      if (parametric.contributesPlace && parametric.readsPlaces) {
        problems.add(KitProblem(
            KitProblemCode.typePlaceConflict,
            '${kit.id}: the type "${type.id}" both contributes places and '
            'reads them, which the engine refuses'));
      }
    }
    for (final tool in kit.tools) {
      final first = toolKits.putIfAbsent(tool.id, () => kit.id);
      if (first != kit.id) {
        problems.add(KitProblem(
            KitProblemCode.duplicateTool,
            'the tool "${tool.id}" of the kit "${kit.id}" is already the '
            'kit "$first"\'s'));
      }
    }
  }
  if (problems.isNotEmpty) throw KitSetError(problems);
  return KitSet._(kits);
}
```

### Task 7: The plan file: the manifest, load, save, versions (spec P4 "The plan file", P5 import manifest)

**Files:**
- Create: `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/file/plan_format_exception.dart`, `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/file/semver.dart`, `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/file/manifest.dart`, `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/file/plan_file.dart`
- Modify: `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart` (exports), `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/support/harness.dart` (adds `planText`)
- Test: `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/file/plan_file_test.dart`, `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/file/manifest_test.dart`, `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/file/semver_test.dart`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `KitSet`, `validateKitSet` (Task 6); `ManifestComponent` (`format`, `kits`, `fromJson`, `toJson`, `componentTypeId = 'jetcad.manifest'`), `SymbolComponent.componentTypeId = 'jetcad.symbol'`, `isKitId`, `kitOfKey`, `KitDiagnostic({required String kitId, String? subject, required KitDiagnosticCode code, required String message, Object? error})`, `KitDiagnosticCode.kitMissing`, `KitDiagnosticCode.kitNewer` (contract, Tasks 1 of sub-project 1 and Task 4); `DraftDocumentCodec.encode`, `DraftDocumentCodec.decode(..., {List<Diagnostic>? diagnostics, void Function(ComponentRegistry)? registerComponents, bool keepUnreadableComponents = false})` (engine, E4 as the Task 1 ruling made it: opt-in); the test kit API and `planDocument`, `installSystem`, `catalogOf`, `registerPlanComponents`, `addObject`, `addLine` (Task 6).
- Produces (exported from the barrel unless marked internal):
  - `enum PlanFormatCode { noManifest, formatTooNew, schema, notJson, damagedUnsavable }`.
  - `final class PlanFormatException implements FormatException` — `const PlanFormatException(PlanFormatCode code, String message)`; `code`, `message`, `source` (null), `offset` (null); `toString()` = `PlanFormatException(<code>): <message>`.
  - `const int kPlanFormat = 1`.
  - `final class PlanManifest` — `const PlanManifest({int format = 1, Map<String, String> kits = const {}})`; `format`, `kits`; value equality.
  - `PlanManifest? manifestOf(DraftDocument d)` — the root's `jetcad.manifest` as read, or null.
  - `Set<String> usedKits(DraftDocument d)` — sorted kit ids of component type ids and symbol keys, `jetcad` and non-kit prefixes excluded.
  - `PlanManifest manifestToWrite(PlanManifest? read, Set<String> used, KitSet loaded)`.
  - `final class ManifestCheck` — `Set<String> missing`, `List<KitDiagnostic> diagnostics`; `ManifestCheck checkManifest(PlanManifest manifest, Set<String> used, KitSet loaded)`.
  - `DraftDocument decodePlan(String text, {required void Function(ComponentRegistry) register, required List<Diagnostic> diagnostics, TextMeasurer measurer = const InsertionPointMeasurer(), DraftPermissions permissions = DraftPermissions.all})`.
  - `String encodePlan(DraftDocument d, KitSet loaded)`.
  - `String ensureManifest(String text)`.
  - `final class SemVer implements Comparable<SemVer>` (`major`, `minor`, `patch`, `pre`; `static SemVer? tryParse(String)`) and `bool? isNewerVersion(String plan, String loaded)` — **internal** (not exported; the tests import `package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/file/semver.dart`).
  - harness: `String planText(List<PlanKit> kits, void Function(DraftDocument d) build, {DecimalSeparator separator = DecimalSeparator.point})`.

Plan decision: `decodePlan` checks the manifest on the **raw JSON**, before the engine decodes anything, so a format-2 plan is refused as `formatTooNew` even when this build could not read its components. The check reads `components['jetcad.manifest']['<root handle>']` and runs `ManifestComponent.fromJson` on it; a manifest that does not read (a format that is not an int, a kit id that is not one, an empty version) is `schema`. Order: `notJson` (not JSON, or not an object), `noManifest`, `schema` (a manifest that does not read), `formatTooNew`, then the engine's decode, any of whose errors is `schema`.
Plan decision: `decodePlan` passes `keepUnreadableComponents: true` and its `diagnostics` list to the codec (the Task 1 ruling): a component whose factory throws is kept raw with a `component.unreadable` diagnostic naming its handle, and the plan opens. Task 11 turns those diagnostics into `componentUnreadable` and locks and freezes the handles.
Plan decision: saving never mutates the document. `encodePlan` encodes the document, then replaces the root's entry of `jetcad.manifest` in the encoded `components` map and re-sorts that map's type ids (and the manifest's handles) as `ComponentRegistry.toJson` sorts them (`component.dart:254-286`), so `encodePlan(decodePlan(x)) == x` for every `x` it wrote. The manifest in memory stays the one read, so a missing kit's entry is still the one read at the next save.
Plan decision: the manifest written is, for every kit that is used or listed in the manifest read: a loaded kit's version when it is used (a loaded kit no longer used is dropped); a kit that is not loaded keeps its entry as read, used or not (its objects are locked, Task 10, so they cannot have gone). A used kit neither loaded nor listed gets no entry: there is no version to write.
Plan decision: "used" is read from the encoded `components` map: a type id `<kit>.<...>` whose `<kit>` is a kit id other than `jetcad` (so the engine's `jet_cad.object_layer` and `jetcad.page`, and today's `floor_planner.*`, are not kits), and the `key` of every `jetcad.symbol` payload. Raw (unknown or unreadable) components count, by their type id.
Plan decision: `checkManifest` visits the union of the manifest's kits and the used kits, sorted by id: a kit not loaded is missing (`kitMissing`); a loaded kit whose saved version is newer than the loaded one by semver precedence warns (`kitNewer`); a version that does not parse is not compared (no diagnostic, never a refusal).
Plan decision: `ensureManifest` returns the very string it was given when the plan already carries a manifest on its root, and when the text is JSON but no plan (no `root` int, no `components` map: `decodePlan` refuses it with its own code); otherwise it adds `{"format": 1, "kits": {}}` on the root and re-encodes.

```dart
/// A saved plan over [kits]: [planDocument] with the kits' system
/// installed, [build] run on it, then [encodePlan] (a manifest of the
/// loaded kits the plan uses).
String planText(List<PlanKit> kits, void Function(DraftDocument d) build,
    {DecimalSeparator separator = DecimalSeparator.point}) {
  final d = planDocument(kits, separator: separator);
  final system = ParametricSystem(d, catalogOf(kits))..install();
  try {
    build(d);
  } finally {
    system.dispose();
  }
  return encodePlan(d, validateKitSet(kits));
}

```dart
// Spec 2a P4 "Versions (R6)": kit versions are semantic versions compared
// by precedence; one that does not parse is not compared.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/file/semver.dart';

void main() {
  test('PF-7 precedence, semver 2.0.0 section 11; build metadata ignored', () {
    const ordered = [
      '0.9.9',
      '1.0.0-alpha',
      '1.0.0-alpha.1',
      '1.0.0-alpha.beta',
      '1.0.0-beta',
      '1.0.0-beta.2',
      '1.0.0-beta.11',
      '1.0.0-rc.1',
      '1.0.0',
      '1.0.1',
      '1.2.0',
      '1.10.0',
      '2.0.0',
    ];
    for (var i = 0; i < ordered.length; i++) {
      for (var j = 0; j < ordered.length; j++) {
        final a = SemVer.tryParse(ordered[i])!, b = SemVer.tryParse(ordered[j])!;
        // M-PF-7a: pre-release identifiers compared as text ('11' < '2').
        // M-PF-7b: a pre-release ranked above its release.
        // M-PF-7c: minor compared as text ('10' < '2').
        expect(a.compareTo(b).sign, i.compareTo(j).sign,
            reason: '${ordered[i]} vs ${ordered[j]}');
      }
    }
    expect(SemVer.tryParse('1.2.3+build.7')!.compareTo(SemVer.tryParse('1.2.3')!),
        0);
  });

  test('PF-7u what does not parse is null, and is never compared', () {
    for (final text in ['', '1', '1.2', '1.2.x', '01.2.3', '1.2.3-', 'v1.2.3',
        '1.2.3-01', '99999999999999999999.0.0']) {
      // M-PF-7u: tryParse on the major.minor.patch prefix only.
      expect(SemVer.tryParse(text), isNull, reason: text);
    }
    expect(isNewerVersion('1.x', '1.0.0'), isNull);
    expect(isNewerVersion('2.0.0', 'dev'), isNull);
    expect(isNewerVersion('1.2.1', '1.2.0'), isTrue);
    expect(isNewerVersion('1.2.0', '1.2.0'), isFalse);
    expect(isNewerVersion('1.2.0', '1.2.0-rc.1'), isTrue);
  });
}

// Spec 2a P4 "The plan file": which kits a plan uses, the manifest a save
// writes, and what a load reports against the loaded kits.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/harness.dart';
import '../support/test_kit.dart';

void main() {
  test('PF-3 used kits: component type ids and symbol keys under a kit id',
      () {
    final kits = [testKit(), discKit()];
    final d = planDocument(kits);
    installSystem(d, kits);
    addObject<SlabComponent>(
        d, SlabComponent(width: 1800, height: 900, angle: 0.4),
        at: Vector2(2350, -1180));
    addObject<DiscComponent>(d, DiscComponent(radius: 650),
        at: Vector2(-3100, 2240));
    final symbolHolder = d.handleSeed.next();
    d.commands.execute(CompoundCommand([
      AddNodeCommand(GroupNode(
          handle: symbolHolder,
          parent: d.rootHandle,
          transform: Transform2.translation(4100, -900),
          children: const [])),
      SetComponentCommand<SymbolComponent>(
          symbolHolder,
          SymbolComponent(
              key: 'cafe.table.round',
              version: 2,
              name: 'Round table',
              category: 'Tables',
              tags: const ['table'])),
    ]));
    // Premise: the page and the objects' layers are there, and are no kit.
    expect(d.components.get<PageComponent>(d.rootHandle), isNotNull);
    // M-PF-3a: symbol keys not read. M-PF-3b: 'jetcad' not excluded.
    expect(usedKits(d), {'cafe', 'disc', 'test'});
    expect(usedKits(d).toList(), ['cafe', 'disc', 'test'], reason: 'sorted');
  });

  test('PF-4 a missing kit keeps the entry read; a loaded used kit is written',
      () {
    final loaded = validateKitSet([testKit(), discKit()]);
    final written = manifestToWrite(
        const PlanManifest(kits: {'gone': '2.0.0', 'test': '0.9.0', 'old': '1.0.0'}),
        {'test', 'gone'},
        loaded);
    // M-PF-4: a kit that is not loaded drops its entry.
    expect(written,
        const PlanManifest(kits: {'gone': '2.0.0', 'old': '1.0.0', 'test': '1.2.0'}));
  });

  test('PF-5 a loaded kit the plan no longer uses is dropped', () {
    final loaded = validateKitSet([testKit(), discKit()]);
    // M-PF-5: every loaded kit read is written, used or not.
    expect(
        manifestToWrite(const PlanManifest(kits: {'disc': '0.4.0', 'test': '1.0.0'}),
            {'test'}, loaded),
        const PlanManifest(kits: {'test': '1.2.0'}));
    expect(manifestToWrite(null, {'disc', 'lost'}, loaded),
        const PlanManifest(kits: {'disc': '0.4.0'}),
        reason: 'a used kit neither loaded nor read has no version to write');
  });

  test('PF-8 missing kits, a newer kit warns, an unparsed version never does',
      () {
    final loaded =
        validateKitSet([testKit(version: '1.2.0'), discKit(version: '0.4.0')]);
    final check = checkManifest(
        const PlanManifest(
            kits: {'gone': '1.0.0', 'test': '2.0.0', 'disc': '0.4.0'}),
        {'test', 'disc', 'lost'},
        loaded);
    // M-PF-8b: only the manifest's kits visited ('lost' is used, not listed).
    expect(check.missing, {'gone', 'lost'});
    expect([for (final d in check.diagnostics) (d.kitId, d.code)], [
      ('gone', KitDiagnosticCode.kitMissing),
      ('lost', KitDiagnosticCode.kitMissing),
      ('test', KitDiagnosticCode.kitNewer),
    ]);
    expect(check.diagnostics.last.message, allOf(contains('2.0.0'), contains('1.2.0')));

    // M-PF-8a: a version that does not parse taken as newer.
    for (final (saved, have) in [('1.x', '1.2.0'), ('9.0.0', 'dev'), ('0.9.0', '1.2.0')]) {
      final quiet = checkManifest(PlanManifest(kits: {'test': saved}), const {},
          validateKitSet([testKit(version: have)]));
      expect(quiet.diagnostics, isEmpty, reason: '$saved over $have');
      expect(quiet.missing, isEmpty);
    }
    final pre = checkManifest(const PlanManifest(kits: {'test': '1.2.0'}),
        const {}, validateKitSet([testKit(version: '1.2.0-rc.1')]));
    expect([for (final d in pre.diagnostics) d.code], [KitDiagnosticCode.kitNewer]);
  });
}

```dart
// Spec 2a P4 "The plan file", P5 "Imported text without a manifest": a
// load refuses by code and changes nothing; a save writes the manifest and
// is byte-stable; a component this build cannot read is kept raw; an
// import gets an empty manifest.
import 'dart:convert';

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/harness.dart';
import '../support/test_kit.dart';

/// The fixture: a turned slab off the origin, a disc, a line.
String fixture() => planText([testKit(), discKit()], (d) {
      addObject<SlabComponent>(
          d,
          SlabComponent(
              width: 1800, height: 900, angle: 0.4, finish: 'tiled', swatch: 'red'),
          at: Vector2(2350, -1180));
      addObject<DiscComponent>(d, DiscComponent(radius: 650),
          at: Vector2(-3100, 2240));
      addLine(d, Vector2(-500, 700), Vector2(1800, 2400));
    });

DraftDocument decode(String text,
    {List<PlanKit>? kits, List<Diagnostic>? diagnostics}) {
  final catalog = catalogOf(kits ?? [testKit(), discKit()]);
  return decodePlan(text,
      register: (r) => registerPlanComponents(r, catalog),
      diagnostics: diagnostics ?? <Diagnostic>[]);
}

Map<String, Object?> jsonOf(String text) =>
    (jsonDecode(text) as Map<String, Object?>);

Map<String, Object?> componentsOf(Map<String, Object?> json) =>
    json['components']! as Map<String, Object?>;

String rootKey(Map<String, Object?> json) => '${json['root']}';

Matcher refusedWith(PlanFormatCode code) => throwsA(allOf(
    isA<FormatException>(),
    isA<PlanFormatException>().having((e) => e.code, 'code', code)));

void main() {
  test('PF-1 each refusal has its code, and is a FormatException', () {
    final good = jsonOf(fixture());
    String withManifest(Object? manifest) {
      final json = jsonOf(fixture());
      final byHandle = componentsOf(json)['jetcad.manifest']! as Map<String, Object?>;
      byHandle[rootKey(json)] = manifest;
      return jsonEncode(json);
    }

    final noManifest = jsonOf(fixture());
    componentsOf(noManifest).remove('jetcad.manifest');
    final cases = <String, PlanFormatCode>{
      'not json': PlanFormatCode.notJson,
      '[1, 2]': PlanFormatCode.notJson,
      '{}': PlanFormatCode.noManifest,
      jsonEncode(noManifest): PlanFormatCode.noManifest,
      withManifest({'format': 2, 'kits': <String, Object?>{}}):
          PlanFormatCode.formatTooNew,
      withManifest({'format': '1', 'kits': <String, Object?>{}}):
          PlanFormatCode.schema,
      withManifest({
        'format': 1,
        'kits': {'Bad': '1.0.0'},
      }): PlanFormatCode.schema,
      jsonEncode({...good, 'schemaVersion': 9999}): PlanFormatCode.schema,
      jsonEncode({...good, 'entities': 7}): PlanFormatCode.schema,
    };
    // M-PF-1a: no manifest check. M-PF-1b: `format > kPlanFormat + 1`.
    // M-PF-1c: the engine's errors rethrown as they are, not as schema.
    for (final MapEntry(key: text, value: code) in cases.entries) {
      expect(() => decode(text), refusedWith(code), reason: text);
    }
    expect('${const PlanFormatException(PlanFormatCode.noManifest, 'none')}',
        'PlanFormatException(noManifest): none');
  });

  test('PF-unreadable a component whose factory throws is kept raw: the plan '
      'opens, the diagnostic names it, and a save writes it byte for byte',
      () {
    final json = jsonOf(fixture());
    final slabs = componentsOf(json)[slabTypeId]! as Map<String, Object?>;
    final key = slabs.keys.single;
    (slabs[key]! as Map<String, Object?>)['width'] = 'wide';
    final broken = jsonEncode(json);
    final diagnostics = <Diagnostic>[];
    // M-PF-unreadable: `keepUnreadableComponents: true` removed from
    // decodePlan's codec call: the load is refused as schema.
    final d = decode(broken, diagnostics: diagnostics);
    final h = Handle.checked(int.parse(key));
    expect(d.components.get<SlabComponent>(h), isNull);
    expect(d.components.unknownOf(h), hasLength(1));
    expect(
        diagnostics.where((x) => x.code == 'component.unreadable').single.handles,
        [h]);
    final saved = componentsOf(jsonOf(encodePlan(d, validateKitSet([testKit(), discKit()]))));
    expect(jsonEncode(saved[slabTypeId]), jsonEncode(slabs));
  });

  test('PF-6 a save is byte-stable: encode(decode(x)) == x, twice', () {
    final x = planText([testKit(), discKit()], (d) {
      addObject<SlabComponent>(d, SlabComponent(width: 1800, height: 900, angle: 0.4),
          at: Vector2(2350, -1180));
      addObject<DiscComponent>(d, DiscComponent(radius: 650),
          at: Vector2(-3100, 2240));
      d.components.attachUnknown(d.rootHandle, {'typeId': 'gone.widget', 'size': 3});
    });
    final loaded = validateKitSet([testKit(), discKit()]);
    final types = componentsOf(jsonOf(x)).keys.toList();
    // M-PF-6: the components map not re-sorted after the manifest is put in.
    expect(types, [...types]..sort(), reason: 'premise: the canonical order');
    final y = encodePlan(decode(x), loaded);
    expect(y, x);
    expect(encodePlan(decode(y), loaded), x);
  });

  test("PF-9 a missing kit's entry and objects round-trip through a save", () {
    final json = jsonOf(fixture());
    componentsOf(json)['gone.widget'] = {
      rootKey(json): {'b': 2, 'a': 1},
    };
    final manifest = componentsOf(json)['jetcad.manifest']! as Map<String, Object?>;
    manifest[rootKey(json)] = {
      'format': 1,
      'kits': {'disc': '0.4.0', 'gone': '3.1.0', 'test': '9.0.0'},
    };
    final saved = jsonOf(encodePlan(decode(jsonEncode(json)),
        validateKitSet([testKit(version: '1.2.0'), discKit()])));
    expect(
        (componentsOf(saved)['jetcad.manifest']! as Map<String, Object?>)[rootKey(saved)],
        {
          'format': 1,
          'kits': {'disc': '0.4.0', 'gone': '3.1.0', 'test': '1.2.0'},
        });
    expect(jsonEncode(componentsOf(saved)['gone.widget']),
        jsonEncode({rootKey(json): {'b': 2, 'a': 1}}));
  });

  test('PF-10 an import without a manifest gets an empty one and opens as '
      'plain geometry; one with a manifest is returned as it is', () {
    final kits = [testKit()];
    final drawing = planDocument(kits);
    final line = addLine(drawing, Vector2(-500, 700), Vector2(1800, 2400));
    final imported = DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(drawing);
    expect(() => decode(imported), refusedWith(PlanFormatCode.noManifest),
        reason: 'premise: without the manifest the load refuses');
    // M-PF-10a: ensureManifest returns its text unchanged.
    final d = decode(ensureManifest(imported), kits: kits);
    expect(manifestOf(d), const PlanManifest());
    expect(usedKits(d), isEmpty);
    expect(d.entities.containsHandle(line), isTrue);

    final plan = fixture();
    // M-PF-10b: ensureManifest always re-encodes.
    expect(ensureManifest(plan), same(plan));
    expect(() => ensureManifest('not json'), refusedWith(PlanFormatCode.notJson));
  });
}

// A plan the library refuses to open or save (spec 2a P4): a
// FormatException, as today's load throws (floor_plan_controller.dart:
// 1192-1203), with a code a host can test.

/// Why a plan was refused.
enum PlanFormatCode {
  /// The plan carries no `jetcad.manifest` on its root.
  noManifest,

  /// The manifest's format is above the one this library writes.
  formatTooNew,

  /// The engine's schema check refused it, or its manifest does not read.
  schema,

  /// The text is not a JSON object.
  notJson,

  /// A damaged plan whose encoding does not decode again (Task 11).
  damagedUnsavable,
}

/// A refused plan. A [FormatException], so a host that catches today's
/// keeps working.
final class PlanFormatException implements FormatException {
  const PlanFormatException(this.code, this.message);

  final PlanFormatCode code;

  @override
  final String message;

  /// Not kept: a plan's text can be megabytes.
  @override
  Object? get source => null;

  @override
  int? get offset => null;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanFormatException(${code.name}): $message';
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Versions.** Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/lib/src/file/semver.dart`:

```dart
// Kit versions in a plan's manifest (spec 2a P4 "Versions", contract R6):
// semantic versions 2.0.0, compared by precedence. A version that does not
// parse is not compared, and never refuses a load.
import 'dart:math' as math;

import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

final RegExp _semver = RegExp(r'^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)'
    r'(?:-((?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*)'
    r'(?:\.(?:0|[1-9]\d*|\d*[a-zA-Z-][0-9a-zA-Z-]*))*))?'
    r'(?:\+([0-9a-zA-Z-]+(?:\.[0-9a-zA-Z-]+)*))?$');

final RegExp _numeric = RegExp(r'^\d+$');

@immutable
final class SemVer implements Comparable<SemVer> {
  const SemVer._(this.major, this.minor, this.patch, this.pre);

  final int major, minor, patch;

  /// The pre-release identifiers; empty for a release. Build metadata is
  /// not kept: it takes no part in precedence.
  final List<String> pre;

  /// [text] as a semantic version, or null when it is not one (or a part
  /// overflows an int).
  static SemVer? tryParse(String text) {
    final m = _semver.firstMatch(text);
    if (m == null) return null;
    final major = int.tryParse(m[1]!);
    final minor = int.tryParse(m[2]!);
    final patch = int.tryParse(m[3]!);
    if (major == null || minor == null || patch == null) return null;
    final pre = m[4];
    return SemVer._(major, minor, patch,
        pre == null ? const [] : List.unmodifiable(pre.split('.')));
  }

  @override
  int compareTo(SemVer other) {
    if (major != other.major) return major.compareTo(other.major);
    if (minor != other.minor) return minor.compareTo(other.minor);
    if (patch != other.patch) return patch.compareTo(other.patch);
    if (pre.isEmpty || other.pre.isEmpty) {
      // A release ranks above its pre-releases.
      return (other.pre.isEmpty ? 0 : 1) - (pre.isEmpty ? 0 : 1);
    }
    for (var i = 0; i < math.min(pre.length, other.pre.length); i++) {
      final c = _compareIdentifier(pre[i], other.pre[i]);
      if (c != 0) return c;
    }
    return pre.length.compareTo(other.pre.length);
  }

  /// Numeric identifiers numerically (no leading zero: the longer is the
  /// larger, so no int can overflow), below alphanumeric ones, which
  /// compare in ASCII order.
  static int _compareIdentifier(String a, String b) {
    final an = _numeric.hasMatch(a), bn = _numeric.hasMatch(b);
    if (an && bn) {
      return a.length != b.length ? a.length.compareTo(b.length) : a.compareTo(b);
    }
    if (an != bn) return an ? -1 : 1;
    return a.compareTo(b);
  }

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) => other is SemVer && compareTo(other) == 0;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(major, minor, patch, Object.hashAll(pre));
}

/// Whether [plan] is newer than [loaded] by precedence; null when either
/// does not parse.
bool? isNewerVersion(String plan, String loaded) {
  final a = SemVer.tryParse(plan), b = SemVer.tryParse(loaded);
  if (a == null || b == null) return null;
  return a.compareTo(b) > 0;
}
```
