```dart
}

/// A grip provider that gives every group one grip and moves it anywhere.
final class _AllGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  int calls = 0;
  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    calls++;
    return const [Grip(GripRole.stretch, 0, 7010, 3020)];
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    calls++;
    return TransformNodeCommand(group, Transform2.translation(world.x, world.y));
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    calls++;
    return [(EntityKind.line, linePayload(Vector2.zero(), world))];
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    calls++;
    return true;
  }
}

    final plan = boxPlan();

    final drawn = coordsOf(source.document, plan.square);

    expect(b.locked.value, {plan.square, plan.lamp.instance});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: The lock.** Create `lib/src/kits/locks.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P4 "Locks: a missing kit, a broken object" (umbrella A9). A locked
// object draws as saved and can be selected as a whole; it loses every
// change. Two layers: up front (no grips, the gates shut, no delete, no
// panel section) and on commit, where the lock is an expander stacked after
// the parametric system's (as jet_cad_floor_plan's TableLabelSystem
// stacks): it applies the command, checks every touched handle and its
// containers, and on a hit applies the inverse and throws [PlanLocked].
// A command names no handles before it applies (command.dart:122-137), so
// a check before apply cannot work.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// The refusal of a command that would change a locked object. A refusal,
/// not a kit diagnostic: the canvas shows a short hint.
final class PlanLocked implements Exception {
  const PlanLocked();

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanLocked: the edit would change a locked object';
}

/// The locked objects of one document, and what they contain.
final class LockSet {
  LockSet._(this._missing, this._definitions, CommandTarget target) {
    _refresh(target);
  }

  /// Scans [document] once (spec P4 "Which objects are locked"):
  /// - a node other than the root that carries an unknown component whose
  ///   type id is kit-namespaced (a kit id, then a dot; not `jetcad`, not
  ///   `plan`), whatever [loaded] says: no loaded code knows the type;
  /// - a definition whose [SymbolComponent] key's kit is not [loaded], or
  ///   that carries such an unknown component, and every instance of it.
  factory LockSet.scan(
      DraftDocument document, bool Function(String kitId) loaded) {
    bool unknown(Handle h) {
      final kit = _unknownKit(document, h);
      return kit != null && _locksUnknown(kit, loaded);
    }

    final definitions = <Handle>{};
    for (final def in document.tree.definitions) {
      final symbol = document.components.get<SymbolComponent>(def.handle);
      if (unknown(def.handle) ||
          (symbol != null && !loaded(kitOfKey(symbol.key)))) {
        definitions.add(def.handle);
      }
    }
    final missing = <Handle>{};
    for (final node in document.tree.nodes) {
      if (node.handle == document.rootHandle) continue;
      if (unknown(node.handle) ||
          (node is InstanceNode && definitions.contains(node.definition))) {
        missing.add(node.handle);
      }
    }
    return LockSet._(missing, definitions, document);
  }

  /// The kit id of an unknown, kit-namespaced component on [h] (a kit id,
  /// then a dot; not `jetcad`, not `plan`), or null.
  static String? _unknownKit(DraftDocument d, Handle h) {
    for (final payload in d.components.unknownOf(h)) {
      final typeId = payload['typeId'];
      if (typeId is! String) continue;
      final dot = typeId.indexOf('.');
      if (dot <= 0) continue;
      final kit = typeId.substring(0, dot);
      if (isKitId(kit) && kit != 'jetcad' && kit != 'plan') return kit;
    }
    return null;
  }

  /// Whether an unknown component of [kit] locks its holder: always (plan
  /// decision), whether or not [kit] is loaded, since no loaded code knows
  /// the type.
  static bool _locksUnknown(String kit, bool Function(String) loaded) => true;

  /// Past this many containers a chain is taken as no lock's (the tree
  /// refuses cycles; this only bounds a malformed one).
  static const int _maxDepth = 4096;

  final Set<Handle> _missing;
  final Set<Handle> _definitions;
  final Set<Handle> _broken = {};

  /// [_missing], [_broken] and [_definitions]: the containers a lock
  /// starts from.
  final Set<Handle> _roots = {};

  /// Every node and entity under a root when the set last changed.
  final Set<Handle> _closure = {};

  /// The locked objects: a missing kit's, an unknown type's, a broken one's.
  /// The guarded definitions are not listed.
  Set<Handle> get objects => Set.unmodifiable({..._missing, ..._broken});

  bool get isEmpty => _roots.isEmpty;

  /// Whether [h] itself is a locked object.
  bool isLockedObject(Handle h) => _missing.contains(h) || _broken.contains(h);

  /// Whether [h] is locked: a locked object or guarded definition, inside
  /// one now (its containers, walked in [target]), or inside one when the
  /// set last changed (a handle a command just removed has no container
  /// left to walk).
  bool covers(CommandTarget target, Handle h) =>
      _closure.contains(h) || _walk(target, h);

  /// Adds [objects], broken (Task 11), and refreshes what they contain.
  void addBroken(CommandTarget target, Iterable<Handle> objects) {
    _broken.addAll(objects);
    _refresh(target);
  }

  void _refresh(CommandTarget t) {
    _roots
      ..clear()
      ..addAll(_missing)
      ..addAll(_broken)
      ..addAll(_definitions);
    _closure.clear();
    if (_roots.isEmpty) return;
    for (final node in t.tree.nodes) {
      if (_walk(t, node.handle)) _closure.add(node.handle);
    }
    for (final slot in t.entities.liveSlots) {
      final h = t.entities.handleAt(slot);
      if (_walk(t, h)) _closure.add(h);
    }
  }

  /// [start] or one of its containers (an entity's owner, a node's parent,
  /// up to the root or a definition) is a root.
  bool _walk(CommandTarget t, Handle start) {
    if (_roots.isEmpty) return false;
    var current = start;
    for (var depth = 0; depth < _maxDepth; depth++) {
      if (_roots.contains(current)) return true;
      final slot = t.entities.slotOf(current);
      final Handle up;
      if (slot != null) {
        up = t.entities.ownerAt(slot);
      } else {
        final node = t.tree[current];
        if (node == null) return false;
        up = node.parent;
      }
      if (up.isNone || up == current) return false;
      current = up;
    }
    return false;
  }
}

/// Stacks on the dispatcher's one expander slot (spec 06 D2), after the
/// parametric system: [install] keeps the expander it found and wraps what
/// that one returns; [dispose] puts it back. **Last in, first out**: the
/// controller installs this after `ParametricSystem.install` and disposes
/// it before `ParametricSystem.dispose`; [dispose] asserts that the slot
/// still holds its own.
final class LockExpander {
  LockExpander(this.document, this.locks);

  final DraftDocument document;
  final LockSet locks;
  DraftCommand Function(DraftCommand command)? _previous;
  bool _installed = false;

  void install() {
    if (_installed) throw StateError('the lock expander is installed already');
    _previous = document.commands.expander;
    document.commands.expander = _expand;
    _installed = true;
  }

  /// Puts the expander [install] found back, only if the slot still holds
  /// this one's own tear-off.
  void dispose() {
    if (!_installed) return;
    _installed = false;
    final mine = document.commands.expander == _expand;
    if (mine) document.commands.expander = _previous;
    _previous = null;
    assert(mine, 'LockExpander disposed out of order (spec P4)');
  }

  /// The previous expander's command for [command], or [command].
  DraftCommand expandInner(DraftCommand command) =>
      _previous?.call(command) ?? command;

  DraftCommand _expand(DraftCommand command) {
    final inner = expandInner(command);
    if (locks.isEmpty) return inner;
    return _LockCheck(this, command, inner);
  }
}

/// One edit and its lock check: [_applied] applies, then each touched
/// handle is tested; a hit undoes the edit and throws [PlanLocked]. Created
/// by [LockExpander], once per `execute`.
final class _LockCheck extends DraftCommand {
  _LockCheck(this._expander, this.original, this._applied);

  final LockExpander _expander;

  /// The command the caller executed, before any expansion.
  final DraftCommand original;

  /// The expanded command this check applies.
  DraftCommand _applied;

  @override
  String get label => _applied.label;

  @override
  Set<Capability> get capabilities => _applied.capabilities;

  /// Read by the dispatcher after [apply]: the applied command's own.
  @override
  Capability get capability => _applied.capability;

  @override
  CommandResult apply(CommandTarget target) =>
      _check(target, _applied.apply(target));

  CommandResult _check(CommandTarget target, CommandResult result) {
    final locks = _expander.locks;
    for (final h in result.touched) {
      if (!locks.covers(target, h)) continue;
      try {
        result.inverse.apply(target);
      } catch (rollbackError) {
        throw PartialMutationError('"$label": it touched a locked object, '
            'and undoing it then threw ($rollbackError); the target is '
            'partially mutated and nothing was recorded in history');
      }
      throw const PlanLocked();
    }
    return result;
  }
}

/// The grip provider a lock leaves: a covered group has no grips, no drag,
/// no preview and does not move; anything else is [inner]'s (no grips and
/// movable with no inner, as with no provider, `grip_cache.dart:61-66`).
final class LockedGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  LockedGrips(this._locks, this._inner);

  final LockSet _locks;
  final ObjectGripProvider? _inner;

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    if (_locks.covers(d, group)) return const [];
    return _inner?.gripsOf(d, group) ?? const [];
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    if (_locks.covers(d, group)) return null;
    return _inner?.drag(d, group, grip, world);
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    if (_locks.covers(d, group)) return const [];
    return _inner?.preview(d, group, grip, world) ?? const [];
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    if (_locks.covers(d, group)) return false;
    return _inner?.movable(d, group) ?? true;
  }
}

/// The select gates a lock shuts (spec P4 "Up front"): move, rotate,
/// reshape and delete refuse while a selected key's target, or a handle of
/// its chain, is in [locked]; a locked object stays selectable. The answer
/// is a cached `bool`, recomputed when the selection or the locked set
/// notifies, so the getters allocate nothing (`select_gates.dart:14-21`).
/// Task 12's `PlanSelectGates` extends it with the permissions (one lock
/// rule, not two).
base class LockGates extends SelectGates {
  LockGates({
    required SelectionController selection,
    required ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> locked,
  })  : _selection = selection,
        _locked = locked {
    _selection.addListener(_recompute);
    _locked.addListener(_recompute);
    _recompute();
  }

  final SelectionController _selection;
  final ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> _locked;
  bool _selectionLocked = false;

  /// Whether a selected key's target, or a handle of its chain, is locked.
  bool get selectionLocked => _selectionLocked;

  void _recompute() {
    final locked = _locked.value;
    var hit = false;
    if (locked.isNotEmpty) {
      for (final key in _selection.keys) {
        if (locked.contains(key.target)) {
          hit = true;
          break;
        }
        final chain = key.chain;
        for (var i = 0; i < chain.length && !hit; i++) {
          hit = locked.contains(Handle(chain[i]));
        }
        if (hit) break;
      }
    }
    _selectionLocked = hit;
  }

  @override
  bool get move => !_selectionLocked;

  @override
  bool get rotate => !_selectionLocked;

  @override
  bool get reshape => !_selectionLocked;

  @override
  bool get delete => !_selectionLocked;

  void dispose() {
    _selection.removeListener(_recompute);
    _locked.removeListener(_recompute);
  }
}
```

- [ ] **Step 5: Wire it into the session and the controller.** The lock set, the expander and the gates are per-document: they live in Task 8's `DocumentSession` (`lib/src/controller/session.dart`), are built in its constructor and disposed by it (Shared interfaces). Only the `locked` notifier is the controller's.
  1. In `lib/src/controller/session.dart`, import `package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable` and `'../kits/locks.dart'`. The constructor gains two named parameters, and its body becomes, in this order (the lock set is scanned first because it only reads the document and the grip cache needs it; the system still installs last and the expander stacks after it, spec P2 "It owns"):

```dart
  DocumentSession(
      {required this.document,
      required this.measurer,
      required ParametricCatalog catalog,
      required CameraController camera,
      required SnapSettings snap,
      required bool Function(String kitId) kitLoaded,
      required ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> locked})
      : page = PageNotifier(document),
        index = SpatialIndex(document),
        dispatch = GripDispatch(catalog) {
    locks = LockSet.scan(document, kitLoaded);
    // planner_shell.dart:625-671, the order load-bearing: the selection
    // prunes a dead key before the outline cache walks it; the gates
    // listen to the selection before the outline and grip caches do; the
    // grip cache rebuilds after the outlines.
    selection = SelectionController(document);
    lockGates = LockGates(selection: selection, locked: locked);
    outlines = OutlineCache(document, selection);
    grips = GripCache(document, selection, outlines,
        objects: LockedGrips(locks, dispatch), gates: lockGates);
    toolContext = ToolContext(
        document: document,
        index: index,
        camera: camera,
        selection: selection,
        page: page,
        snap: snap,
        grips: grips);
    select = SelectTool(gates: lockGates);
    tools = ToolController(initial: select, context: toolContext);
    _entries.add((id: planSelectToolId, tool: select, kit: false));
    // :1050-1057: the document arrives built; the system installs last,
    // and the lock expander stacks after it.
    parametric = ParametricSystem(document, catalog, isFrozen: frozen.contains)
      ..install();
    lockExpander = LockExpander(document, locks)..install();
  }
```

```dart
  /// The locked objects of the current document (spec P4).
  final ValueNotifier<Set<Handle>> _locked = ValueNotifier(const {});

  /// The locked objects: a missing kit's, an unknown type's, a broken
  /// one's. Never the root.
  ValueListenable<Set<Handle>> get locked => _locked;

  /// Whether [handle] is locked: a locked object, inside one, or inside a
  /// locked symbol's definition. The property panel shows no section for
  /// it; the pickers refuse it.
  bool isLocked(Handle handle) => _session.locks.covers(document, handle);

  /// Locks [objects] in the middle of a session (spec P4: a type's code
  /// failed, Task 11): adds them to the lock set, clears the undo history
  /// so no earlier edit can be undone onto them, and tells the listeners.
  @internal
  void lockBroken(Set<Handle> objects) {
    if (objects.isEmpty) return;
    _session.locks.addBroken(document, objects);
    document.commands.clearHistory();
    _locked.value = _session.locks.objects;
    // clearHistory emits no change: refresh the undo listenables here.
    _refreshFlags();
    grips.gatesChanged();
    notifyListeners();
  }
```

  (`_refreshFlags()` is Task 8's: it sets `dirty`, `canUndo` and `canRedo` from `document.commands`.)
  3. In the controller's `dispose`, after the last session is disposed: `_locked.dispose();`.

  - On `LockExpander` (Task 10's): `bool Function(KitHookFailure)? onHookFailure`, `void Function(PartialMutationError)? onPartialMutation`.

Plan decision (where the retry lives): a tool commits through `ToolContext.execute`, which calls `document.commands.execute` directly (`tool.dart:109`), and a host may do the same; so the controller cannot see every command. The one place every `execute` passes is the expander slot, and Task 10's lock wrapper already holds it. So the wrapper catches a `KitHookFailure` from the parametric edit it applies, asks the failure boundary to recover (diagnostic, probe that type's objects with `ParametricSystem.probe`, freeze and lock every one that fails, which clears the history), and, when something was frozen, re-expands the **original** command through the parametric expander (a `ParametricEdit` applies once, `parametric_system.dart:733-736`) and applies it once more, inside the same `execute`: one undo step, recorded after `apply` returns (`undo.dart:195-196`). A second failure propagates: the command is refused. When the probe froze nothing, the retry would repeat the same failure, so it is skipped. The engine has rolled the failed edit back before rethrowing (`regeneration.dart:1011-1014`, `:1033-1045`), so the probe and the retry start from the state before the edit.

Plan decision (the load-time check): after a load, the boundary runs `ParametricSystem.drift()` once (the engine's guarded dry run over every live object: `reach`, `references`, the plan, `dissolves` and `generate`; it mutates nothing, `parametric_system.dart:577-610`); only when it throws a `KitHookFailure` does it probe that type's objects one by one, freeze the failing ones, and run `drift()` again. Each round freezes at least one object or stops, so it ends; a healthy plan pays one dry run (probing every object would be O(n²): each probe surveys).

Plan decision (`DanglingReferenceError`): E2 refuses an edit of a `cascade` referrer of a frozen object with `DanglingReferenceError`. It is a refusal, not a kit failure: `GuardedTool` treats it like `PlanLocked` (the hint, the gesture cancelled, no diagnostic), and `execute` catches it and answers false (controller ruling R-b).

Plan decision (generic tools): every armed tool is wrapped, generic or a kit's (spec P4). A kit tool's own throw is a diagnostic, its cancel and `plan.select` (spec table: "a tool's event"); a generic tool's own throw is rethrown unchanged, today's behaviour (`select_tool.dart:546-550`), because it is not a kit's. A `KitHookFailure` that reaches a generic tool (the retry failed during its commit) is the kit's: a diagnostic, cancel, `plan.select`.

Plan decision (painting, sections): a failure while painting, or while building a section, must not notify listeners mid-frame, so those diagnostics go through `DiagnosticsLog.addAfterFrame` (deduplicated at once, published after the frame), and a failed paint cancels the tool after the frame (spec table).

Plan decision (allocation): `GuardedType` sits on the parametric hot path (spec Risks). Each member is a `try` around one delegating call: no closure, no collection, no boxing in the happy path. The engine's `query_allocation_test.dart` stays green (Task 21's gate); no allocation meter is added here, because the plan library's test process would need the VM-service meter whose noise floor in `_Closure` and `Context` (documented in `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/invariants/vm_allocation_meter.dart`) cannot resolve a per-call budget.

Plan decision (getters at registration): `ParametricCatalog.register` reads `contributesPlace` and `readsPlaces` (`parametric_system.dart:497-501`); through the guard, a throwing getter there surfaces as a `KitHookFailure` out of the controller's constructor, beside the kit-set validation errors. It is a construction error, not a runtime one (F-G12, F-G13 pin the attribution).

```dart
// through a guarding adapter that rethrows what the hook throws as

// hook's guard removed (the delegate called bare): the raw HookBoom then

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

/// A document with a page and a system over the guarded square and disc.
({DraftDocument doc, ParametricSystem system, ParametricCatalog catalog})
    harness(Switches sw) {
  final d = DraftDocument.empty();
  PageComponent.register(d.components);
  d.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
      d.rootHandle, PageComponent(scaleDenominator: 50)));
  final catalog = ParametricCatalog()
    ..register<SquareParams>(SquareParams.id, SquareParams.fromJson,
        GuardedType<SquareParams>('box', SquareParams.id, SquareType(sw)))
    ..register<DiscParams>(DiscParams.id, DiscParams.fromJson,
        GuardedType<DiscParams>('ring', DiscParams.id, DiscType(sw)));
  final system = ParametricSystem(d, catalog)..install();
  return (doc: d, system: system, catalog: catalog);
}

Matcher failed(String kitId, String typeId, String hook) =>
    isA<KitHookFailure>()
        .having((f) => f.kitId, 'kitId', kitId)
        .having((f) => f.typeId, 'typeId', typeId)
        .having((f) => f.hook, 'hook', hook)
        .having((f) => f.error, 'error',
            isA<HookBoom>().having((b) => b.hook, 'hook', hook));

/// Runs [edit] on [d]: it must throw [matcher], leave the document as it
/// was and record nothing.
void expectRefused(DraftDocument d, void Function() edit, Matcher matcher) {
  final before = canon(d);
  final depth = d.commands.undoDepth;
  final state = d.commands.stateId;
  expect(edit, throwsA(matcher));
  expect(canon(d), before, reason: 'rolled back');
  expect(d.commands.undoDepth, depth);
  expect(d.commands.stateId, state);
}
```

```dart
// Spec P4 "The failure boundary", through the controller: a hook that
// fails during an edit is caught at the expander, that type's objects are
// probed (E2), the failing ones frozen and locked, the history cleared,
// and the edit run once more; a second failure refuses it with one
// diagnostic. A load probes once. A component its factory cannot read is
// kept raw, locked and frozen (E4). A rollback that throws damages the
// plan (E3), and saving a damaged plan first reads it back.
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/kits/guard.dart' show GuardedTool;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../support/box_kit.dart';

/// [owner]'s entities' scalars (a circle's radius), in handle order.
List<double> scalarsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle owner) => [
      for (final k in kids(d, owner))
        ...d.geometry
            .read(d.entities.geomIndexAt(d.entities.slotOf(k)!))
            .scalars,
    ];

List<KitDiagnostic> diagnosticsOf(PlanController c, KitDiagnosticCode code) =>
    [
      for (final d in c.diagnostics.value)
        if (d.code == code) d
    ];

/// Applies [inner], then hands back an inverse that throws: a command
/// whose rollback fails.
final class _Sabotage extends DraftCommand {
  _Sabotage(this.inner);
  final DraftCommand inner;
  @override
  Capability get capability => inner.capability;
  @override
  Set<Capability> get capabilities => inner.capabilities;
  @override
  String get label => 'Sabotage';
  @override
  CommandResult apply(CommandTarget target) {
    final r = inner.apply(target);
    return CommandResult(inverse: _Throwing(), touched: r.touched);
  }
}

final class _Throwing extends DraftCommand {
  @override
  Capability get capability => Capability.components;
  @override
  String get label => 'Throwing';
  @override
  CommandResult apply(CommandTarget target) =>
      throw StateError('this inverse refuses');
}

      'F-1 (spec Tests) an object whose reach throws: one edit of it is '

    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    final d = c.document;
    final broken = addObject(d, atSquare, const SquareParams(side: 1200, poisoned: true));
    final other = addObject(d, nearSquare(4000, -500, 0.25), const SquareParams(side: 500));
    final drawn = coordsOf(d, broken);
    sw.failing.add('reach');

    // M-F1a: `FailureBoundary.recover` returning false at once: the move
    // is refused by the failure, not by the lock, so nothing is locked and
    // no hint is shown. `execute` catches the retry's PlanLocked and

        isFalse);

  test(

/// A command that refuses: [apply] throws [error] before it touches
/// anything.
final class _Refusing extends DraftCommand {
```

  Create `test/kits/guarded_tool_test.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P4 "The failure boundary", the tool rows: every armed tool is wrapped
// in a guarding Tool decorator. A kit tool's event that throws is a
// diagnostic, a cancel and plan.select; a refusal (PlanLocked, or E2's
// DanglingReferenceError) only cancels the gesture and shows the hint; a
// paint that throws is skipped and the tool cancelled after the frame; a
// generic tool's own error is rethrown as today. The decorator forwards
// what it does not guard.
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/kits/guard.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// A tool whose members throw [errors] by name; it counts its cancels and
/// paints, and reports [midShape] and [toolPhase].
final class _Inner extends Tool {
  final Map<String, Object> errors = {};
  int cancels = 0;
  int paints = 0;
  bool midShape = true;
  ToolPhase toolPhase = ToolPhase.dragging;

  void _maybe(String member) {
    final e = errors[member];
    if (e != null) throw e;
  }

  void ping() => notifyListeners();

  @override
  String get name => 'inner';
  @override
  ToolPhase get phase {
    _maybe('phase');
    return toolPhase;
  }

  @override
  bool get isMidShape {
    _maybe('isMidShape');
    return midShape;
  }

  @override
  void onPointerDown(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) => _maybe('onPointerDown');
  @override
  void onPointerMove(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) => _maybe('onPointerMove');
  @override
  void onPointerUp(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) => _maybe('onPointerUp');
  @override
  void onPointerExit(ToolContext ctx) => _maybe('onPointerExit');
  @override
  KeyEventResult onKey(KeyEvent event, ToolContext ctx) {
    _maybe('onKey');
    return KeyEventResult.handled;
  }

  @override
  void cancel(ToolContext ctx) => cancels++;
  @override
  void paintOverlay(Canvas canvas, ViewportTransform camera, Size viewport,
      PaperPalette paper) {
    paints++;
    _maybe('paintOverlay');
  }
}

final class _Rig {
  _Rig({this.kitId = 'box', this.toolId = 'box.stamp'}) {
    final d = DraftDocument.empty();
    index = SpatialIndex(d);
    selection = SelectionController(d);
    ctx = ToolContext(
        document: d,
        index: index,
        camera: CameraController(ViewportTransform(
            worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2(0.125, 0, 0, -0.125, 400, 300))),
        selection: selection);
    tool = GuardedTool(
        inner: inner,
        kitId: kitId,
        toolId: toolId,
        log: log,
        lockHint: hint,
        onFailed: () => failed++);
  }

  final String kitId;
  final String toolId;
  final _Inner inner = _Inner();
  final DiagnosticsLog log = DiagnosticsLog();
  final ValueNotifier<bool> hint = ValueNotifier(false);
  late final SpatialIndex index;
  late final SelectionController selection;
  late final ToolContext ctx;
  late final GuardedTool tool;
  int failed = 0;

  void dispose() {
    tool.dispose();
    index.dispose();
    selection.dispose();
    hint.dispose();
    log.dispose();
  }
}

final ToolPointerEvent down = ToolPointerEvent(
    screen: const Offset(410.5, 290.25),
    world: Vector2(84.0, 78.0),
    pointer: 1,
    buttons: 1,
    shift: false,
    control: false,
    meta: false,
    alt: false,
    pickRadiusWorld: 48);

const KeyDownEvent keyR = KeyDownEvent(
    physicalKey: PhysicalKeyboardKey.keyR,
    logicalKey: LogicalKeyboardKey.keyR,
    timeStamp: Duration.zero);

/// Each event member, called on [t] with [ctx].
final Map<String, void Function(Tool t, ToolContext ctx)> events = {
  'onPointerDown': (t, ctx) => t.onPointerDown(down, ctx),
  'onPointerMove': (t, ctx) => t.onPointerMove(down, ctx),
  'onPointerUp': (t, ctx) => t.onPointerUp(down, ctx),
  'onPointerExit': (t, ctx) => t.onPointerExit(ctx),
  'onKey': (t, ctx) => t.onKey(keyR, ctx),
};

void main() {
  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();

  test(
      'F-T1 a kit tool\'s event that throws: no exception, one diagnostic '
      'naming the tool, the tool cancelled, plan.select asked for', () {
    for (final MapEntry(key: member, value: call) in events.entries) {
      final r = _Rig();
      r.inner.errors[member] = StateError('boom in $member');
      // M-F-T1-<member>: that member's `try` removed in GuardedTool.
      expect(() => call(r.tool, r.ctx), returnsNormally, reason: member);
      final d = r.log.entries.value;
      expect(d, hasLength(1), reason: member);
      expect((d.single.kitId, d.single.subject, d.single.code),
          ('box', 'box.stamp', KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed),
          reason: member);
      expect(r.inner.cancels, 1, reason: member);
      expect(r.failed, 1, reason: member);
      expect(r.hint.value, isFalse, reason: member);
      r.dispose();
    }
  });

  test(
      'F-T2 a refusal (PlanLocked, or E2\'s DanglingReferenceError) shows '
      'the hint and cancels the gesture: no diagnostic, the tool stays', () {
    for (final refusal in <Object>[
      const PlanLocked(),
      const DanglingReferenceError(Handle(4101), Handle(4102)),
    ]) {
      final r = _Rig();
      r.inner.errors['onPointerUp'] = refusal;
      // M-F-T2: the refusal branch of `_failed` removed: the refusal is
      // then a kit failure (a diagnostic, plan.select).
      r.tool.onPointerUp(down, r.ctx);
      expect(r.hint.value, isTrue, reason: '$refusal');
      expect(r.inner.cancels, 1, reason: '$refusal');
      expect(r.failed, 0, reason: '$refusal');
      expect(r.log.entries.value, isEmpty, reason: '$refusal');
      r.dispose();
    }
  });

  test(
      'F-T3 a KitHookFailure reaching a generic tool is the kit\'s: the '
      'diagnostic names the failing type, the tool is cancelled', () {
    final r = _Rig(kitId: 'plan', toolId: 'plan.line');
    r.inner.errors['onPointerUp'] =
        const KitHookFailure('ring', 'ring.disc', 'generate', HookError());
    r.tool.onPointerUp(down, r.ctx);
    final d = r.log.entries.value.single;
    // M-F-T3: the KitHookFailure attributed to the tool (kitId, toolId).
    expect((d.kitId, d.subject), ('ring', 'ring.disc'));
    expect(r.inner.cancels, 1);
    expect(r.failed, 1);
    r.dispose();
  });

  test('F-T4 a generic tool\'s own error is rethrown, as today', () {
    final r = _Rig(kitId: 'plan', toolId: 'plan.select');
    r.inner.errors['onPointerUp'] = StateError('a refused edit');
    // M-F-T4: `_failed` treating every tool as a kit's swallows it.
    expect(() => r.tool.onPointerUp(down, r.ctx), throwsStateError);
    expect(r.failed, 0);
    expect(r.log.entries.value, isEmpty);
    r.dispose();
  });

  testWidgets(
      'F-T5 a kit tool\'s paint that throws is skipped; the tool is '
      'cancelled after the frame, and not painted again', (tester) async {
    final r = _Rig();
    addTearDown(r.dispose);
    r.inner.errors['paintOverlay'] = StateError('paint');
    final canvas = Canvas(ui.PictureRecorder());
    final camera = ViewportTransform(
        worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2(0.125, 0, 0, -0.125, 400, 300));
    r.tool.paintOverlay(canvas, camera, const Size(800, 600), PaperPalette.light);
    // M-F-T5: `onFailed` called at once instead of after the frame.
    expect(r.failed, 0, reason: 'not inside the paint');
    r.tool.paintOverlay(canvas, camera, const Size(800, 600), PaperPalette.light);
    expect(r.inner.paints, 1, reason: 'a broken overlay is skipped');
    await tester.pump();
    expect(r.failed, 1);
    expect(r.log.entries.value, hasLength(1));
    r.tool.cancel(r.ctx);
    r.inner.errors.clear();
    r.tool.paintOverlay(canvas, camera, const Size(800, 600), PaperPalette.light);
    expect(r.inner.paints, 2, reason: 'a cancel clears the broken flag');
  });

  test(
      'F-T6 the decorator forwards phase, isMidShape and notifications; a '
      'kit getter that throws answers the safe default with a diagnostic',
      () async {
    final r = _Rig();
    // M-F-T6a: `isMidShape` answering false without asking the inner.
    expect(r.tool.isMidShape, isTrue);
    expect(r.tool.phase, ToolPhase.dragging);
    var heard = 0;
    r.tool.addListener(() => heard++);

    expect(r.tool.isMidShape, isFalse);
    r.inner.errors['phase'] = StateError('phase');

        reason: 'the decorator owns and disposes its tool');

}

final class HookError implements Exception {
  const HookError();
```

```dart
// Spec P4 "The failure boundary" (umbrella A9): every kit hook is called at
// the contract's boundary. A kit's ParametricType is wrapped in
// [GuardedType], which rethrows what a hook throws as [KitHookFailure];
// its tools in [GuardedTool]; its grips, attachment providers, factories
// and sections in guarded calls. [FailureBoundary] is the controller's
// flow after a failed edit: probe the type's objects (E2), freeze and lock
// the failing ones, retry once; and the load's check. [DiagnosticsLog]
// keeps one diagnostic per kit, subject and code.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show KeyEvent;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../controller/diagnostics_log.dart';
import 'locks.dart' show PlanLocked;

export '../controller/diagnostics_log.dart' show DiagnosticsLog;

/// A kit's [ParametricType] hook threw [error]: [hook] of [typeId], in
/// [kitId]. The engine rolls the edit back and rethrows it unchanged.
final class KitHookFailure implements Exception {
  const KitHookFailure(this.kitId, this.typeId, this.hook, this.error);

  final String kitId;
  final String typeId;
  final String hook;
  final Object error;

  @override
  String toString() => 'KitHookFailure: $typeId.$hook threw $error';
}

/// [inner] with every member called at the boundary: what it throws is
/// rethrown as a [KitHookFailure] naming [kitId], [typeId] and the member
/// (a [KitHookFailure] from a nested call, another type's hook asked
/// through the view, keeps its own attribution). `implements`, not
/// `extends`: a member the engine adds later is a compile error here, never
/// a silently unguarded default. One `try` around one call per member: no
/// allocation in the happy path.
final class GuardedType<T extends Component> implements ParametricType<T> {
  const GuardedType(this.kitId, this.typeId, this.inner);

  final String kitId;
  final String typeId;
  final ParametricType<T> inner;

  Never _fail(String hook, Object error, StackTrace stack) =>
      Error.throwWithStackTrace(
          KitHookFailure(kitId, typeId, hook, error), stack);

  @override
  Capability get editCapability {
    try {
      return inner.editCapability;
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('editCapability', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  Aabb2 reach(T params, Transform2 toWorld) {
    try {
      return inner.reach(params, toWorld);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('reach', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  List<Generated> generate(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    try {
      return inner.generate(view, self);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('generate', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  List<Diagnostic> diagnose(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    try {
      return inner.diagnose(view, self);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('diagnose', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  Iterable<Handle> references(T params) {
    try {
      return inner.references(params);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('references', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  ReferencePolicy get referencePolicy {
    try {
      return inner.referencePolicy;
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('referencePolicy', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  Object? pageKey(PageComponent? page) {
    try {
      return inner.pageKey(page);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('pageKey', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool dissolves(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    try {
      return inner.dissolves(view, self);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('dissolves', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool get contributesPlace {
    try {
      return inner.contributesPlace;
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('contributesPlace', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  Aabb2? placeBox(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    try {
      return inner.placeBox(view, self);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('placeBox', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  Object placeInput(ParametricView view, Handle self) {
    try {
      return inner.placeInput(view, self);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('placeInput', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  bool get readsPlaces {
    try {
      return inner.readsPlaces;
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('readsPlaces', e, s);
    }
  }

  @override
  Aabb2 readBox(T params, Transform2 toWorld, Aabb2 stored) {
    try {
      return inner.readBox(params, toWorld, stored);
    } on KitHookFailure {
      rethrow;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _fail('readBox', e, s);
    }
  }
}

/// The plan library's [TypeGuard]: `PlanType.registerInto(catalog, guard:)`
/// wraps the kit's type in a [GuardedType] of the same `T`.
final class PlanTypeGuard implements TypeGuard {
  const PlanTypeGuard();

  @override
  ParametricType<T> wrap<T extends Component>(
          String kitId, String typeId, ParametricType<T> type) =>
      GuardedType<T>(kitId, typeId, type);
}

/// [create]'s product, or null when it throws: the failure is reported as
/// [subject]'s (a tool id, a type id), and the caller disables what the
/// factory would have made (spec table: "a tool's factory: the tool is
/// disabled").
T? guardFactory<T extends Object>(
    String kitId, String subject, T Function() create, DiagnosticsLog log) {
  try {
    return create();
  } catch (error) {
    log.add(KitDiagnostic(
        kitId: kitId,
        subject: subject,
        code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
        message: 'factory: $error',
        error: error));
    return null;
  }
}

/// Every armed tool, generic or a kit's, behind the boundary (spec P4).
///
/// - [PlanLocked] and `DanglingReferenceError` (E2's refusal of a frozen
///   object's `cascade` referrer) are refusals: the hint is set and the
///   inner's gesture cancelled; no diagnostic.
/// - A [KitHookFailure] is its kit's: a diagnostic, the inner cancelled,
///   [onFailed] (the controller arms `plan.select`).
/// - Anything else a kit tool throws is a diagnostic of [toolId], the
///   inner cancelled, [onFailed]; a generic tool's (kit id `plan`) is
///   rethrown unchanged, as today (`select_tool.dart:546-550`).
/// - A paint that throws is skipped, reported after the frame, and the tool
///   is given to [onFailed] after the frame; it paints nothing until it is
///   cancelled.
///
/// Owns [inner]: [dispose] disposes it.
final class GuardedTool extends Tool {
  GuardedTool({
    required this.inner,
    required this.kitId,
    required this.toolId,
    required this.log,
    required this.lockHint,
    required this.onFailed,
  }) {
    inner.addListener(_forward);
  }

  final Tool inner;
  final String kitId;
  final String toolId;
  final DiagnosticsLog log;
  final ValueNotifier<bool> lockHint;
  final VoidCallback onFailed;

  bool _broken = false;

  bool get _isKit => kitId != 'plan';

  void _forward() => notifyListeners();

  KitDiagnostic _diagnostic(Object error) => KitDiagnostic(
      kitId: kitId,
      subject: toolId,
      code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
      message: '$error',
      error: error);

  /// A getter's failure: a generic tool's is rethrown; a kit's is reported
  /// after the frame (a getter may be read in a build or a paint).
  void _getterFailed(Object error, StackTrace stack) {
    if (!_isKit) Error.throwWithStackTrace(error, stack);
    log.addAfterFrame(_diagnostic(error));
  }

  void _cancelInner(ToolContext ctx) {
    try {
      inner.cancel(ctx);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      if (!_isKit) Error.throwWithStackTrace(error, stack);
      log.add(_diagnostic(error));
    }
  }

  void _failed(Object error, StackTrace stack, ToolContext ctx) {
    if (error is PlanLocked || error is DanglingReferenceError) {
      lockHint.value = true;
      _cancelInner(ctx);
      return;
    }
    if (error is KitHookFailure) {
      log.add(KitDiagnostic(
          kitId: error.kitId,
          subject: error.typeId,
          code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
          message: '${error.hook}: ${error.error}',
          error: error.error));
    } else if (_isKit) {
      log.add(_diagnostic(error));
    } else {
      Error.throwWithStackTrace(error, stack);
    }
    _cancelInner(ctx);
    onFailed();
  }

  void _paintFailed(Object error, StackTrace stack) {
    if (!_isKit) Error.throwWithStackTrace(error, stack);
    _broken = true;
    log.addAfterFrame(_diagnostic(error));
    SchedulerBinding.instance
      ..addPostFrameCallback((_) => onFailed())
      ..ensureVisualUpdate();
  }

  @override
  String get name {
    try {
      return inner.name;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _getterFailed(e, s);
      return toolId;
    }
  }

  @override
  ToolPhase get phase {
    try {
      return inner.phase;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _getterFailed(e, s);
      return ToolPhase.idle;
    }
  }

  @override
  TouchPress get touchPress {
    try {
      return inner.touchPress;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _getterFailed(e, s);
      return TouchPress.lift;
    }
  }

  @override
  bool get isMidShape {
    try {
      return inner.isMidShape;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _getterFailed(e, s);
      return false;
    }
  }

  @override
  MouseCursor get cursor {
    try {
      return inner.cursor;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _getterFailed(e, s);
      return MouseCursor.defer;
    }
  }

  @override
  Transform2? get selectionPreviewTransform {
    try {
      return inner.selectionPreviewTransform;
    } catch (e, s) {
      _getterFailed(e, s);
      return null;
    }
  }

  @override
  void onPointerDown(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {
    try {
      inner.onPointerDown(e, ctx);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _failed(error, stack, ctx);
    }
  }

  @override
  void onPointerMove(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {
    try {
      inner.onPointerMove(e, ctx);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _failed(error, stack, ctx);
    }
  }

  @override
  void onPointerUp(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {
    try {
      inner.onPointerUp(e, ctx);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _failed(error, stack, ctx);
    }
  }

  @override
  void onPointerExit(ToolContext ctx) {
    try {
      inner.onPointerExit(ctx);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _failed(error, stack, ctx);
    }
  }

  @override
  KeyEventResult onKey(KeyEvent event, ToolContext ctx) {
    try {
      return inner.onKey(event, ctx);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _failed(error, stack, ctx);
      return KeyEventResult.ignored;
    }
  }

  @override
  void cancel(ToolContext ctx) {
    _broken = false;
    _cancelInner(ctx);
  }

  @override
  void paintOverlay(Canvas canvas, ViewportTransform camera, Size viewport,
      PaperPalette paper) {
    if (_broken) return;
    try {
      inner.paintOverlay(canvas, camera, viewport, paper);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _paintFailed(error, stack);
    }
  }

  @override
  void paintWorldOverlay(
      Canvas canvas, Vector2 origin, double scale, PaperPalette paper) {
    if (_broken) return;
    try {
      inner.paintWorldOverlay(canvas, origin, scale, paper);
    } catch (error, stack) {
      _paintFailed(error, stack);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    inner.removeListener(_forward);
    inner.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }
}

/// The grip provider behind the boundary: a call that throws is reported
/// (once per type, through [typeIdOf]) and that object has no grips, no
/// drag and does not move until the document is replaced (a drag in flight
/// is refused: its `drag` answers null).
final class GuardedGrips implements ObjectGripProvider {
  GuardedGrips(this._inner,
      {required String? Function(DraftDocument, Handle) typeIdOf,
      required DiagnosticsLog log})
      : _typeIdOf = typeIdOf,
        _log = log;

  final ObjectGripProvider _inner;
  final String? Function(DraftDocument, Handle) _typeIdOf;
  final DiagnosticsLog _log;
  final Set<Handle> _failed = {};

  void _fail(DraftDocument d, Handle group, String member, Object error) {
    _failed.add(group);
    String typeId;
    try {
      typeId = _typeIdOf(d, group) ?? 'plan';
    } catch (_) {
      typeId = 'plan';
    }
    _log.add(KitDiagnostic(
        kitId: kitOfKey(typeId),
        subject: typeId,
        code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
        message: 'grips.$member: $error',
        error: error));
  }

  @override
  List<Grip> gripsOf(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    if (_failed.contains(group)) return const [];
    try {
      return _inner.gripsOf(d, group);
    } catch (error) {
      _fail(d, group, 'gripsOf', error);
      return const [];
    }
  }

  @override
  DraftCommand? drag(DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    if (_failed.contains(group)) return null;
    try {
      return _inner.drag(d, group, grip, world);
    } catch (error) {
      _fail(d, group, 'drag', error);
      return null;
    }
  }

  @override
  List<(EntityKind, GeometryPayload)> preview(
      DraftDocument d, Handle group, Grip grip, Vector2 world) {
    if (_failed.contains(group)) return const [];
    try {
      return _inner.preview(d, group, grip, world);
    } catch (error) {
      _fail(d, group, 'preview', error);
      return const [];
    }
  }

  @override
  bool movable(DraftDocument d, Handle group) {
    if (_failed.contains(group)) return false;
    try {
      return _inner.movable(d, group);
    } catch (error) {
      _fail(d, group, 'movable', error);
      return false;
    }
  }
}

/// [provider]'s answer to [query], or null when it throws (spec table: an
/// attachment provider's failure is taken as no attachment), reported
/// under [kitId] and the provider's kind.
Attachment? guardAttachment(String kitId, AttachmentProvider provider,
    AttachmentQuery query, void Function(KitDiagnostic) report) {
  try {
    return provider.attach(query);
  } catch (error) {
    String kind;
    try {
      kind = provider.kind;
    } catch (_) {
      kind = 'attachment';
    }
    report(KitDiagnostic(
        kitId: kitId,
        subject: kind,
        code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
        message: 'attach: $error',
        error: error));
    return null;
  }
}

/// The controller's flow after a kit's hook failed (spec P4), for one
/// document.
final class FailureBoundary {
  FailureBoundary({
    required this.document,
    required this.catalog,
    required this.system,
    required this.frozen,
    required this.log,
    required this.lock,
    required this.damage,
  });

  final DraftDocument document;
  final ParametricCatalog catalog;
  final ParametricSystem system;

  /// The set the system's `isFrozen` reads.
  final Set<Handle> frozen;
  final DiagnosticsLog log;

  /// The controller's `lockBroken`: locks and clears the history.
  final void Function(Set<Handle> objects) lock;

  /// The controller's damage handler (E3).
  final void Function(PartialMutationError error) damage;

  void _report(KitHookFailure f) => log.add(KitDiagnostic(
      kitId: f.kitId,
      subject: f.typeId,
      code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
      message: '${f.hook}: ${f.error}',
      error: f.error));

  void _freeze(Set<Handle> objects) {
    frozen.addAll(objects);
    lock(objects);
  }

  /// [failure] reported; that type's objects probed, and the failing ones
  /// frozen and locked. True when one was: the edit is worth one retry.
  bool recover(KitHookFailure failure) {
    _report(failure);
    final broken = probeType(failure.typeId);
    if (broken.isEmpty) return false;
    _freeze(broken);
    return true;
  }

  /// The live, unfrozen root-level objects of [typeId] whose probe (E2)
  /// fails, ascending by the tree's order.
  Set<Handle> probeType(String typeId) {
    final broken = <Handle>{};
    final root = document.rootHandle;
    for (final node in document.tree.nodes) {
      if (node is! GroupNode || node.parent != root) continue;
      final h = node.handle;
      if (frozen.contains(h) || catalog.typeIdOf(document, h) != typeId) {
        continue;
      }
      if (system.probe(h) != null) broken.add(h);
    }
    return broken;
  }

  /// After a load: one dry run of the whole plan; while it fails on a kit's
  /// hook, that type's failing objects are frozen and locked and it runs
  /// again. Ends when it passes, when nothing more can be frozen, or on an
  /// error that is no kit's (the engine's own reports cover that).
  void probeLoaded() {
    while (true) {
      try {
        system.drift();
        return;
      } on KitHookFailure catch (failure) {
        _report(failure);
        final broken = probeType(failure.typeId);
        if (broken.isEmpty) return;
        _freeze(broken);
      } catch (_) {
        return;
      }
    }
  }

  /// E4: each `component.unreadable` diagnostic of the load is reported as
  /// its kit's `componentUnreadable`, and its handles frozen and locked.
  void reportUnreadable(List<Diagnostic> loadDiagnostics) {
    final unreadable = <Handle>{};
    final registered = catalog.typeIds.toSet();
    for (final d in loadDiagnostics) {
      if (d.code != 'component.unreadable') continue;
      for (final h in d.handles) {
        final typeId = _typeOf(h, d.message, registered);
        log.add(KitDiagnostic(
            kitId: kitOfKey(typeId),
            subject: typeId,
            code: KitDiagnosticCode.componentUnreadable,
            message: d.message));
        unreadable.add(h);
      }
    }
    if (unreadable.isNotEmpty) _freeze(unreadable);
  }

  /// The registered type whose payload [h] kept raw, else the message's
  /// `<typeId>:` prefix (E4's message shape).
  String _typeOf(Handle h, String message, Set<String> registered) {
    for (final payload in document.components.unknownOf(h)) {
      final typeId = payload['typeId'];
      if (typeId is String && registered.contains(typeId)) return typeId;
    }
    final colon = message.indexOf(':');
    return colon > 0 ? message.substring(0, colon) : message;
  }

  /// E3: a rollback threw. Reported, then the controller rebuilds through
  /// `notifyLoaded` and marks the plan damaged.
  void partialMutation(PartialMutationError error) {
    log.add(KitDiagnostic(
        kitId: 'plan',
        code: KitDiagnosticCode.rollbackFailed,
        message: error.message,
        error: error));
    damage(error);
  }
}
```

  Create `lib/src/kits/section_boundary.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P4 "The failure boundary", the section row: a kit's section builder
// that throws leaves a small "section failed" box in its place; a widget
// it returned that fails while building shows Flutter's ErrorWidget in its
// place only, and the plan stays usable. The diagnostic is published after
// the frame (a build must not notify).
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import '../l10n/strings.dart';
import 'guard.dart';

/// Builds a kit's property section through [builder], behind the boundary.
class KitSectionBoundary extends StatelessWidget {
  const KitSectionBoundary({
    super.key,
    required this.kitId,
    required this.typeId,
    required this.log,
    required this.builder,
  });

  final String kitId;
  final String typeId;
  final DiagnosticsLog log;

  /// Calls the type's section (`PlanType.sectionFor`); null for none.
  final Widget? Function(BuildContext context) builder;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final Widget? section;
    try {
      section = builder(context);
    } catch (error) {
      log.addAfterFrame(KitDiagnostic(
          kitId: kitId,
          subject: typeId,
          code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
          message: 'section: $error',
          error: error));
      final scheme = Theme.of(context).colorScheme;
      return Container(
        key: const Key('kit-section-failed'),
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(8),
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          border: Border.all(color: scheme.error),
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4),
        ),
        child: Text(PlanStrings.of(context).sectionFailed,
            style: TextStyle(color: scheme.error)),
      );
    }
    return section ?? const SizedBox.shrink();
  }
}
```

  Replace the whole of `lib/src/controller/diagnostics_log.dart` (Task 8's minimal log; controller ruling R-j: completed in place, every member Task 8's callers use kept: the `ValueListenable` itself, `planScoped`, `report`, `reportAll`, `clearPlanScoped`) with:

```dart
// Spec P4 "Diagnostics": the controller's kit diagnostics, one per kit id,
// subject and code, in arrival order, as a listenable list. The plan's own
// (a missing kit, a newer kit, a component that does not read, a failed
// rollback, an unsavable plan) are cleared when the plan is replaced; the
// kit set's stay. Task 8 made the minimal log; Task 11 makes it the
// boundary's: deduplicated, and safe to add to from a build or a paint.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

final class DiagnosticsLog extends ChangeNotifier
    implements ValueListenable<List<KitDiagnostic>> {
  /// The codes that belong to one plan.
  static const Set<KitDiagnosticCode> planScoped = {
    KitDiagnosticCode.kitMissing,
    KitDiagnosticCode.kitNewer,
    KitDiagnosticCode.componentUnreadable,
    KitDiagnosticCode.rollbackFailed,
    KitDiagnosticCode.damagedUnsavable,
  };

  List<KitDiagnostic> _value = const [];
  final Set<(String, String?, KitDiagnosticCode)> _seen = {};
  List<KitDiagnostic>? _pending;
  bool _disposed = false;

  @override
  List<KitDiagnostic> get value => _value;

  /// The log itself, as the boundary's callers name it.
  ValueListenable<List<KitDiagnostic>> get entries => this;

  List<KitDiagnostic> get _current => _pending ?? _value;

  bool _isNew(KitDiagnostic d) => _seen.add((d.kitId, d.subject, d.code));

  void _publish(List<KitDiagnostic> next) {
    _pending = null;
    _value = List.unmodifiable(next);
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// Adds [diagnostic] and tells the listeners now; false (and nothing
  /// changes) when its kit, subject and code are already in the log. Not
  /// for a build or a paint: use [addAfterFrame] there.
  bool add(KitDiagnostic diagnostic) {
    if (!_isNew(diagnostic)) return false;
    _publish([..._current, diagnostic]);
    return true;
  }

  /// Task 8's name for [add].
  void report(KitDiagnostic diagnostic) => add(diagnostic);

  /// Adds each new one of [diagnostics], then tells the listeners once.
  void reportAll(Iterable<KitDiagnostic> diagnostics) {
    final next = [..._current];
    for (final d in diagnostics) {
      if (_isNew(d)) next.add(d);
    }
    if (next.length == _current.length) return;
    _publish(next);
  }

  /// Adds [diagnostic] at once (a second one of the same kit, subject and
  /// code is refused at once), and tells the listeners after the current
  /// frame: for a failure inside a build or a paint.
  bool addAfterFrame(KitDiagnostic diagnostic) {
    if (!_isNew(diagnostic)) return false;
    final first = _pending == null;
    _pending = List<KitDiagnostic>.unmodifiable([..._current, diagnostic]);
    if (first) {
      SchedulerBinding.instance
        ..addPostFrameCallback((_) {
          final next = _pending;
          if (next != null && !_disposed) _publish(next);
        })
        ..ensureVisualUpdate();
    }
    return true;
  }

  /// Drops the [planScoped] diagnostics: the plan they spoke of is gone, so
  /// the next plan may report them again.
  void clearPlanScoped() {
    final current = _current;
    final kept = [
      for (final d in current)
        if (!planScoped.contains(d.code)) d,
    ];
    _seen.removeWhere((key) => planScoped.contains(key.$3));
    if (kept.length == current.length) return;
    _publish(kept);
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    super.dispose();
  }
}
```

```dart
  /// Set when an edit is refused because it would change a locked object;
  /// the canvas shows a short hint and clears it (Task 15).
  final ValueNotifier<bool> lockHint = ValueNotifier(false);

  final ValueNotifier<bool> _damaged = ValueNotifier(false);

  /// Whether a rollback threw in this document (E3): the plan was rebuilt
  /// from what it holds, and saving reads it back first. Listenable: the
  /// editor's bar shows a warning while it holds (Task 20).
  ValueListenable<bool> get damaged => _damaged;

  final Set<String> _disabledTools = {};

  /// Whether [toolId]'s factory threw for the current document.
  bool isToolDisabled(String toolId) => _disabledTools.contains(toolId);

  /// Executes [command] on the current document: the commit path of every
  /// widget and panel (controller ruling R-b; no widget calls
  /// `document.commands.execute`). True when it applied; false when it was
  /// refused, the refusal caught here: [PlanLocked] (and [lockHint] set),
  /// `DanglingReferenceError` (E2's refusal of a frozen object's
  /// referrer), `ArgumentError`, and a kit's hook failure the retry did not
  /// cure (one diagnostic). `StateError` (`PartialMutationError` included,
  /// after the damage is handled) goes on to the caller.
  bool execute(DraftCommand command) {
    try {
      document.commands.execute(command);
      return true;
    } on PlanLocked {
      lockHint.value = true;
      return false;
    } on DanglingReferenceError {
      return false;
    } on ArgumentError {
      return false;
    } on KitHookFailure catch (failure) {
      _diagnostics.add(KitDiagnostic(
          kitId: failure.kitId,
          subject: failure.typeId,
          code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
          message: '${failure.hook}: ${failure.error}',
          error: failure.error));
      return false;
    }
  }

  void _damage(PartialMutationError error) {
    _damaged.value = true;
    document.commands.notifyLoaded();
    _session.locks.addBroken(document, const []);
    _refreshFlags();
    notifyListeners();
  }
```

```dart
  /// The design document's text (spec P2). A damaged plan (E3) is first
  /// read back; if it does not encode or does not decode, nothing is
  /// returned: PlanFormatException(damagedUnsavable), and a diagnostic.
  String save() {
    if (!_damaged.value) return _saveUnchecked();
    final String text;
    try {
      text = _saveUnchecked();
      decodePlan(text, register: _registerComponents, diagnostics: <Diagnostic>[])
          .dispose();
    } catch (error) {
      _diagnostics.add(KitDiagnostic(
          kitId: 'plan',
          code: KitDiagnosticCode.damagedUnsavable,
          message: '$error',
          error: error));
      throw PlanFormatException(PlanFormatCode.damagedUnsavable,
          'the damaged plan does not read back: $error');
    }
    return text;
  }
```

(Paths below are under `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/` unless they start at the repository root.)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `PlanGate` (Task 3), `PlanTool.needs` (Task 4) from `package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart`.
  - `DraftPermissions`, `Capability`, `Handle`, `PermissionDeniedError` from `package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart`.
  - `SelectGates`, `SelectTool`, `MoveResolver`, `LineTool`, `PolylineTool`, `RectangleTool`, `CircleTool`, `ArcTool`, `TextTool`, `Tool`, `ToolController`, `ToolPhase`, `SelectionController`, `SelectionKey`, `GripCache`, `DragKind`, `ToolPointerEvent`, `ViewportTransform`, `kPickRadiusPixels` from `package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart`.
  - From Task 8: `PlanController` and the members listed under "Assumed from earlier tasks".
  - From Task 10: `PlanController.locked` (`ValueListenable<Set<Handle>>`).
- Produces:
  - Exported from the barrel: `final class PlanPermissions` —
    `const PlanPermissions({Set<String>? tools, bool move = true, bool rotate = true, bool mirror = true, bool reshape = true, bool delete = true, bool changeLayer = true, bool recolor = true, bool editLayers = true, bool editPage = true, bool undo = true, bool export = true, bool print = true})`;
    `static const PlanPermissions full`, `static const PlanPermissions readOnly`;
    `bool allowsTool(String id)`; `bool allows(PlanGate gate)`; `bool get edits`; `DraftPermissions get draft`;
    `PlanPermissions copyWith({...every field...})`; `==`, `hashCode`, `toString`.
  - On `PlanController` (public): `PlanPermissions get permissions`, `set permissions(PlanPermissions value)`.
  - On `PlanController` (`@internal`, for Tasks 14-17): `PlanSelectGates get selectGates`, `ValueNotifier<bool> get fill`, `SelectTool get planSelect`, `Set<Capability>? needsOf(String toolId)`, `void registerToolNeeds(String id, Set<Capability> needs)`.
  - Internal (`lib/src/tools/`): `abstract final class PlanToolIds` (the eight reserved ids), `final class GenericTool`, `const List<GenericTool> genericTools`, `final class GenericToolSet`, `GenericToolSet buildGenericTools({required SelectGates gates, required ValueListenable<bool> fill, MoveResolver? moveResolver})`, `final class PlanSelectGates extends SelectGates`.

Plan decision (the engine groups): `PlanPermissions.draft` is `DraftPermissions.readOnly` when no edit flag is on and no tool but `plan.select` is allowed (`edits == false`), else `DraftPermissions.all`. Each engine group maps onto several flags (spec Facts: the engine cannot tell a rotation from a move; `AddEntityCommand` is `geometry`, `commands.dart:42`, and a delete is `geometry` and `structure`), so a group can be closed only when every flag that may need it is closed; the one profile where that is known without a per-command table is "no edit at all", today's `readOnly`. Every finer refusal stays a UI gate (spec P2: "`DraftPermissions` gets a group only where a flag maps onto one").

Plan decision (host calls): `controller.undo()` and `controller.redo()` run with the document's permissions lifted to `DraftPermissions.all` for that one call, then restored. The dispatcher checks permissions on undo and redo too (`jet_cad_2d/lib/src/document/undo.dart:213`, `:244`, `_require` at `:286-292`), so without the lift a host's `undo()` under `readOnly` (whose `draft` is `DraftPermissions.readOnly`) would throw `PermissionDeniedError`, against spec P2 "a host calling `controller.undo()` under `undo: false` still undoes". `undo` and `redo` skip the expander, so the lock layer is unaffected (spec P4).

Plan decision (`deleteSelection`): it keeps today's refusals (`floor_plan_controller.dart:695-714`: nothing selected, the editor's `delete` refused, mid-gesture), because it is the select tool's own delete through the gates (`select_tool.dart:748-753`); the "from a widget" of spec P2 is the flag, which today's controller call honours too. A locked selection is refused by the same gates (Task 10's set, read by `PlanSelectGates`).

Plan decision (`plan.select`): it is always allowed, whatever `tools` says, so `PlanPermissions` needs no validation (today's `validateEditorCapabilities`, `editor_capabilities.dart:355-360`, refused a `tools` set without select; here select is implied).

Plan decision (Fill): the Fill toggle is one `ValueNotifier<bool>` owned by the controller and kept across document swaps (today the shell's, `planner_shell.dart:421`, reset when a new shell was built). Task 16's palette and `F` key flip it.

Plan decision (the gates' cost): `SelectGates` getters are read at every hover, key and frame and must allocate nothing (`select_gates.dart:14-21`). `PlanSelectGates` extends Task 10's `LockGates`, which caches "the selection holds a locked object" as a `bool`, recomputed on a selection notification and on a `locked` notification; the getters read the permissions and that boolean.

Ported tests: none verbatim. Today's capability tests drive `FloorPlanEditorCapabilities` and `FloorPlanTool` through `FloorPlanView` (`test/host/editor_capabilities_test.dart`, `editor_tools_test.dart`, `editor_select_test.dart`); `PlanPermissions` is a new type (its panel, gallery and drafting-aid fields moved to widget options, P7; `selectTablesOnly` and `renumber` to 2b). - [ ] **Step 1: The test support for pointer events.** Create `test/support/tool_events.dart`:

```dart
// Pointer events for the plan's tools without a canvas (Task 12; reused by
// Tasks 13 and 14). Every event goes to the controller's active tool
// through its own ToolContext, resolved through the controller's camera,
// which a test first sets to a rotated, flipped, off-origin view
// ([useTestCamera]) so no fixture sits at the identity transform.
import 'dart:ui' show Offset;

import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// The test camera's pixels per millimetre.
const double kTestScale = 0.25;

/// Turned by 0.3 rad, y flipped, 0.25 px/mm, the world point
/// (4200, -1300) at the screen point (400, 300).
ViewportTransform testCamera() => ViewportTransform(
    worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.translation(400, 300)
        .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.3))
        .multiply(Transform2.scale(kTestScale, -kTestScale))
        .multiply(Transform2.translation(-4200, 1300)));

void useTestCamera(PlanController c) =>
    c.toolController.context.camera.value = testCamera();

/// An event at world [world] as the interaction layer would build it.
ToolPointerEvent eventAt(PlanController c, Vector2 world,
    {int buttons = 0, int pointer = 7}) {
  final cam = c.toolController.context.camera.value;
  final s = cam.worldToScreen(world);
  return ToolPointerEvent(
      screen: Offset(s.x, s.y),
      world: world,
      pointer: pointer,
      buttons: buttons,
      shift: false,
      control: false,
      meta: false,
      alt: false,
      pickRadiusWorld: kPickRadiusPixels / cam.scale);
}

/// A hover, a primary press and a release at [world], to the active tool.
void tapAt(PlanController c, Vector2 world) {
  final tools = c.toolController;
  tools.active.onPointerMove(eventAt(c, world), tools.context);
  tools.active
      .onPointerDown(eventAt(c, world, buttons: kPrimaryButton), tools.context);
  tools.active.onPointerUp(eventAt(c, world), tools.context);
}

/// A primary press at [from], eight moves to [to], [beforeUp], a release.
void dragFrom(PlanController c, Vector2 from, Vector2 to,
    {void Function()? beforeUp}) {
  final tools = c.toolController;
  tools.active.onPointerMove(eventAt(c, from), tools.context);
  tools.active
      .onPointerDown(eventAt(c, from, buttons: kPrimaryButton), tools.context);
  for (var i = 1; i <= 8; i++) {
    final p = from + (to - from) * (i / 8);
    tools.active
        .onPointerMove(eventAt(c, p, buttons: kPrimaryButton), tools.context);
  }
  beforeUp?.call();
  tools.active.onPointerUp(eventAt(c, to), tools.context);
}

/// The root-level lines of [d], ascending by handle.
List<Handle> linesOf(DraftDocument d) {
  final e = d.entities;
  return [
    for (final s in e.liveSlots)
      if (e.kindAt(s) == EntityKind.line && e.ownerAt(s) == d.rootHandle)
        e.handleAt(s),
  ]..sort((a, b) => a.value.compareTo(b.value));
}

/// Draws one line from [a] to [b] with `plan.line`, then arms `plan.select`
/// (which ends the line tool's chain). Returns the line's handle.
Handle drawLine(PlanController c, Vector2 a, Vector2 b) {
  final before = linesOf(c.document).toSet();
  if (!c.selectTool('plan.line')) throw StateError('plan.line refused');
  tapAt(c, a);
  tapAt(c, b);
  c.selectTool('plan.select');
  return linesOf(c.document).singleWhere((h) => !before.contains(h));
}
```

```dart
// Spec P2 "Permissions" (Task 12): PlanPermissions, read field by field
// against the spec's list, written out here and never read from the code
// under test. Modelled on jet_cad_floor_plan's editor_capabilities_test
// EC2-EC5; the type is new (P7 moves the panels, the gallery and the
// drafting aids to the widgets' options, and the tables-only fields to 2b).
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show DraftPermissions;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show PlanGate;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

typedef P = PlanPermissions;

/// Every flag, in declaration order.
const List<String> kFlagNames = [
  'move',
  'rotate',
  'mirror',
  'reshape',
  'delete',
  'changeLayer',
  'recolor',
  'editLayers',
  'editPage',
  'undo',
  'export',
  'print',
];

Map<String, bool> flagsOf(P p) => {
      'move': p.move,
      'rotate': p.rotate,
      'mirror': p.mirror,
      'reshape': p.reshape,
      'delete': p.delete,
      'changeLayer': p.changeLayer,
      'recolor': p.recolor,
      'editLayers': p.editLayers,
      'editPage': p.editPage,
      'undo': p.undo,
      'export': p.export,
      'print': p.print,
    };

P copyFlag(P p, String name, bool v) => switch (name) {
      'move' => p.copyWith(move: v),
      'rotate' => p.copyWith(rotate: v),
      'mirror' => p.copyWith(mirror: v),
      'reshape' => p.copyWith(reshape: v),
      'delete' => p.copyWith(delete: v),
      'changeLayer' => p.copyWith(changeLayer: v),
      'recolor' => p.copyWith(recolor: v),
      'editLayers' => p.copyWith(editLayers: v),
      'editPage' => p.copyWith(editPage: v),
      'undo' => p.copyWith(undo: v),
      'export' => p.copyWith(export: v),
      'print' => p.copyWith(print: v),
      _ => throw ArgumentError(name),
    };

/// The flag each gate reads (spec P3: a gate names a PlanPermissions flag).
const Map<PlanGate, String> kGateFlag = {
  PlanGate.move: 'move',
  PlanGate.rotate: 'rotate',
  PlanGate.mirror: 'mirror',
  PlanGate.reshape: 'reshape',
  PlanGate.delete: 'delete',
  PlanGate.changeLayer: 'changeLayer',
  PlanGate.recolor: 'recolor',
  PlanGate.editLayers: 'editLayers',
  PlanGate.editPage: 'editPage',
};

/// readOnly's flags, as spec P2 and today's S-12 list them.
const Map<String, bool> kReadOnly = {
  'move': false,
  'rotate': false,
  'mirror': false,
  'reshape': false,
  'delete': false,
  'changeLayer': false,
  'recolor': false,
  'editLayers': false,
  'editPage': false,
  'undo': false,
  'export': true,
  'print': true,
};

void main() {
  test('PM-1 full and readOnly, field by field', () {
    expect(P.full.tools, isNull, reason: 'every tool');
    expect(flagsOf(P.full), {for (final n in kFlagNames) n: true});
    expect(const P(), P.full);
    // M-PM1: readOnly's `undo: false` dropped.
    expect(P.readOnly.tools, {'plan.select'});
    expect(flagsOf(P.readOnly), kReadOnly);
  });

  test('PM-2 copyWith replaces exactly the field it names; null keeps', () {
    for (final name in kFlagNames) {
      for (final base in [P.full, P.readOnly]) {
        final before = flagsOf(base);
        final after = flagsOf(copyFlag(base, name, !before[name]!));
        // M-PM2: `move: move ?? this.move` written `move: this.move`.
        expect(after, {...before, name: !before[name]!},
            reason: '$name on $base');
        expect(copyFlag(base, name, before[name]!), base, reason: name);
      }
    }
    final some = P.full.copyWith(tools: {'plan.select', 'plan.line'});
    expect(some.tools, {'plan.select', 'plan.line'});
    expect(flagsOf(some), flagsOf(P.full));
    // A null argument keeps (Flutter's convention): start from full to
    // allow every tool again.
    expect(P.readOnly.copyWith().tools, {'plan.select'});
    expect(P.readOnly.copyWith(tools: null).tools, {'plan.select'});
    // The set given is copied, unmodifiable.
    final given = {'plan.select', 'plan.arc'};
    final copied = P.full.copyWith(tools: given);
    given.add('plan.text');
    expect(copied.tools, {'plan.select', 'plan.arc'});
    expect(() => copied.tools!.add('plan.circle'), throwsUnsupportedError);
  });

  test('PM-3 == and hashCode over every field; the tools as a set', () {
    final a = P.full.copyWith(tools: {'plan.line', 'plan.select', 'acme.x'});
    final b = P.full.copyWith(tools: {'acme.x', 'plan.select', 'plan.line'});
    expect(a, b);
    expect(a.hashCode, b.hashCode);
    // M-PM3: `setEquals(other.tools, tools) &&` dropped from ==.
    expect(a == P.full.copyWith(tools: {'plan.select', 'plan.line'}), isFalse);
    expect(a == P.full, isFalse, reason: 'a set is not "every tool"');
    for (final name in kFlagNames) {
      final changed = copyFlag(P.full, name, false);
      expect(changed == P.full, isFalse, reason: name);
      expect(P.full == changed, isFalse, reason: name);
    }
    expect(P.full == P.readOnly, isFalse);
    expect(identical(P.readOnly, P.readOnly), isTrue);
  });

  test('PM-4 allowsTool: select always; null allows every id; a set its own',
      () {
    for (final id in ['plan.select', 'plan.line', 'acme.wall', 'x.y']) {
      expect(P.full.allowsTool(id), isTrue, reason: id);
    }
    // M-PM4: `id == PlanToolIds.select ||` dropped.
    final none = P.full.copyWith(tools: const <String>{});
    expect(none.allowsTool('plan.select'), isTrue);
    expect(none.allowsTool('plan.line'), isFalse);
    expect(P.readOnly.allowsTool('plan.select'), isTrue);
    expect(P.readOnly.allowsTool('plan.symbol'), isFalse);
    final some = P.full.copyWith(tools: {'acme.wall'});
    expect(some.allowsTool('acme.wall'), isTrue);
    expect(some.allowsTool('acme.door'), isFalse);
    expect(some.allowsTool('plan.select'), isTrue);
  });

  test("PM-5 allows(gate) reads that gate's own flag, and only it", () {
    for (final MapEntry(key: gate, value: flag) in kGateFlag.entries) {
      final off = copyFlag(P.full, flag, false);
      for (final other in PlanGate.values) {

        expect(off.allows(other), other != gate,
            reason: '$flag off, asking $other');
      }
    }
    expect(kGateFlag.keys.toSet(), PlanGate.values.toSet(),
        reason: 'premise: every gate is listed');
  });

  test(
      'PM-6 draft: no edit flag and no tool but select is the engine\'s '
      'readOnly; any edit flag or any other tool opens every group', () {
    // M-PM6a: `draft` always DraftPermissions.all.
    expect(P.readOnly.draft, same(DraftPermissions.readOnly));
    expect(P.readOnly.edits, isFalse);
    expect(P.full.draft, same(DraftPermissions.all));

      expect(one.draft, same(DraftPermissions.all), reason: name);

    expect(drawing.draft, same(DraftPermissions.all));
    final everyTool = const P(
        move: false,
        rotate: false,
        mirror: false,
        reshape: false,
        delete: false,
        changeLayer: false,
        recolor: false,
        editLayers: false,
        editPage: false);
    expect(everyTool.tools, isNull);
    expect(everyTool.draft, same(DraftPermissions.all),
        reason: 'null tools allows the drawing tools');

  test('PM-7 toString names the fields that differ from full', () {
    expect(P.full.toString(), 'PlanPermissions()');
    expect(P.full.copyWith(reshape: false).toString(),

    // The tools sorted, so the text is stable whatever the set's order.
    expect(P.full.copyWith(tools: {'plan.text', 'acme.x'}).toString(),
```
