```dart
  Rig(
      {bool page = true,
      bool? objectSnap,
      double? step = gridStep,
      AttachmentRegistry? attachments,
      bool Function()? canRotate,
      bool Function()? canMirror}) {
    document = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: const InsertionPointMeasurer());
    registerKitComponents(document.components);
    document.header.units = DrawingUnits.millimeters;
    if (page) {
      document.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
          document.rootHandle,
          PageComponent(
              originX: gridOriginX, originY: gridOriginY, gridStepMm: step)));
    }
    document.commands.execute(addDrafted(
        document, EntityKind.line, linePayload(e0, e0 + Vector2(1200, 700)),
        layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero));
    document.commands.clearHistory();
    index = SpatialIndex(document);
    final linear = Transform2.scale(scale, -scale);
    final mid = linear.transformPoint(Vector2(76000, -41000));
    camera = CountingCamera(ViewportTransform(
        worldToScreenMatrix:
            Transform2.translation(400 - mid.x, 300 - mid.y).multiply(linear)));
    selection = SelectionController(document);
    pages = PageNotifier(document);
    snap = objectSnap == null ? null : SnapSettings(objectSnap: objectSnap);
    ctx = ToolContext(
        document: document,
        index: index,
        camera: camera,
        selection: selection,
        page: pages,
        snap: snap);
    armed = CountingNotifier(chair);
    tool = PlanSymbolTool(armed,
        attachments: attachments, canRotate: canRotate, canMirror: canMirror);
    tool.addListener(() => notifications.add(tool.isMidShape));
    addTearDown(() {
      if (!disposed) tool.dispose();
      armed.dispose();
      pages.dispose();
      snap?.dispose();
      selection.dispose();
      camera.dispose();
      index.dispose();
    });
  }
```

- [ ] **Step 9: The registry and the marker.** Create `lib/src/attach/attachment_registry.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P3 "Attachment" (Task 14): the registry over the kits' providers,
// one per document (spec P1 "Lifetimes": a kit's factories run once per
// document). plan.symbol and plan.select's move resolver use it, and
// nothing else.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';

import '../kits/guard.dart' show guardAttachment;

/// The providers of one document, by kind, in the order they were added
/// (kit load order).
///
/// [attach] asks every provider of each kind in its `kinds` and returns
/// the answer whose marker is nearest the query's pointer (the earlier on
/// a tie). A query's `keep` reaches only the provider that made it. A
/// provider that throws is taken as no attachment and reported; so is a
/// factory that throws, which adds no provider.
final class PlanAttachmentRegistry implements AttachmentRegistry {
  PlanAttachmentRegistry(
      {required void Function(KitDiagnostic diagnostic) report})
      : _report = report;

  final void Function(KitDiagnostic diagnostic) _report;
  final Map<String, List<_Provider>> _byKind = <String, List<_Provider>>{};
  final Expando<_Provider> _origin = Expando<_Provider>('attachment origin');

  /// Runs [factory] over [services] and adds its provider.
  void add(String kitId, AttachmentProvider Function(PlanServices) factory,
      PlanServices services) {
    final AttachmentProvider provider;
    try {
      provider = factory(services);
    } catch (e) {
      _report(KitDiagnostic(
          kitId: kitId,
          subject: 'attachments',
          code: KitDiagnosticCode.hookFailed,
          message: 'an attachment provider factory of "$kitId" threw: $e',
          error: e));
      return;
    }
    (_byKind[provider.kind] ??= <_Provider>[])
        .add(_Provider(kitId, provider));
  }

  @override
  Set<String> get kinds => Set.unmodifiable(_byKind.keys);

  @override
  Attachment? attach(List<String> kinds, AttachmentQuery query) {
    final keep = query.keep;
    final keeper = keep == null ? null : _origin[keep];
    AttachmentQuery? bare;
    Attachment? best;
    var bestDistance = double.infinity;
    for (final kind in kinds) {
      final providers = _byKind[kind];
      if (providers == null) continue;
      for (final p in providers) {
        final q = keep == null || identical(p, keeper)
            ? query
            : (bare ??= _withoutKeep(query));
        final a = _ask(p, q);
        if (a == null) continue;
        _origin[a] = p;
        final d = a.marker.distanceToSquared(query.pointer);
        if (d < bestDistance) {
          best = a;
          bestDistance = d;
        }
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  /// [p]'s answer through Task 11's guard: a throw is no attachment and
  /// one hookFailed (subject: the provider's kind).
  Attachment? _ask(_Provider p, AttachmentQuery q) =>
      guardAttachment(p.kitId, p.provider, q, _report);

  static AttachmentQuery _withoutKeep(AttachmentQuery q) => AttachmentQuery(
        footprint: q.footprint,
        current: q.current,
        pointer: q.pointer,
        capture: q.capture,
        edgeCapture: q.edgeCapture,
        mirrored: q.mirrored,
        mayRotate: q.mayRotate,
        exclude: q.exclude,
      );

  /// Disposes every provider that is [Disposable] and empties the
  /// registry (the document is going).
  void dispose() {
    for (final providers in _byKind.values) {
      for (final p in providers) {
        final provider = p.provider;
        if (provider is Disposable) provider.dispose();
      }
    }
    _byKind.clear();
  }
}

final class _Provider {
  const _Provider(this.kitId, this.provider);

  final String kitId;
  final AttachmentProvider provider;
}
```

(`Disposable` comes from `package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart`, Task 4's `plan_services.dart`; controller ruling R-d.)

Create `lib/src/attach/attachment_painter.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P3 "Drawing" (Task 14): the plan library draws every kit's
// attachment marker alike: the nearest glyph at the marker's screen point
// (today's attached marker, symbol_place_tool.dart:503-522).
import 'dart:ui' show Canvas, Offset, Paint;

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show SnapKind;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ViewportTransform, drawSnapMarker;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

/// Draws the attachment marker at world [marker] with [paint]. Allocates
/// only the screen offset.
void paintAttachmentMarker(
    Canvas canvas, ViewportTransform camera, Vector2 marker, Paint paint) {
  final m = camera.worldToScreenMatrix;
  final at = Offset(m.a * marker.x + m.c * marker.y + m.e,
      m.b * marker.x + m.d * marker.y + m.f);
  drawSnapMarker(canvas, at, SnapKind.nearest, grid: false, paint: paint);
}
```

The full file:

```dart
// Spec P3 "Attachment" (Task 14): plan.symbol, ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan's symbol_place_tool.dart (spec 09b D6, F-5, F-6,
// F-12, F-14, F-16; 09c D5, D6, D12). A ghost of the armed symbol's
// outline follows the pointer, snapping like the drawing tools; press,
// drag, release places it at the release point; one undo step per
// placement; the tool stays armed. A symbol whose jetcad.symbol names
// attachment kinds attaches through the registry, while object snap is on.
import 'dart:typed_data';
import 'dart:ui' as ui;

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart'
    show ValueListenable, visibleForTesting;
import 'package:flutter/gestures.dart' show kPrimaryButton;
import 'package:flutter/services.dart'
    show
        HardwareKeyboard,
        KeyDownEvent,
        KeyEvent,
        KeyUpEvent,
        LogicalKeyboardKey,
        MouseCursor,
        SystemMouseCursors;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show KeyEventResult;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show Attachment, AttachmentQuery, AttachmentRegistry;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../attach/attachment_painter.dart';
import '../symbols/plan_symbol.dart';
import '../symbols/symbol_box.dart';
import '../symbols/symbol_ghost.dart';
import '../symbols/symbol_placer.dart';
import 'generic_tools.dart' show PlanToolIds;

/// The half-size of the ghost's base-point cross, in screen pixels.
const double kGhostCrossPixels = 6.0;

/// How near, in screen pixels, the raw pointer may be for an attachment
/// (today's kWallAttachPixels, spec 09c D4, D6): larger than the snap
/// aperture, since the pointer is often the symbol's centre.
const double kAttachPixels = 16.0;

/// Places the [armed] symbol on release (spec 09b D6; see the header).
///
/// - Nothing armed is idle: every pointer event is ignored, every key
///   bubbles, the cursor defers.
/// - R, Shift+R and M turn and mirror the next placement while
///   [canRotate] / [canMirror] allow (null allows); a refused turn or
///   mirror is not used (the stored one returns with the flag).
/// - Attachment (spec P3): for a symbol whose component's `attachTo` is not
///   empty, with object snap on and [attachments] given, each recompute
///   asks `attachments.attach(attachTo, query)` with the symbol's
///   footprint, the free placement as `current`, the raw pointer, the
///   captures `kAttachPixels / scale` and `kSnapAperturePixels / scale`,
///   the mirror, `mayRotate` ([canRotate]) and the last answer as `keep`.
///   Attached, the ghost and the release use the answer's transform
///   verbatim and the marker is drawn at its marker; M mirrors in place.
class PlanSymbolTool extends Tool {
  PlanSymbolTool(this.armed,
      {this.attachments, this.canRotate, this.canMirror}) {
    armed.addListener(_onArmed);
    _syncPath();
  }

  final ValueListenable<PlanSymbol?> armed;
  final AttachmentRegistry? attachments;
  final bool Function()? canRotate;
  final bool Function()? canMirror;

  final DragPoint _at = DragPoint();
  final SnapResult _scratch = SnapResult();
  final GhostMatrix _matrix = GhostMatrix();
  final ui.Paint _ghostPaint = ui.Paint()..style = ui.PaintingStyle.stroke;
  final ui.Paint _markerPaint = ui.Paint()
    ..style = ui.PaintingStyle.stroke
    ..strokeWidth = kSnapMarkerStrokePixels;

  ui.Path? _path;
  bool _ghostVisible = false;
  bool _pressed = false;
  int _pressPointer = -1;
  int _quarterTurns = 0;
  bool _mirrored = false;
  Transform2? _placement;
  Attachment? _attached;

  final Vector2 _raw = Vector2.zero();
  bool _rawObjectSnap = true;
  double _rawScale = 1;
  bool _hasRaw = false;

  ui.Offset _lastScreen = ui.Offset.zero;
  ToolContext? _context;
  ToolContext? _listening;

  /// What a placement commits (spec D6: the definition copy, its leaves and
  /// its jetcad.symbol).
  static const Set<Capability> needs = PlanToolIds.symbolNeeds;

  @override
  String get name => 'Symbol';

  @override
  ToolPhase get phase => _pressed ? ToolPhase.pressed : ToolPhase.idle;

  @override
  TouchPress get touchPress => TouchPress.press;

  @override
  bool get isMidShape => _pressed;

  @override
  MouseCursor get cursor =>
      armed.value == null ? MouseCursor.defer : SystemMouseCursors.precise;

  bool get ghostVisible => _ghostVisible && armed.value != null;

  Vector2 get ghostAt => _at.point;

  @visibleForTesting
  ui.Path? get ghostPath => _path;

  @visibleForTesting
  Transform2? get ghostPlacement => _placement;

  @visibleForTesting
  GhostMatrix get ghostMatrix => _matrix;

  /// The attachment the ghost (and a release) uses, or null.
  @visibleForTesting
  Attachment? get ghostAttachment => _attached;

  int get quarterTurns => _quarterTurns;
  bool get mirrored => _mirrored;

  int get _turns => (canRotate?.call() ?? true) ? _quarterTurns : 0;
  bool get _mirror => _mirrored && (canMirror?.call() ?? true);

  /// The permissions may have changed: the ghost and its attachment are
  /// computed again with the turn and the mirror now allowed.
  void gatesChanged() {
    if (armed.value == null) return;
    final ctx = _listening ?? _context;
    if (ctx != null) _syncAttachment(ctx);
    _syncPlacement();
    notifyListeners();
  }

  void _syncPath() {
    final symbol = armed.value;
    _path = symbol == null ? null : ghostPathFor(symbol.entry);
  }

  void _onArmed() {
    _syncPath();
    _syncCamera();
    // The previous symbol's answer is no keep for this one.
    _attached = null;
    final ctx = _listening;
    if (ctx != null) {
      _update(ctx, _worldUnderPointer(ctx));
    } else {
      _syncPlacement();
    }
    _pressed = false;
    _pressPointer = -1;
    notifyListeners();
  }

  /// The free placement: the resolved point, the turns, the mirror.
  Transform2? _free() {
    final symbol = armed.value;
    return symbol == null
        ? null
        : placementTransform(
            at: _at.point,
            basePoint: symbol.entry.definition.basePoint,
            quarterTurns: _turns,
            mirrored: _mirror);
  }

  void _syncPlacement() => _placement = _attached?.transform ?? _free();

  void _syncAttachment(ToolContext ctx) {
    final previous = _attached;
    _attached = null;
    final registry = attachments;
    final symbol = armed.value;
    if (registry == null || symbol == null || !_hasRaw || !_rawObjectSnap) {
      return;
    }
    final kinds = symbol.component.attachTo;
    if (kinds.isEmpty) return;
    final box = boxOfEntry(symbol.entry);
    if (box == null) return;
    _attached = registry.attach(
        kinds,
        AttachmentQuery(
          footprint: footprintOf(box),
          current: _free()!,
          pointer: _raw.clone(),
          capture: kAttachPixels / _rawScale,
          edgeCapture: kSnapAperturePixels / _rawScale,
          mirrored: _mirror,
          mayRotate: canRotate?.call() ?? true,
          exclude: const {},
          keep: previous,
        ));
  }

  void _resolve(ToolContext ctx, Vector2 raw) {
    final cam = ctx.camera.value;
    final page = ctx.page?.value;
    resolveDragPoint(
      raw: raw,
      orthoBase: null,
      index: ctx.index,
      apertureWorld: kSnapAperturePixels / cam.scale,
      objectSnap: ctx.snap?.objectSnap ?? true,
      page: page,
      gridStepMm: dragGridStepMm(page, cam.scale),
      scratch: _scratch,
      out: _at,
    );
  }

  void _update(ToolContext ctx, Vector2 raw) {
    _resolve(ctx, raw);
    _raw.setFrom(raw);
    _rawObjectSnap = ctx.snap?.objectSnap ?? true;
    _rawScale = ctx.camera.value.scale;
    _hasRaw = true;
    _syncAttachment(ctx);
    _syncPlacement();
  }

  void _track(ToolPointerEvent e, ToolContext ctx) {
    _lastScreen = e.screen;
    _context = ctx;
  }

  Vector2 _worldUnderPointer(ToolContext ctx) =>
      ctx.camera.value.screenToWorld(Vector2(_lastScreen.dx, _lastScreen.dy));

  void _syncCamera() {
    final want = ghostVisible ? _context : null;
    if (identical(want, _listening)) return;
    _listening?.camera.removeListener(_onCamera);
    _listening = want;
    want?.camera.addListener(_onCamera);
  }

  void _onCamera() {
    final ctx = _listening;
    if (ctx == null) return;
    _update(ctx, _worldUnderPointer(ctx));
    notifyListeners();
  }

  // onPointerDown, onPointerMove, onPointerUp, onPointerExit: copied from
  // symbol_place_tool.dart:362-410 unchanged (they call _track, _update,
  // _syncCamera and _place as before).

  // onKey and _hasModifier: copied from symbol_place_tool.dart:426-469
  // unchanged.

  // cancel: copied from symbol_place_tool.dart:474-482 unchanged.

  /// The one commit path: one command, one undo step; the permissions are
  /// checked before placeSymbol allocates a handle (Ruling 05-3, F-16).
  void _place(ToolContext ctx, PlanSymbol symbol) {
    if (!needs.every(ctx.document.commands.permissions.allows)) return;
    ctx.execute(placeSymbol(ctx.document, symbol.entry,
        at: _at.point,
        quarterTurns: _turns,
        mirrored: _mirror,
        transform: _attached?.transform));
  }

  @override
  void paintOverlay(ui.Canvas canvas, ViewportTransform camera,
      ui.Size viewport, PaperPalette paper) {
    if (!ghostVisible) return;
    _markerPaint.color = paper.snap;
    final attached = _attached;
    if (attached != null) {
      paintAttachmentMarker(canvas, camera, attached.marker, _markerPaint);
      return;
    }
    final m = camera.worldToScreenMatrix;
    final p = _at.point;
    final at =
        ui.Offset(m.a * p.x + m.c * p.y + m.e, m.b * p.x + m.d * p.y + m.f);
    drawSnapMarker(canvas, at, _at.objectKind,
        grid: _at.grid, paint: _markerPaint);
  }

  // paintWorldOverlay: copied from symbol_place_tool.dart:528-551 with
  // `final entry = armed.value;` → `final entry = armed.value?.entry;`.

  @override
  void dispose() {
    armed.removeListener(_onArmed);
    _listening?.camera.removeListener(_onCamera);
    _listening = null;
    _context = null;
    super.dispose();
  }
}
```

  In the copied `onPointerUp` (`:388-402`), `final entry = armed.value;` → `final symbol = armed.value;` and `_place(ctx, entry)` → `_place(ctx, symbol)`. The `pointer` in the query is `_raw.clone()` because `_raw` is reused: an answer kept as `keep` must not see the next event's point. The class comment of `SymbolPlaceTool` (`:44-74`) is replaced by the one above.

- [ ] **Step 12: The move resolver.** Create `lib/src/tools/move_resolver.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P3 "Attachment" (Task 14): plan.select's move resolver, ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan's symbol_move.dart (spec 09c D8) over the registry.
// A root-level symbol instance whose jetcad.symbol names attachment kinds,
// dragged by its body with object snap on, attaches as a placement does,
// anchored on its plain-moved back-centre.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show MoveResolver, ToolContext;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart'
    show Attachment, AttachmentQuery, AttachmentRegistry, SymbolComponent;
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import '../symbols/symbol_box.dart';
import 'plan_symbol_tool.dart' show kAttachPixels;

/// Whether [g]'s linear part is orthonormal (spec 09c W-8, S-10; ported
/// from wall_attach.dart:402-407): a mirror is, a scale is not.
bool isOrthonormal(Transform2 g) {
  final tol = Tolerance.standard.linear;
  return (g.a * g.a + g.b * g.b - 1).abs() <= tol &&
      (g.c * g.c + g.d * g.d - 1).abs() <= tol &&
      (g.a * g.c + g.b * g.d).abs() <= tol;
}

final class PlanMoveResolver implements MoveResolver {
  PlanMoveResolver({required this.attachments, this.canRotate});

  /// The current document's registry, read at each call.
  final AttachmentRegistry Function() attachments;

  /// Whether a move may turn the symbol (the permissions' rotate), read at
  /// each call; null allows.
  final bool Function()? canRotate;

  DraftDocument? _document;
  int _state = -1;
  Handle? _node;
  Attachment? _last;
  final Map<Handle, SymbolBox?> _boxes = <Handle, SymbolBox?>{};

  /// For a root-level instance of a live definition whose `SymbolComponent`
  /// names attachment kinds, with object snap on and an orthonormal
  /// transform (a scaled instance never attaches, so its scale is never
  /// dropped): the registry's answer for the plain move `delta · T`; else
  /// null.
  @override
  ({Transform2 transform, Vector2 marker})? resolveMove(
      ToolContext ctx, Handle node, Transform2 delta) {
    final doc = ctx.document;
    if (!(ctx.snap?.objectSnap ?? true)) return null;
    final n = doc.tree[node];
    if (n is! InstanceNode || n.parent != doc.rootHandle) return null;
    if (doc.tree.definition(n.definition) == null) return null;
    final symbol = doc.components.get<SymbolComponent>(n.definition);
    if (symbol == null || symbol.attachTo.isEmpty) return null;
    final t = n.transform;
    if (!isOrthonormal(t)) return null;
    _sync(doc, node);
    final box = _boxes.putIfAbsent(
        n.definition, () => boxOfDefinition(doc, n.definition));
    if (box == null) return null;
    final moved = delta.multiply(t);
    final scale = ctx.camera.value.scale;
    final a = attachments().attach(
        symbol.attachTo,
        AttachmentQuery(
          footprint: footprintOf(box),
          current: moved,
          pointer: moved.transformPoint(box.backCentre),
          capture: kAttachPixels / scale,
          edgeCapture: kSnapAperturePixels / scale,
          mirrored: t.a * t.d - t.b * t.c < 0,
          mayRotate: canRotate?.call() ?? true,
          exclude: {node},
          keep: _last,
        ));
    _last = a;
    if (a == null) return null;
    return (transform: a.transform, marker: a.marker);
  }

  /// One drag is one document state and one node: outside it the boxes
  /// and the keep start afresh.
  void _sync(DraftDocument doc, Handle node) {
    final state = doc.commands.stateId;
    if (identical(doc, _document) && state == _state) {
      if (node != _node) {
        _node = node;
        _last = null;
      }
      return;
    }
    _document = doc;
    _state = state;
    _node = node;
    _last = null;
    _boxes.clear();
  }
}
```

```dart
  /// plan.symbol of this document (Task 14); in the tool map, which owns
  /// and disposes it.
  late final PlanSymbolTool symbolTool;

  /// Runs every kit's attachment-provider factories over this document,
  /// once (spec P1 lifetimes), before its tools: the registry is what
  /// `PlanServices.attachments` returns from here on.
  void runAttachmentFactories(KitSet kits, Map<String, PlanServices> services,
      void Function(KitDiagnostic) report) {
    final registry = PlanAttachmentRegistry(report: report);
    attachments = registry;
    for (final kit in kits.kits) {
      for (final factory in kit.attachments) {
        registry.add(kit.id, factory, services[kit.id]!);
      }
    }
  }

  /// Puts [tool] in the map as plan.symbol, after the generic tools and
  /// before the kits'.
  void addSymbolTool(PlanSymbolTool tool) {
    symbolTool = tool;
    addTool(PlanToolIds.symbol, tool);
  }
```

```dart
  /// One attachmentKindUnoffered per kit and kind (the log keeps one per
  /// kit, subject and code) for each loaded symbol's attachTo kind that no
  /// provider of the current document offers.
  void _reportUnofferedKinds() {
    final offered = _session.attachments.kinds;
    for (final s in _symbols) {
      for (final kind in s.component.attachTo) {
        if (offered.contains(kind)) continue;
        _diagnostics.add(KitDiagnostic(
            kitId: s.kitId,
            subject: kind,
            code: KitDiagnosticCode.attachmentKindUnoffered,
            message: '${s.id} attaches to "$kind", which no loaded kit '
                'offers'));
      }
    }
  }
```

Plan decision (**the guard lands here**): the scopes give the shortcut guard to Task 16, but the text entry this task ports already needs it (`text_entry_overlay.dart:135` wraps its field in `ShellShortcutGuard`), and Task 18 assumes `PlanShortcutGuard({required PlanController controller, required Widget child})` in `lib/src/shortcuts/plan_shortcut_guard.dart` with `planLetterKeys(PlanController)`. So the guard file and the chords land here with the generic letters; Task 16 makes `planLetterKeys` return the letters actually in use (spec P2: "The guard is built from the letters actually in use"), and every guarded field follows without a change.

Plan decision (**which tests move**): `floor_plan/test/planner_palette_test.dart` tests the canvas's colour palettes (chrome and paper sets), not the tool palette, so it is ported here; `floor_plan/test/hover_removal_test.dart`'s HR1 removes a hovered canvas beside the property panel that listens to the selection (its named mutant is the panel's relay), so it moves to Task 17, where that panel exists; HR2 (a hovered table) is 2b's. `canvas_ui_test.dart`'s D6a tests the page panel's swatches and moves to Task 18.

Plan decision (**the canvas owns the paper**): the resolver, its key (ACI 7's ink on the display paper, and whether the canvas re-tones) and the canvas colour move from the shell (`floor_plan/lib/src/planner_shell.dart:281-382`) into `PlanCanvas`, so the canvas stands alone with only a controller (spec P2). The table colour layer (`planner_shell.dart:1518-1524`) and the `_fillPaper`/`_fillTheme` notifiers (`:359`, `:380-381`) are 2b's and are not ported.

Plan decision (**one canvas at a time**, spec P2): the rule is checked after the frame, not in `initState`. Flutter inflates a replacing canvas before it disposes the replaced one when a keyed child moves (`RenderObjectElement.updateChildren` inflates the new middle children before it deactivates the old keyed ones), so a check in `initState` would assert on a legitimate swap. Each `_PlanCanvasState` adds itself to a per-controller set in `initState` and removes itself in `dispose`; a post-frame callback asserts that the set holds at most one. Debug only (`assert`).

Plan decision (**the lock hint**): `PlanController.lockHint` (Task 11) is set by the guarded tools and the panels' commit sites when an edit is refused with `PlanLocked`. The canvas shows `PlanStrings.lockedHint` (Task 9's word) near its bottom edge while it is set, ignoring the pointer, and clears it `kLockHintDuration` (2 s) after it was set.

Plan decision (**`snapping`**): the canvas option writes Task 8's `@internal bool PlanController.snappingAllowed` in `initState` and `didUpdateWidget`; the controller's effective object-snap flag (Task 8's `EffectiveSnap`, the one the `ToolContext`'s `SnapSettings` and `PlanServices.objectSnap` read) is `snappingAllowed && snap.objectSnap`, today's `_CapabilitySnap` (`planner_shell.dart:1756-1777`).

```dart
/// A document with two ACI 7 lines (ByLayer, layer 0) and, unless [paper]
/// is null, a 1:20 page of that background with the grid off, its origin
/// at ([originX], [originY]). Null [paper] is the page-less document a file
/// saved without a page decodes to. Units are millimetres, as
/// `prepareDocument` set them (`floor_plan/lib/src/new_document.dart:18-24`).
({DraftDocument doc, Handle selected, Handle ink}) paletteDoc(
    TextMeasurer measurer,
    {required int? paper,
    double originX = sheetMinX,
    double originY = sheetMinY}) {
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: measurer);
  PageComponent.register(doc.components);
  doc.header.units = DrawingUnits.millimeters;
  if (paper != null) {
    doc.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
        doc.rootHandle,
        PageComponent(
            scaleDenominator: 20,
            originX: originX,
            originY: originY,
            background: paper,
            gridVisible: false,
            snapToGrid: false)));
  }
  Handle line(double y) {
    final add = addDrafted(doc, EntityKind.line,
        linePayload(Vector2(lineX0, y), Vector2(lineX1, y)),
        layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero);
    doc.commands.execute(add);
    return add.record.handle;
  }

  final selected = line(selectedY);
  final ink = line(inkY);
  doc.commands.clearHistory();
  expect(doc.entities.colorAt(doc.entities.slotOf(ink)!), kByLayer);
  expect(doc.tables.layers[ReservedHandles.layerZero]!.color,
      const IndexedColor(7));
  return (doc: doc, selected: selected, ink: ink);
}

/// [paletteDoc] as a plan's text: [extra] draws on it, then it is encoded
/// with the empty manifest an imported drawing gets (Task 7). The two
/// lines' handles survive the encoding.
({String json, Handle selected, Handle ink}) paletteText(
    {required int? paper,
    double originX = sheetMinX,
    double originY = sheetMinY,
    void Function(DraftDocument doc)? extra}) {
  final m = FlutterTextMeasurer();
  final f = paletteDoc(m, paper: paper, originX: originX, originY: originY);
  extra?.call(f.doc);
  f.doc.commands.clearHistory();
  final json = ensureManifest(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(f.doc));
  unawaited(f.doc.dispose());
  m.clear();
  return (json: json, selected: f.selected, ink: f.ink);
}

/// A controller with no kit over [paletteText]. Disposed at the end of the
/// test.
({PlanController c, Handle selected, Handle ink}) paletteController(
    {required int? paper, void Function(DraftDocument doc)? extra}) {
  final t = paletteText(paper: paper, extra: extra);
  final c = PlanController(kits: const [], json: t.json);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return (c: c, selected: t.selected, ink: t.ink);
}

/// Pumps [c]'s canvas alone, in a Scaffold, under the seed's themes in
/// [mode], at 1440 x 900 and device pixel ratio 1.
Future<void> pumpCanvas(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, ThemeMode mode,
    {bool rulers = true}) async {
  windowAt(tester, const Size(1440, 900));
  await pumpThemed(
      tester, Scaffold(body: PlanCanvas(controller: c, rulers: rulers)), mode);
  await tester.pump();
}

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `drawDoc` (`:16-32`) as a plan: a 1:20 page
/// anchored at (7000, 3000), grid snap off, its background [background],
/// and one line to select.
({PlanController c, Handle line}) drawController({int background = white}) {
  final m = FlutterTextMeasurer();
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: m);
  PageComponent.register(doc.components);
  doc.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
      doc.rootHandle,
      PageComponent(
          scaleDenominator: 20,
          originX: 7000,
          originY: 3000,
          background: background,
          snapToGrid: false)));
  final add = addDrafted(doc, EntityKind.line,
      linePayload(Vector2(7137.3, 3161.7), Vector2(7300.9, 3190.1)),
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero);
  doc.commands.execute(add);
  doc.commands.clearHistory();
  final json = ensureManifest(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc));
  unawaited(doc.dispose());
  m.clear();
  final c = PlanController(kits: const [], json: json);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return (c: c, line: add.record.handle);
}

/// A controller over a document with no page and nothing drawn.
PlanController pagelessController() {
  final m = FlutterTextMeasurer();
  final doc = DraftDocument.empty(measurer: m);
  final json = ensureManifest(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(doc));
  unawaited(doc.dispose());
  m.clear();
  final c = PlanController(kits: const [], json: json);
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `pumpDraw` (`:38-53`): pumps [c]'s canvas
/// (inside [frame] when given: Tasks 16 and 17 put the palette, the panels
/// and the shortcuts around it), then sets a zoomed, rotated,
/// **non-reflecting** camera centred on (7150, 3110).
Future<void> pumpDraw(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c,
    {Widget Function(Widget canvas)? frame}) async {
  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1440, 900));
  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
  final canvas = PlanCanvas(controller: c);
  await tester.pumpWidget(
      MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: frame?.call(canvas) ?? canvas)));
  await tester.pump();
  final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
  final linear = Transform2.rotation(0.35).multiply(Transform2.scale(2.0, 2.0));
  final mid = linear.transformPoint(Vector2(7150, 3110));
  c.camera.value = ViewportTransform(
      worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2.translation(
              size.width / 2 - mid.x, size.height / 2 - mid.y)
          .multiply(linear));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `globalOf` (`:55-58`).
Offset globalOf(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c, double x, double y) {
  final s = c.camera.value.worldToScreen(Vector2(x, y));
  return tester.getTopLeft(find.byType(InteractionLayer)) + Offset(s.x, s.y);
}

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `bytes` and `withoutSeed` (`:69-75`).
String bytes(PlanController c) =>
    DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(c.document);

Map<String, Object?> withoutSeed(PlanController c) =>
    (jsonDecode(bytes(c)) as Map<String, Object?>)..remove('handleSeed');

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `entryEditable` and `ofKind` (`:79-87`).
final Finder entryEditable = find.descendant(
    of: find.byKey(const Key('text-entry')),
    matching: find.byType(EditableText));

List<Handle> ofKind(DraftDocument doc, EntityKind kind) => [
      for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots)
        if (doc.entities.kindAt(slot) == kind) doc.entities.handleAt(slot),
    ];

/// The active tool with Task 11's guarding decorator taken off, for a test
/// that reads a drawing tool's own state.
Tool activeTool(PlanController c) {
  final t = c.toolController.active;
  return t is GuardedTool ? t.inner : t;
}
```

```dart
/// The six numbers of [v]'s world-to-screen matrix.
List<double> m(ViewportTransform v) {
  final t = v.worldToScreenMatrix;
  return [t.a, t.b, t.c, t.d, t.e, t.f];
}

Future<void> pumpAlone(WidgetTester tester, Widget body) async {
  windowAt(tester, const Size(1200, 700));
  await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: body)));
  await tester.pump();
}

/// [c]'s page fitted to the drawing area, clamped as every fit is.
List<double> pageFit(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c) {
  final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
  final page =
      c.document.components.get<PageComponent>(c.document.rootHandle)!;
  return m(clampCameraScale(fitToPage(page, size), size,
      minScale: c.camera.minScale, maxScale: c.camera.maxScale));
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: The invariant.** Create `test/invariants/canvas_paint_allocation_test.dart`:

```dart
// What a steady-state frame of the plan library's canvas allocates
// (CLAUDE.md: "The frame path allocates nothing per entity in steady state,
// and O(1) per flush"; spec 2a "Tests": a paint-allocation test for the
// plan library's canvas).
//
// The drawing is the Flutter layer's DraftCanvas, whose own frame path
// jet_cad_2d_flutter/test/invariants/paint_allocation_test.dart measures:
// once a frame has drawn its widest view, the vertices sink never gives
// capacity back, so `debugCapacityVertices` holds still across a later
// frame or it does not, and `flush` reuses one Paint. What the plan library
// adds is the composition around it: PlanCanvas rebuilds (a controller
// notification, a theme, a parent's build) must hand DraftCanvas the same
// resolver, document, index and camera, or DraftCanvas re-attaches
// (`draft_canvas.dart:443-462`): a new DraftPainter, a new sink, every
// cache made again, which is O(entities) per rebuild. So the frames below
// rebuild PlanCanvas every frame and pin: the same DraftCanvasState, the
// same painter, the same sink, a capacity that holds still and the same
// Paint. The plan library paints nothing per entity of its own: the
// overlay, the rulers and the page chrome are the Flutter layer's.
//
// The corpus is the Flutter layer's (4,000 entities, 400 instances nested
// two deep, mirrored and non-uniform placements, groups, eight layers,
// ByBlock and dashed styles), loaded through PlanController from its text,
// with 50 root entities selected so the overlay draws outlines and grips.
// The two cameras differ by one pixel of pan, off the origin.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/testing.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/file/plan_file.dart' show ensureManifest;

void main() {
  testWidgets(
      'CV-alloc a rebuilt steady-state PlanCanvas frame allocates O(1) per '
      'flush, not O(entities) (M-CV-alloc-1, M-CV-alloc-2)', (tester) async {
    final corpus = generateDocument(
      4000,
      definitionCount: 40,
      instanceCount: 400,
      nestingDepth: 2,
      mirroredFraction: 0.1,
      nonUniformFraction: 0.2,
      groupCount: 10,
      layerCount: 8,
      byBlockFraction: 0.3,
      dashedFraction: 0.35,
    );
    final json = ensureManifest(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(corpus));
    final c = PlanController(kits: const [], json: json);
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1440, 900));
    addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
    await tester.pumpWidget(
        MaterialApp(home: Scaffold(body: PlanCanvas(controller: c))));
    await tester.pump();

    final doc = c.document;
    final roots = [
      for (final slot in doc.entities.liveSlots)
        if (doc.entities.ownerAt(slot) == doc.rootHandle)
          doc.entities.handleAt(slot),
    ].take(50).toList();
    expect(roots, hasLength(50), reason: 'premise: root entities to select');
    c.selection.replace([for (final h in roots) SelectionKey.root(h)]);

    final size = tester.getSize(find.byType(InteractionLayer));
    final a = ViewportTransform.fit(doc.extents, size);
    final b = ViewportTransform(
        worldToScreenMatrix:
            Transform2.translation(1, -1).multiply(a.worldToScreenMatrix));
    Future<void> frames(int n) async {
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        c.camera.value = i.isEven ? a : b;
        tester.element(find.byType(PlanCanvas)).markNeedsBuild();
        await tester.pump();
      }
    }

    // Warm up: both views drawn, so the buffers are at their high water.
    await frames(6);
    final state = tester.state<DraftCanvasState>(find.byType(DraftCanvas));
    final painter = state.painter;
    final sink = state.vertices!;
    final capacity = sink.debugCapacityVertices;
    final paint = sink.debugPaint;
    sink.resetCounters();

    await frames(10);

    expect(sink.totalFlushCount, greaterThan(0),
        reason: 'nothing was flushed, so nothing was measured');
    expect(sink.frameTriangleCount, greaterThan(1000),
        reason: 'a degenerate corpus would make the bound meaningless');
    // M-CV-alloc-2: a key that changes per build remounts the canvas.
    expect(
        identical(
            tester.state<DraftCanvasState>(find.byType(DraftCanvas)), state),
        isTrue,
        reason: 'a rebuild remounted DraftCanvas');
    // M-CV-alloc-1: a resolver made per build rebuilds the painter.
    expect(identical(state.painter, painter), isTrue,
        reason: 'a rebuild handed DraftCanvas a new resolver: a new painter '
            'and every cache made again');
    expect(identical(state.vertices, sink), isTrue);
    expect(sink.debugCapacityVertices, capacity,
        reason: 'the buffer grew in a steady-state frame: O(entities)');
    expect(identical(sink.debugPaint, paint), isTrue,
        reason: 'flush() must reuse the one Paint of the sink\'s life');
  });
}
```

```dart
// The keys a text field inside the plan keeps (spec 2a P2, "The keyboard":
// text fields keep their keys, and the guard is built from the letters
// actually in use, not from today's fixed list of 16). Ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/shortcut_guard.dart: ShellShortcutGuard
// becomes PlanShortcutGuard, whose letters come from planLetterKeys;
// PlannerTextKeys becomes PlanTextKeys, unchanged.
import 'package:flutter/services.dart'
    show HardwareKeyboard, KeyEvent, KeyUpEvent, LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import '../tools/generic_tools.dart';
import 'chords.dart';

export 'chords.dart';

/// The key of an upper-case Latin [letter] (`'A'`..`'Z'`).
LogicalKeyboardKey letterKey(String letter) => LogicalKeyboardKey(
    LogicalKeyboardKey.keyA.keyId + letter.codeUnitAt(0) - 0x41);

/// The letters [controller]'s keyboard binds, F included (spec 2a P2: F is
/// reserved for Fill). Here the generic tools' (V L P R C A T); Task 16
/// adds the kits' letters in load order.
List<LogicalKeyboardKey> planLetterKeys(PlanController controller) => [
      for (final t in genericTools) letterKey(t.letter),
      LogicalKeyboardKey.keyF,
    ];

/// Spec 05 D9, Ruling 05-8, spec 2a P2. Ported from `ShellShortcutGuard`
/// (`shortcut_guard.dart:27-67`).
///
/// **Why this exists.** A `Shortcuts` or `CallbackShortcuts` above a text
/// field takes the field's keystrokes. PlanShortcuts' tool letters, its
/// Undo and Redo chords and its Escape are such shortcuts.
///
/// **What it does.** It maps each of them, **nearer** the field, to
/// `DoNothingAndStopPropagationTextIntent`. `EditableText` answers that
/// intent with `DoNothingAction(consumesKey: false)`, so the key stops here
/// and reaches the field as text.
///
/// **Elsewhere it is inert.** With focus anywhere other than a text field,
/// no action is found, and the key bubbles up to the shortcuts as before.
class PlanShortcutGuard extends StatelessWidget {
  const PlanShortcutGuard(
      {super.key, required this.controller, required this.child});

  /// Whose letters in use are guarded.
  final PlanController controller;
  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Shortcuts(
        shortcuts: <ShortcutActivator, Intent>{
          for (final key in planLetterKeys(controller))
            SingleActivator(key): const DoNothingAndStopPropagationTextIntent(),
          // Undo and Redo: in a focused field they never reach the
          // document. A SingleActivator matches its modifiers exactly, so
          // each chord is listed. The file chords are not guarded: Cmd+S in
          // a panel field saves.
          for (final chord in [...kUndoChords, ...kRedoChords])
            chord: const DoNothingAndStopPropagationTextIntent(),
          // PlanShortcuts binds Escape too: in a panel's field it must not
          // drop a pending shape. The text entry's own Escape binding sits
          // nearer, so it still cancels there.
          const SingleActivator(LogicalKeyboardKey.escape):
              const DoNothingAndStopPropagationTextIntent(),
        },
        child: child,
      );
}
```

  followed by the copied `PlanTextKeys` and `_TypingActivator` (`:69-138` with the doc comment's "[ShellShortcutGuard]" read as "[PlanShortcutGuard]").

- [ ] **Step 11: The canvas.** Create `lib/src/canvas/plan_canvas.dart`:

```dart
// The plan's canvas (spec 2a P2, "The widgets"): the rulers, the camera
// gestures, the interaction layer, the page chrome, the drawing, the
// selection and grip overlay and the text entry, over one PlanController,
// which is all it takes.
//
// Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan: the paper, the ink and the resolver from
// planner_shell.dart (:281-382), the canvas colour (:367-368), the
// fit-on-start latch from host/floor_plan_view.dart (:507, :595-602), and
// the view itself (PlanCanvasView, planner_view.dart). New: the one-canvas
// rule, the controller's document swap, the locale push, the snapping
// option and the lock hint (spec P4, "Where PlanLocked is caught").
import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/scheduler.dart' show SchedulerBinding;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart';

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import '../l10n/locale_scope.dart';
import '../l10n/strings.dart';
import '../theme/plan_theme.dart' show PlanTheme, planPaperPaletteFor;
import 'plan_canvas_view.dart';

/// How long the canvas shows the lock hint before it clears it.
const Duration kLockHintDuration = Duration(seconds: 2);

/// Draws [controller]'s plan and routes the pointer and the keys to its
/// active tool.
///
/// - The plan is fitted to the drawing area on its first frame, and again
///   on the first frame of each plan `load`, `newPlan` or `import` swaps in.
/// - A controller is shown in one PlanCanvas at a time: a second one
///   asserts in debug, after the frame.
/// - [rulers] and [grid] are the drafting aids; [snapping] lets object snap
///   act (the user's F3 setting is kept either way); [autofocus] lets the
///   canvas take the focus when it is mounted.
class PlanCanvas extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlanCanvas({
    super.key,
    required this.controller,
    this.rulers = true,
    this.grid = true,
    this.snapping = true,
    this.autofocus = true,
  });

  final PlanController controller;
  final bool rulers;
  final bool grid;
  final bool snapping;
  final bool autofocus;

  @override
  State<PlanCanvas> createState() => _PlanCanvasState();
}

/// The canvases each controller is shown in, for the one-canvas rule
/// (debug only).
final Expando<Set<Object>> _canvasesOf = Expando<Set<Object>>('PlanCanvas');

class _PlanCanvasState extends State<PlanCanvas> {
  PlanController get _c => widget.controller;

  /// The document the resolver, the page listener and the fit latch belong
  /// to; [_bind] moves them to the controller's current one.
  DraftDocument? _document;
  PageNotifier? _page;

  /// ACI 7's foreground follows the paper (planner_shell.dart:281-299):
  /// replaced only when its key ([_foreground], [_darkCanvas]) changes, as
  /// DraftCanvas rebuilds its painter whenever it is handed a different
  /// resolver.
  late StyleResolver _resolver;
  int _foreground = -1;
  bool _darkCanvas = false;

  /// The theme's surface (or the theme's `canvasBackground`) and
  /// brightness; set in [didChangeDependencies].
  late int _surfaceArgb;
  late Brightness _brightness;
  PlanTheme? _theme;

  final GesturePolicy _policy = GesturePolicy.forPlatform();

  /// floor_plan_view.dart:507, :595-602: the fit-on-start latch, taken once
  /// per document.
  DraftDocument? _fitFor;
  bool _fit = false;
  bool _fitIsRequest = false;

  Timer? _hintTimer;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    _enter(_c);
    _c.addListener(_onController);
    _c.lockHint.addListener(_onHint);
    _c.snappingAllowed = widget.snapping;
    _bind();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    _theme = PlanTheme.of(context);
    _surfaceArgb = _canvasColour(theme.colorScheme).toARGB32();
    _brightness = theme.brightness;
    // A build follows, so no setState: only a key change builds a new
    // resolver (planner_shell.dart:371-382).
    if (_nextResolver() case final next?) _resolver = next;
    PlanLocaleScope.push(context, _c);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PlanCanvas oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    final old = oldWidget.controller;
    if (!identical(old, _c)) {
      _leave(old);
      old.removeListener(_onController);
      old.lockHint.removeListener(_onHint);
      _hintTimer?.cancel();
      _enter(_c);
      _c.addListener(_onController);
      _c.lockHint.addListener(_onHint);
      _rebind();
      PlanLocaleScope.push(context, _c);
    }
    _c.snappingAllowed = widget.snapping;
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _leave(_c);
    _c.removeListener(_onController);
    _c.lockHint.removeListener(_onHint);
    _page?.removeListener(_onPage);
    _hintTimer?.cancel();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// Spec 2a P2: a controller is shown in one PlanCanvas at a time. Checked
  /// after the frame, when a replaced canvas has been disposed (a keyed
  /// swap inflates the new canvas before it deactivates the old one).
  void _enter(PlanController c) {
    assert(() {
      (_canvasesOf[c] ??= <Object>{}).add(this);
      SchedulerBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
        final shown = _canvasesOf[c];
        if (shown != null && shown.length > 1) {
          throw FlutterError(
              'A PlanController is shown in one PlanCanvas at a time '
              '(spec 2a P2): this controller is in ${shown.length}. Dispose '
              'the first canvas before showing the controller in another.');
        }
      });
      return true;
    }());
  }

  void _leave(PlanController c) {
    assert(() {
      _canvasesOf[c]?.remove(this);
      return true;
    }());
  }

  /// Binds the page listener to the controller's current document.
  void _bind() {
    _document = _c.document;
    _page = _c.page..addListener(_onPage);
  }

  /// A new document (load, newPlan, import) or a new controller: the page
  /// listener moves, and the resolver is made again for the new document.
  void _rebind() {
    _page?.removeListener(_onPage);
    _bind();
    _foreground = -1;
    _resolver = _nextResolver()!;
  }

  /// The controller notified: a document swap rebuilds the canvas; any
  /// other notification (permissions, the locale) is not the canvas's.
  void _onController() {
    if (identical(_c.document, _document)) return;
    setState(_rebind);
  }

  /// planner_shell.dart:344-363, less the table fills (2b): a page change
  /// that moves the resolver's key rebuilds with a new resolver.
  void _onPage() {
    final next = _nextResolver();
    if (next == null) return;
    setState(() => _resolver = next);
  }

  /// planner_shell.dart:328-331: the paper the drafting and the overlays
  /// lie on.
  int _paperArgb() => displayPaperFor(
      page: _c.page.value?.background,
      surface: _surfaceArgb,
      brightness: _brightness);

  /// planner_shell.dart:334-343: a new resolver when the key moved, else
  /// null; records the new key.
  StyleResolver? _nextResolver() {
    final paper = _paperArgb();
    final foreground = foregroundFor(paper);
    final dark =
        darkCanvasFor(page: _c.page.value?.background, brightness: _brightness);
    if (foreground == _foreground && dark == _darkCanvas) return null;
    _foreground = foreground;
    _darkCanvas = dark;
    return canvasResolverFor(_c.document, paper: paper, dark: dark);
  }

  /// planner_shell.dart:367-368: the theme's `canvasBackground`, else its
  /// surface.
  Color _canvasColour(ColorScheme scheme) =>
      _theme?.canvasBackground ?? scheme.surface;

  /// floor_plan_view.dart:595-602.
  bool _fitOnStartFor(DraftDocument document) {
    if (!identical(_fitFor, document)) {
      _fitFor = document;
      _fitIsRequest = !_c.owesFirstFit;
      _fit = _c.takeFitOnStart();
    }
    return _fit;
  }

  /// Spec P4: the hint clears [kLockHintDuration] after it was set.
  void _onHint() {
    _hintTimer?.cancel();
    if (!_c.lockHint.value) return;
    final c = _c;
    _hintTimer = Timer(kLockHintDuration, () {
      if (mounted && identical(c, _c)) c.lockHint.value = false;
    });
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final scheme = theme.colorScheme;
    final c = _c;
    final document = c.document;
    // A parent rebuild may arrive before the controller's notification.
    if (!identical(document, _document)) _rebind();
    final paper = _paperArgb();
    return ColoredBox(
      color: _canvasColour(scheme),
      child: Stack(
        fit: StackFit.expand,
        children: [
          PlanCanvasView(
            // A new document is a new view: its own first fit, its own
            // listeners (today's PlannerShell keyed by ObjectKey(document)).
            key: ObjectKey(document),
            controller: c,
            document: document,
            index: c.index,
            resolver: _resolver,
            camera: c.camera,
            page: c.page,
            policy: _policy,
            selection: c.selection,
            tools: c.toolController,
            outlines: c.outlines,
            chrome: ChromePalette.of(theme.brightness),
            paper: planPaperPaletteFor(paper, _theme),
            selectionStrokePixels:
                _theme?.selectionWidth ?? kSelectionStrokePixels,
            sheetArgb: _darkCanvas ? paper : null,
            grips: c.grips,
            textTool: c.textTool,
            fitRequests: c.fitRequests,
            fitOnStart: _fitOnStartFor(document),
            startFitIsRequest: _fitIsRequest,
            onFitted: c.fitted,
            framing: c.framingFor,
            cameraEpoch: () => c.cameraEpoch,
            onCanvasPlaced: c.canvasPlaced,
            rulers: widget.rulers,
            grid: widget.grid,
            autofocus: widget.autofocus,
          ),
          ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
            valueListenable: c.lockHint,
            builder: (context, shown, _) => shown
                ? Align(
                    alignment: const Alignment(0, 0.9),
                    child: IgnorePointer(
                      child: DecoratedBox(
                        key: const Key('plan-lock-hint'),
                        decoration: BoxDecoration(
                            color: scheme.inverseSurface,
                            borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(4)),
                        child: Padding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                              horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),
                          child: Text(PlanStrings.of(context).lockedHint,
                              style:
                                  TextStyle(color: scheme.onInverseSurface)),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                  )
                : const SizedBox.shrink(),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

```

**Interfaces:**

  - `PlanKit.tools`, `PlanTool` (`id`, `icon`, `letter`, `needs`), `KitNames.word`, `kitOfKey`, `KitDiagnostic`, `KitDiagnosticCode.letterTaken` from `package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart` (Task 4 and sub-project 1).

  - Tasks 8, 9: see "Assumed from earlier tasks".
- Produces:
  - Exported from the barrel:
    - `class PlanToolPalette extends StatefulWidget` — `const PlanToolPalette({Key? key, required PlanController controller})`.
    - `class PlanShortcuts extends StatefulWidget` — `const PlanShortcuts({Key? key, required PlanController controller, required Widget child, bool shortcuts = true, Future<void> Function()? onNew, Future<void> Function()? onOpen, Future<void> Function()? onSave, Future<void> Function()? onSaveAs, Future<void> Function()? onExport, Future<void> Function()? onPrint})`.
    - `PlanShortcutGuard` (Task 15's), so a host that composes its own layout guards its own text fields.
  - Internal: `final class PlanToolEntry` (`id`, `kitId`, `icon`, `needs`, `letter`, `key`); `List<PlanToolEntry> planToolEntries(PlanController controller)`; `const String kPlanKitId = 'plan'`; `String planToolLabel(BuildContext context, PlanController controller, String toolId)` (Task 20's status line reuses it); `bool fillOffered(PlanController controller)`; `planLetterKeys` now returns the letters in use.

Plan decision (**the letters are the controller's**): which tool has which letter depends only on the kit set, which a controller fixes at construction. `planToolEntries(controller)` computes the entries once per controller (an `Expando`), and the controller's constructor calls it, so a `letterTaken` diagnostic (spec P2, A3) is in `controller.diagnostics` before any widget is built. The palette, `PlanShortcuts` and every guard read the same list.

Plan decision (**which letters**): the generic tools keep V L P R C A T (Task 12's `genericTools`); F is reserved for Fill whether or not Fill is offered; a kit tool's `letter` is upper-cased, and must then be one Latin letter A-Z. A kit tool asking for a letter already given (to a generic tool or an earlier kit's tool), for F, or for something that is no letter, gets none and one `letterTaken` diagnostic (subject: the tool id; the message names the owner). Keys a tool handles itself while active (Enter, Delete, R and M of `plan.symbol`) are not letters and never conflict (spec P2).

Plan decision (**the binding rules**, today's, `planner_shell.dart:1444-1469`, with the capabilities read from `PlanPermissions`):
- `shortcuts: false` binds nothing and closes the select tool's idle keys (`PlanSelectGates.idleKeys`, Task 12), so every key reaches the host (host embedding spec C-7, S-16). The setting is re-applied after every document swap, since the gates are per document.
- File chords (New, Open, Save, Save As) are bound when the host gave the callback; Export and Print also need their flag. A bound chord whose command cannot act now (a shape part-way, or no page for Export and Print) consumes the key and does nothing (S-26).
- Undo and Redo are bound while `permissions.undo`; they call `controller.undo()` / `redo()`, which do nothing mid-shape (Task 8).
- F3 is bound while `controller.snappingAllowed` (Task 8's flag, written by Task 15's canvas); F while a fill tool is offered (`polyline`, `rectangle`, `circle`), toggling only while geometry is allowed; Escape always, arming `plan.select` from an idle tool.
- A letter is bound while its tool is allowed by `permissions.allowsTool`; `controller.selectTool` still refuses a tool whose needs the document's permissions refuse (Task 12), as today's `_activate` refused it under `runtime`.

Plan decision (**the palette's rows**): the generic tools, then each kit's tools in load order, a `Divider` keyed `tool-group-<kit id>` before each kit's group; each row keyed `tool-<tool id>`, with the tool's icon, its label (`planToolLabel`: `PlanStrings` for the generic ids, the kit's `tool:<id>` word in `controller.locale` with English fallback, the id as the last resort), its letter, selected while it is the active tool, enabled exactly when `selectTool` would arm it (allowed by the permissions, and every need allowed by the document's engine permissions, Task 12's `_allowsTool` rule over `needsOf`). The Fill row follows (`tool-fill`), shown while a fill tool is offered. The palette never takes focus (`ExcludeFocus`, Ruling 05-6) and pushes the locale (Task 9's `PlanLocaleScope`).

Ported tests and where the others go: `floor_plan/test/planner_draw_test.dart`'s palette and keyboard cases come here (Step 13); its page-panel cases (`A9`, `A14`, `A15`, `A18`, `A19`, `A23`-`A26`) need the Page panel and go to Task 18; `A16` and `A27` read the bar's OSNAP and zoom read-outs (Task 20); `A7`, `A17`, `A20`-`A22` are Task 15's. `floor_plan/test/host/keyboard_focus_test.dart` drives tables, `tablesOnly`, the Wall tool and `FloorPlanView`'s two modes: its generic behaviours are pinned here by new tests modelled on it (KB-3 on T6-b, KB-4 on "a gesture's keys stay", KB-10 on T6-a), with their own named mutations; its table and service cases are 2b's. `floor_plan/test/host/host_text_keys_test.dart`: the host-field cases are ported (Step 13); its panel-field cases go with their panels (Tasks 13, 17, 18); "the canvas focused: Delete, Backspace, W, K, 1, Space and Enter each fire the host's intent" asserts a table selection and is covered by KB-3. `floor_plan/test/planner_palette_test.dart` (the canvas's colour palettes) is Task 15's.

- [ ] **Step 2: The harness.** Create `test/support/design_harness.dart`:

```dart
// The design composition a host builds from the widgets (spec 2a P2): the
// keyboard around a status line, the palette, the canvas and an optional
// right column, over one controller, under the drawing fixture's rotated,
// zoomed camera (canvas_fixture.dart's pumpDraw). A host's own bindings
// sit above it and count every key that reaches them. The status line is
// the active tool's palette label (today's status text, less the
// selection count, which is Task 20's bar).
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show InteractionLayer;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/editor/plan_tool_palette.dart'
    show planToolLabel;

import 'canvas_fixture.dart';

/// What the host saw: the keys that reached its bindings, by name, and its
/// file callbacks' calls.
final class Design {
  Design(this.c, bool shortcuts) : shortcuts = ValueNotifier(shortcuts);

  final PlanController c;

  /// `PlanShortcuts.shortcuts`, changeable at runtime.
  final ValueNotifier<bool> shortcuts;
  final Map<String, int> reached = {};
  int news = 0, opens = 0, saves = 0, saveAses = 0, exports = 0, prints = 0;
}

/// Pumps the composition over [c]: [hostKeys] are the host's bindings
/// above the plan (by name); [hostField] puts a host text field, guarded
/// as a host guards its own fields, beside the status line; [right] is the
/// right column (Task 17's property panel); [host] wraps the plan in a
/// host's own `Shortcuts`/`Actions`/`Focus`.
Future<Design> pumpDesign(WidgetTester tester, PlanController c,
    {bool shortcuts = true,
    Map<String, SingleActivator> hostKeys = const {},
    bool hostField = false,
    Widget? right,
    Widget Function(Widget plan)? host}) async {
  final d = Design(c, shortcuts);
  addTearDown(d.shortcuts.dispose);
  for (final name in hostKeys.keys) {
    d.reached[name] = 0;
  }
  Widget frame(Widget canvas) {
    final plan = ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
      valueListenable: d.shortcuts,
      builder: (_, keys, __) => PlanShortcuts(
        controller: c,
        shortcuts: keys,
        onNew: () async => d.news++,
        onOpen: () async => d.opens++,
        onSave: () async => d.saves++,
        onSaveAs: () async => d.saveAses++,
        onExport: () async => d.exports++,
        onPrint: () async => d.prints++,
        child: Column(children: [
          SizedBox(
            height: 40,
            child: Row(children: [
              Expanded(child: StatusLine(controller: c)),
              if (hostField)
                SizedBox(
                    width: 160,
                    child: PlanShortcutGuard(
                        controller: c,
                        child: const TextField(key: Key('host-field')))),
            ]),
          ),
          Expanded(
            child: Row(children: [
              SizedBox(width: 240, child: PlanToolPalette(controller: c)),
              Expanded(child: canvas),
              if (right != null)
                SizedBox(
                    width: 280, child: SingleChildScrollView(child: right)),
            ]),
          ),
        ]),
      ),
    );
    final hosted = host?.call(plan) ?? plan;
    return CallbackShortcuts(
      bindings: {
        for (final MapEntry(key: name, value: chord) in hostKeys.entries)
          chord: () => d.reached[name] = d.reached[name]! + 1,
      },
      child: hosted,
    );
  }

  await pumpDraw(tester, c, frame: frame);
  return d;
}

/// The active tool's palette label, keyed `status-text`.
class StatusLine extends StatelessWidget {
  const StatusLine({super.key, required this.controller});

  final PlanController controller;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ValueListenableBuilder<String>(
        valueListenable: controller.activeTool,
        builder: (context, id, _) => Text(
            planToolLabel(context, controller, id),
            key: const Key('status-text')),
      );
}

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `status` (`:60-61`).
String status(WidgetTester tester) =>
    tester.widget<Text>(find.byKey(const Key('status-text'))).data!;

/// `planner_draw_test.dart`'s `press` (`:63-67`): whether a handler took
/// the key.
Future<bool> press(WidgetTester tester, LogicalKeyboardKey key) async {
  final handled = await tester.sendKeyEvent(key);
  await tester.pump();
  return handled;
}

/// `keyboard_focus_test.dart`'s `sendActivator` (`:242-252`): [a]'s
/// modifiers down around its key.
Future<void> sendActivator(WidgetTester tester, SingleActivator a) async {
  if (a.control) await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.controlLeft);
  if (a.meta) await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.metaLeft);
  if (a.shift) await tester.sendKeyDownEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.shiftLeft);
  await tester.sendKeyEvent(a.trigger);
  if (a.shift) await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.shiftLeft);
  if (a.meta) await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.metaLeft);
  if (a.control) await tester.sendKeyUpEvent(LogicalKeyboardKey.controlLeft);
  await tester.pump();
}

/// The canvas's own focus node: the `Focus` the `InteractionLayer` builds.
FocusNode canvasFocus(WidgetTester tester) => tester
    .widget<Focus>(find
        .descendant(
            of: find.byType(InteractionLayer), matching: find.byType(Focus))
        .first)
    .focusNode!;

/// A click a little inside the canvas's top left (empty paper under the
/// fixture's camera): the canvas takes the focus.
Future<void> focusCanvas(WidgetTester tester) async {
  await tester
      .tapAt(tester.getTopLeft(find.byType(InteractionLayer)) + const Offset(6, 6));
  await tester.pump();
  expect(FocusManager.instance.primaryFocus, same(canvasFocus(tester)),
      reason: 'premise: the canvas focused');
}
```

```dart
// The palette's rows and the tool letters (spec 2a P2, "The keyboard" and
// "The widgets"): the generic tools first, with today's letters (V L P R C
// A T), then each kit's tools in load order. F is reserved for Fill. A
// kit's letter goes to the first tool that asks for it; a later tool that
// asks for a taken letter, for F, or for something that is no letter A-Z
// gets none and a letterTaken diagnostic (A3). plan.symbol has no row and
// no letter: the gallery arms it.
import 'package:flutter/services.dart' show LogicalKeyboardKey;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show IconData;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart' show Capability;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:meta/meta.dart' show immutable;

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import '../tools/generic_tools.dart';
import 'plan_shortcut_guard.dart' show letterKey;

/// The kit id the plan library's own tools stand under (a reserved id).
const String kPlanKitId = 'plan';

/// One palette row and its letter.
@immutable
final class PlanToolEntry {
  const PlanToolEntry({
    required this.id,
    required this.kitId,
    required this.icon,
    required this.needs,
    this.letter,
  });

  final String id;

  /// [kPlanKitId] for a generic tool, else its kit's id.
  final String kitId;
  final IconData icon;

  /// What the tool's commits need (`PlanTool.needs`' meaning).
  final Set<Capability> needs;

  /// The letter given, upper case, or null.
  final String? letter;

  /// [letter]'s key, or null.
  LogicalKeyboardKey? get key => switch (letter) {
        final l? => letterKey(l),
        null => null,
      };
}

final Expando<List<PlanToolEntry>> _entriesOf =
    Expando<List<PlanToolEntry>>('planToolEntries');

/// [controller]'s rows in palette order, computed once per controller: its
/// kit set is fixed at construction. The first call reports the refused
/// letters.
List<PlanToolEntry> planToolEntries(PlanController controller) =>
    _entriesOf[controller] ??= _assign(controller);

final RegExp _aLetter = RegExp(r'^[A-Z]$');

List<PlanToolEntry> _assign(PlanController c) {
  // The letter → the tool (or Fill) that has it.
  final taken = <String, String>{'F': 'Fill'};
  final out = <PlanToolEntry>[];
  for (final g in genericTools) {
    taken[g.letter] = g.id;
    out.add(PlanToolEntry(
        id: g.id,
        kitId: kPlanKitId,
        icon: g.icon,
        needs: g.needs,
        letter: g.letter));
  }
  for (final kit in c.kits.kits) {
    for (final t in kit.tools) {
      final asked = t.letter?.toUpperCase();
      String? letter;
      if (asked != null) {
        final owner = taken[asked];
        if (!_aLetter.hasMatch(asked)) {
          _refuse(c, kit, t, '"${t.letter}" is not a letter A-Z');
        } else if (owner != null) {
          _refuse(c, kit, t, 'the letter $asked is taken by $owner');
        } else {
          taken[asked] = t.id;
          letter = asked;
        }
      }
      out.add(PlanToolEntry(
          id: t.id,
          kitId: kit.id,
          icon: t.icon,
          needs: t.needs,
          letter: letter));
    }
  }
  return List<PlanToolEntry>.unmodifiable(out);
}

void _refuse(PlanController c, PlanKit kit, PlanTool tool, String why) =>
    c.diagnosticsLog.report(KitDiagnostic(
        kitId: kit.id,
        subject: tool.id,
        code: KitDiagnosticCode.letterTaken,
        message: '${tool.id} gets no letter: $why'));
```

```dart
/// The letters [controller]'s keyboard binds, F included (spec 2a P2: the
/// guard is built from the letters actually in use; F is reserved for
/// Fill): the generic tools' and the kits' given letters, in palette order.
List<LogicalKeyboardKey> planLetterKeys(PlanController controller) => [
      for (final e in planToolEntries(controller))
        if (e.key case final key?) key,
      LogicalKeyboardKey.keyF,
```
