```dart
// Spec 12b D9, D10, D11 and 2a spec P2: the Layers section of the right
// panel, over a PlanController. Ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/layers/layer_panel.dart.
import 'dart:async' show StreamSubscription;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show PageNotifier, displayPaperFor;

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import '../l10n/locale_scope.dart';
import '../l10n/numbered_names.dart';
import '../l10n/strings.dart';
import '../l10n/strings_en.dart';
import '../theme/plan_theme.dart';
import 'layer_row.dart';

// <layer_panel.dart:12-50 here: kLayerListVisibleRows, layersInPanelOrder,
//  nextLayerName, with PlanStrings / PlanStringsEn>

/// The Layers section (spec 12b D9) of [controller]'s plan: a collapsible
/// list of every layer, one [LayerRow] each, with + and delete below.
///
/// **No copy of the layers.** Every build reads the controller's document;
/// the panel rebuilds on its `commands.changes`, its `tables.changes`, the
/// page (ACI 7's swatch follows the paper) and the controller (a document
/// swapped by `load`, `newPlan` or `import`, or new permissions), and moves
/// its subscriptions to a swapped-in document.
///
/// **Each user action is exactly one command**, through
/// `controller.execute`, which answers false for a refusal (`PlanLocked`,
/// `DanglingReferenceError`, `ArgumentError`, a kit's failure); a
/// `StateError` is caught here: nothing changed.
///
/// **Permissions:** every control is disabled while the controller's
/// `permissions.editLayers` is false or the document's permissions refuse
/// [Capability.structure] (D11); the list is still shown.
class PlanLayerPanel extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlanLayerPanel({super.key, required this.controller});

  final PlanController controller;

  @override
  State<PlanLayerPanel> createState() => PlanLayerPanelState();
}

class PlanLayerPanelState extends State<PlanLayerPanel> {
  StreamSubscription<DocChange>? _changes;

  /// The document and page notifier the subscriptions are on.
  DraftDocument? _bound;
  PageNotifier? _boundPage;

  /// Whether the list is shown. Per session, not stored.
  bool _open = true;

  /// The selected row's layer (for delete), or null.
  Handle? _selected;

  /// The layer whose name field is open, or null.
  Handle? _editing;

  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();

  /// Whether the list is shown (the header toggles it).
  bool get isOpen => _open;

  /// The selected row's layer, or null.
  Handle? get selected => _selected;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.controller.addListener(_onController);
    _bind();
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    PlanLocaleScope.push(context, widget.controller);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PlanLayerPanel oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.controller, widget.controller)) {
      oldWidget.controller.removeListener(_onController);
      widget.controller.addListener(_onController);
      _bind();
      PlanLocaleScope.push(context, widget.controller);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.removeListener(_onController);
    _unbind();
    _scroll.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// A new document (load, newPlan, import) or new permissions: rebinds
  /// when the document is another one, rebuilds either way.
  void _onController() {
    if (!identical(_bound, widget.controller.document)) _bind();
    _refresh();
  }

  void _bind() {
    _unbind();
    final document = widget.controller.document;
    _bound = document;
    _changes = document.commands.changes.listen((_) => _refresh());
    document.tables.changes.addListener(_refresh);
    _boundPage = widget.controller.page..addListener(_refresh);
    _selected = null;
    _editing = null;
  }

  void _unbind() {
    _changes?.cancel();
    _changes = null;
    _bound?.tables.changes.removeListener(_refresh);
    _boundPage?.removeListener(_refresh);
    _bound = null;
    _boundPage = null;
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  DraftDocument get _doc => widget.controller.document;

  bool get _allowed =>
      widget.controller.permissions.editLayers &&
      _doc.commands.permissions.allows(Capability.structure);

  /// Executes [command] through the controller. A refusal is caught: the
  /// dispatcher, the parametric system or the lock expander rolled it
  /// back, so nothing changed, and no gesture surfaces an exception.
  /// Nothing while the panel may not edit: a menu opened before
  /// `editLayers` was turned off still answers after it.
  void _execute(DraftCommand command) {
    if (!_allowed) return;
    try {
      // False: refused (a lock, which raises the hint, a dangling
      // reference, an ArgumentError, a kit's failure); nothing changed.
      widget.controller.execute(command);
    } on StateError {
      // Refused by the dispatcher: nothing changed.
    }
  }

  /// ACI 7's ink on the paper the canvas shows (`planner_shell.dart:327-342`):
  /// the page's background, a dark canvas's paper, or the canvas
  /// background (the theme's surface) for a plan without a page.
  int _foreground(BuildContext context) {
    final theme = Theme.of(context);
    final surface = PlanTheme.of(context)?.canvasBackground ??
        theme.colorScheme.surface;
    return foregroundFor(displayPaperFor(
        page: widget.controller.page.value?.background,
        surface: surface.toARGB32(),
        brightness: theme.brightness));
  }

  // _update, _add, _delete, _deleteBlocked: layer_panel.dart:182-229
  // verbatim, with `FloorPlanStrings` -> `PlanStrings`.

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    // layer_panel.dart:233-352 verbatim, with three changes:
    // - `FloorPlanStrings.of(context)` -> `PlanStrings.of(context)` (:243,
    //   :310);
    // - `foreground: widget.foreground` (:286) -> `foreground: foreground`,
    //   after `final foreground = _foreground(context);` beside `:240`;
    // - `LayerRow(` (:279) gains `controller: widget.controller,`.
  }
}
```

The two comment blocks above stand for the source ranges named in them: the implementer copies those lines in their place, with exactly the substitutions listed, and the result has no `// layer_panel.dart` comments left.

```dart
// Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/layers/layer_picker.dart: "is a
// live object" is the catalog's (E1) in place of the floor planner's
// closed list (`isParametricObject`, :16-29), and a locked object refuses
// its layer change.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show SelectionKey;

/// Key [key]'s layer as the picker shows it (spec 12b D12), or null for a
/// plain group or a key that no longer resolves:
///
/// - an instance's own layer;
/// - an ATTRIB's: its owning instance's;
/// - a live parametric object's ([isObject]): its `objectLayer`;
/// - a drafted region's: its boundary's, whichever record was picked;
/// - any other root entity's: its own.
Handle? layerOfKey(DraftDocument doc, SelectionKey key,
    {required bool Function(Handle h) isObject}) {
  final h = key.target;
  final node = doc.tree[h];
  if (node is InstanceNode) return node.layer;
  if (node is GroupNode) return isObject(h) ? objectLayer(doc, h) : null;
  if (node != null) return null;
  final entities = doc.entities;
  final slot = entities.slotOf(h);
  if (slot == null) return null;
  if (_owningInstance(doc, slot) case final owner?) return owner.layer;
  final boundary = _boundaryOfFill(doc, slot);
  return entities.layerAt(boundary == null ? slot : entities.slotOf(boundary)!);
}

/// Whether [h], or a group or instance above it (its entity owner, then
/// the tree's parents up to the root), is locked.
bool _lockedOrUnderLock(
    DraftDocument doc, Handle h, bool Function(Handle h) isLocked) {
  if (isLocked(h)) return true;
  final slot = doc.entities.slotOf(h);
  Handle? up = slot != null ? doc.entities.ownerAt(slot) : doc.tree[h]?.parent;
  final root = doc.rootHandle;
  while (up != null && up != root) {
    if (isLocked(up)) return true;
    up = doc.tree[up]?.parent;
  }
  return false;
}

/// Why the picker is disabled for [keys] in [doc], or null when it is
/// enabled: a permission set without `Capability.components` (D11); a
/// locked object, or a key under one, among the keys (2a spec P4); a plain
/// group among the keys (D12). In [strings]' language.
String? layerPickerBlocked(DraftDocument doc, Iterable<SelectionKey> keys,
    {required bool Function(Handle h) isObject,
    required bool Function(Handle h) isLocked,
    PlanStrings strings = const PlanStringsEn()}) {
  if (!doc.commands.permissions.allows(Capability.components)) {
    return strings.readOnlyDocument;
  }
  for (final k in keys) {
    if (_lockedOrUnderLock(doc, k.target, isLocked)) {
      return strings.lockedNoLayer;
    }
  }
  for (final k in keys) {
    final node = doc.tree[k.target];
    if (node is GroupNode && !isObject(k.target)) {
      return strings.plainGroupNoLayer;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/// The one command that moves [keys] to [layer] (spec 12b D12), or null
/// when every member is already on it: `layer_picker.dart:88-153`, with a
/// live parametric object decided by [isObject].
DraftCommand? layerMoveCommand(
    DraftDocument doc, Iterable<SelectionKey> keys, Handle layer,
    {required bool Function(Handle h) isObject}) {
  // layer_picker.dart:107-152 verbatim, with `isParametricObject(doc, h)`
  // (:119) -> `isObject(h)`.
}

bool _never(Handle _) => false;

/// Spec 12b D12: the property panel's layer menu over [controller]'s
/// selection. It shows the selection's common layer ([layerOfKey]), or the
/// strings' `mixed`; choosing a layer dispatches [layerMoveCommand]'s one
/// command through `controller.execute`, built from the document and the
/// selection as they are at the choice. Disabled, with the reason as its
/// tooltip, when [layerPickerBlocked] says so. It keeps no state: its
/// parent rebuilds it on every selection and document change.
class LayerPicker extends StatelessWidget {
  const LayerPicker({super.key, required this.controller});

  final PlanController controller;

  bool _isObject(Handle h) =>
      controller.catalog.typeIdOf(controller.document, h) != null;

  void _choose(Handle layer) {
    final document = controller.document;
    final keys = controller.selection.keys;
    // A menu opened before the host turned `changeLayer` off picks nothing.
    if (!controller.permissions.changeLayer) return;
    // Today's re-check (permissions, a plain group). A lock made after the
    // menu opened is refused at commit by the lock expander (spec P4).
    if (keys.isEmpty ||
        layerPickerBlocked(document, keys,
                isObject: _isObject, isLocked: _never) !=
            null) {
      return;
    }
    if (document.tables.layers[layer] == null) return;
    final command =
        layerMoveCommand(document, keys, layer, isObject: _isObject);
    if (command == null) return;
    try {
      // False: refused (a lock, which raises the hint, a dangling
      // reference, an ArgumentError, a kit's failure); nothing changed.
      controller.execute(command);
    } on StateError {
      // Refused by the dispatcher: nothing changed.
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final document = controller.document;
    final keys = controller.selection.keys;
    final strings = PlanStrings.of(context);
    final blocked = layerPickerBlocked(document, keys,
        isObject: _isObject, isLocked: controller.isLocked, strings: strings);
    Handle? common;
    var mixed = false;
    for (final k in keys) {
      final l = layerOfKey(document, k, isObject: _isObject);
      if (l == null) continue;
      if (common == null) {
        common = l;
      } else if (common != l) {
        mixed = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    // layer_picker.dart:209-255 verbatim (the label and the Row with its
    // PopupMenuButton), with `FloorPlanStrings` -> `PlanStrings`.
  }
}
```

```dart
// Spec D12 (the page panel) and 2a spec P2: the page's controls over a
// PlanController. Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/page_panel.dart.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart' show PageNotifier;

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import '../l10n/locale_scope.dart';
import '../l10n/number_text.dart';
import '../l10n/strings.dart';
import '../l10n/strings_en.dart';
import 'panel_focus.dart';

/// The page panel (spec D12) of [controller]'s plan. Every control
/// executes one `SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>` through
/// `controller.execute`; the panel rebuilds from the page notifier, so
/// undo moves the controls back. With `permissions.editPage` false every
/// control is disabled and the values are still shown. It follows a
/// swapped document, and its scale field's re-sync is registered with the
/// controller's pending-input settle.
class PlanPagePanel extends StatefulWidget {
  const PlanPagePanel({super.key, required this.controller});

  final PlanController controller;

  @override
  State<PlanPagePanel> createState() => PlanPagePanelState();
}

class PlanPagePanelState extends State<PlanPagePanel> {
  final TextEditingController _scale = TextEditingController();
  final PanelFieldFocusNode _scaleFocus = PanelFieldFocusNode();

  // <page_panel.dart:39-44: _swatches, verbatim>

  /// The panel's words (spec 14d L12): set before the first build; a
  /// change of language shows the scale again in it.
  PlanStrings _strings = const PlanStringsEn();

  /// The page notifier [_syncScale] listens to: the controller's, rebound
  /// on a swap.
  PageNotifier? _page;

  /// Withdraws [resyncScale]'s registration with the controller.
  VoidCallback? _releaseSettle;

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.controller.addListener(_onController);
    _bindPage();
    _releaseSettle = widget.controller.registerSettle(resyncScale);
  }

  @override
  void didChangeDependencies() {
    super.didChangeDependencies();
    PlanLocaleScope.push(context, widget.controller);
    final next = PlanStrings.of(context);
    if (identical(next, _strings)) return;
    _strings = next;
    if (!_scaleFocus.hasFocus) _syncScale();
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(PlanPagePanel oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.controller, widget.controller)) {
      oldWidget.controller.removeListener(_onController);
      _releaseSettle?.call();
      widget.controller.addListener(_onController);
      _releaseSettle = widget.controller.registerSettle(resyncScale);
      _bindPage();
      PlanLocaleScope.push(context, widget.controller);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.removeListener(_onController);
    _releaseSettle?.call();
    _page?.removeListener(_syncScale);
    _scale.dispose();
    _scaleFocus.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  /// A swapped document has a new page notifier: listen to it and show its
  /// scale. New permissions rebuild.
  void _onController() {
    if (!identical(_page, widget.controller.page)) _bindPage();
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  void _bindPage() {
    _page?.removeListener(_syncScale);
    _page = widget.controller.page..addListener(_syncScale);
    _syncScale();
  }

  /// Shows the page's scale, read from the document, not from the notifier
  /// (page_panel.dart:74-77: a command updates the document at once, the
  /// notifier only after the change stream delivers).
  void _syncScale() {
    final document = widget.controller.document;
    final page = document.components.get<PageComponent>(document.rootHandle);
    if (page == null) return;
    final text = formatPanelNumber(page.scaleDenominator, _strings);
    if (_scale.text != text) _scale.text = text;
  }

  /// Shows the stored scale in the scale field, dropping any text typed and
  /// not submitted, and commits nothing: the controller's settle calls it
  /// before a flow reads the document (D14: unsubmitted text is not saved).
  void resyncScale() => _syncScale();

  bool get _editable => widget.controller.permissions.editPage;

  // <page_panel.dart:93-125 verbatim: _onScaleTapOutside and its comment>

  void _set(PageComponent next) {
    if (!_editable) return;
    final document = widget.controller.document;
    try {
      // False: refused (a lock, which raises the hint, a dangling
      // reference, an ArgumentError, a kit's failure); nothing changed.
      widget.controller.execute(
          SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(document.rootHandle, next));
    } on StateError {
      // Refused by the dispatcher: nothing changed.
    }
  }

  // <page_panel.dart:130-139 verbatim: _submitScale>

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => ValueListenableBuilder<PageComponent?>(
        valueListenable: widget.controller.page,
        builder: (context, page, _) {
          // page_panel.dart:145-338 verbatim, with
          // `final editable = widget.editable;` (:147) ->
          // `final editable = _editable;`.
        },
      );
}
```

  - On `PlanController`: `Future<PlanExport?> export(String exporterId, PlanExportChoice choice, {String? name})`, `Future<bool> print(PlanExportChoice choice, {PagePrinter? printer, String? name})`, `Future<void> import(String importerId, Uint8List bytes)`, `List<PlanExporter> get exporters`, `List<PlanImporter> get importers`.
- Produces (package-internal):
  - `PlanController.pageFlows` (`@internal`): `PlanPageFlows` — `ValueListenable<bool> ready`, `bool acquire()`, `void release()`, `PlanExportAnswer dialogAnswer`, `PlanExportFonts fonts`, `exportOnce`, `printOnce`, `exporterOf`, `omittedOf`.
  - `EditorPageFlows({required PlanController controller, required PageFlowSettings Function() settings, PageFlowHooks Function() hooks})` with `ready`, `canExport`, `Future<void> export(BuildContext)`, `Future<void> print(BuildContext)`, `dispose()`; `typedef PageFlowSettings`, `typedef PageFlowHooks`.
  - `showPlanExportDialog(BuildContext, PlanExportAnswer initial, List<PlanExporter> exporters)`, `bool isRasterExporter(PlanExporter)`.
  - `PlanPdfExporter`, `PlanPngExporter` (ids `plan.pdf`, `plan.png`), `exportPageOf`, `printPageFormat`.

Plan decision: **the exporter's document is a copy made when the export starts** (spec P5): the plan's engine JSON (`DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString`) decoded with a `FlutterTextMeasurer` of its own and the controller's component registrations (`PageComponent`, the kit components, the catalog's types), as the planner's service copy is made (`floor_plan_controller.dart:1301-1316`). It is made synchronously, after the settle and before the first `await`, and disposed (its measurer cleared) once the exporter's bytes are back. The `omitted` set is computed on the copy (handles survive the round trip).

Plan decision: **the built-in exporters ignore the table colours.** `exportBytes` filled the coloured tables under the drawing (`export_bytes.dart:35-51`, plan colours spec PC-7); tables are 2b's. Without them the underlay is empty, and `exportPagePdf`/`exportPagePng` with an empty underlay write today's bytes (`page_export.dart:28-29`, `:107-108`).

Plan decision: **one flow at a time per controller, as today** (`floor_plan_controller.dart:1376-1388`): the guard (`ready`) belongs to `PlanPageFlows`, owned by the controller and shared by its views' `EditorPageFlows`, so a host's `export` while the bar's Print runs answers `null`. The remembered dialog answer is `pageFlows.dialogAnswer`; `controller.export` leaves it as it is (today's rule).

Plan decision: **the dialog lists the registry.** The format row has one segment per exporter, labelled by its extension in capitals (`PDF`, `PNG`, as today's literal labels, `export_dialog.dart:74-79`) and keyed `export-format-<id>`; the resolution row shows while the chosen exporter writes an image (`mimeType` starting `image/`), which is today's "PNG only" rule (`:85`) for any raster format a host adds.

Plan decision: **registry ids are unique.** The built-ins come first, the host's after them in its order; two exporters (or two importers) with one id are an `ArgumentError` naming `exporters` (or `importers`) when the controller is built. An unknown id given to `export` or `import` is an `ArgumentError` at once, before any flow runs (today's `exportPlan` threw its argument errors at once, `floor_plan_controller.dart:1344-1347`).

Plan decision: **host calls are not gated** (spec P2): `controller.export` and `controller.print` ignore `permissions.export` / `.print`; `EditorPageFlows` reads them after the dialog and after the bytes, as today's `exportAllowed`/`printAllowed` read the capabilities (`floor_plan_view.dart`'s `_flowsFor`; `page_flows.dart:146-153`).

Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/support/export_plan.dart`:

```dart
// The export fixture: a plan on the default page with, around the sheet's
// centre (not the origin), two marks turned 0.4 and -1.1 rad and a line,
// saved by a controller of the given kits; and the same plan without its
// page.
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'mark_kit.dart';

String exportPlanJson({List<PlanKit>? kits, bool page = true}) {
  final scratch = PlanController(kits: kits ?? [markKit()]);
  final doc = scratch.document;
  final root = doc.rootHandle;
  final sheet = sheetWorldRect(doc.components.get<PageComponent>(root)!);
  final cx = (sheet.minX + sheet.maxX) / 2, cy = (sheet.minY + sheet.maxY) / 2;
  Transform2 put(double dx, double dy, double turn) =>
      Transform2.translation(cx + dx, cy + dy)
          .multiply(Transform2.rotation(turn));
  addMark(doc, ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      at: put(-2600.5, 900.25, 0.4), size: 700.5);
  addMark(doc, ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      at: put(2100.25, -700.5, -1.1), size: 520.25);
  doc.commands.execute(addDrafted(
      doc,
      EntityKind.line,
      linePayload(Vector2(cx - 3900.5, cy - 2100.25),
          Vector2(cx + 3300.75, cy + 1800.5)),
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero));
  if (!page) {
    doc.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(root, null));
  }
  final json = scratch.save();
  scratch.dispose();
  return json;
}
```

Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/support/recording_exporters.dart`:

```dart
// A host's exporter and importer for tests: each records what it was
// handed, can fail once, and (the exporter) can hold its bytes until the
// test lets them go.
import 'dart:async';
import 'dart:convert' show utf8;
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/export/registries.dart';

class RecordingExporter implements PlanExporter {
  RecordingExporter(this.id, this.extension, this.mimeType);

  @override
  final String id;
  @override
  final String extension;
  @override
  final String mimeType;

  final List<PlanExportRequest> requests = [];

  /// Each request's document as the codec writes it, read on arrival (the
  /// copy is disposed once the bytes are back).
  final List<String> seen = [];

  /// Thrown by the next call, then cleared.
  Object? failNext;

  /// While true, each call waits on a completer added to [held].
  bool hold = false;
  final List<Completer<void>> held = [];

  @override
  Future<Uint8List> export(PlanExportRequest request) async {
    requests.add(request);
    seen.add(DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(request.document));
    final failure = failNext;
    failNext = null;
    if (failure != null) throw failure;
    if (hold) {
      final open = Completer<void>();
      held.add(open);
      await open.future;
    }
    return Uint8List.fromList(utf8.encode('$id ${request.omitted.length}'));
  }
}

/// A host exporter that plots the page.
class RecordingPageExporter extends RecordingExporter
    implements PlanPageExporter {
  RecordingPageExporter(super.id, super.extension, super.mimeType);
}

class TextImporter implements PlanImporter {
  TextImporter(this.id, {this.text = ''});

  @override
  final String id;

  @override
  List<String> get extensions => const ['json'];

  /// What the next import answers.
  String text;

  /// Thrown by the next call, then cleared.
  Object? failNext;

  final List<Uint8List> asked = [];

  @override
  Future<String> import(Uint8List bytes) async {
    asked.add(bytes);
    final failure = failNext;
    failNext = null;
    if (failure != null) throw failure;
    return text;
  }
}
```

Create `packages/jet_cad_2d_plan/test/support/flows_bar.dart` (the editor bar's Export and Print as Task 20's `PlanEditorBar` builds them, so the ported view-level tests run before the editor exists):

```dart
// The editor bar's two page buttons over EditorPageFlows, as Task 20's
// PlanEditorBar has them: Export (`toolbar-export`) only with onExport and
// while permissions.export is on; Print (`toolbar-print`) while
// permissions.print is on; each enabled while the controller's flows are
// ready. The flows read this widget's fields at each call.
import 'dart:async' show unawaited;

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/export/editor_page_flows.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/export/export_dialog.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/export/page_printer.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/export/registries.dart';

class FlowsBar extends StatefulWidget {
  const FlowsBar(
      {super.key,
      required this.controller,
      this.onExport,
      this.printer,
      this.exportName = 'plan',
      this.onExportDialog,
      this.onPageFlowError});

  final PlanController controller;
  final void Function(PlanExport export)? onExport;
  final PagePrinter? printer;
  final String exportName;
  final PlanExportDialog? onExportDialog;
  final void Function(Object error)? onPageFlowError;

  @override
  State<FlowsBar> createState() => FlowsBarState();
}

class FlowsBarState extends State<FlowsBar> {
  late EditorPageFlows flows = _flowsFor(widget.controller);

  EditorPageFlows _flowsFor(PlanController c) => EditorPageFlows(
        controller: c,
        settings: () => (
          onExport: widget.onExport,
          printer: widget.printer ?? const PrintingPagePrinter(),
          exportName: widget.exportName,
        ),
        hooks: () => (
          exportDialog: widget.onExportDialog,
          onError: widget.onPageFlowError,
        ),
      );

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();
    widget.controller.addListener(_refresh);
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(FlowsBar oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    if (!identical(oldWidget.controller, widget.controller)) {
      oldWidget.controller.removeListener(_refresh);
      widget.controller.addListener(_refresh);
      flows.dispose();
      flows = _flowsFor(widget.controller);
    }
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    widget.controller.removeListener(_refresh);
    flows.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  void _refresh() {
    if (mounted) setState(() {});
  }

  Widget _button(String key, IconData icon, VoidCallback run) =>
      ValueListenableBuilder<bool>(
        valueListenable: flows.ready,
        builder: (_, ready, __) => IconButton(
            key: Key(key), icon: Icon(icon), onPressed: ready ? run : null),
      );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final permissions = widget.controller.permissions;
    return Material(
      child: Row(mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min, children: [
        if (flows.canExport && permissions.export)
          _button('toolbar-export', Icons.ios_share_outlined,
              () => unawaited(flows.export(context))),
        if (permissions.print)
          _button('toolbar-print', Icons.print_outlined,
              () => unawaited(flows.print(context))),
      ]),
    );
  }
}
```

```dart
// Spec P2 and P5: the export choice without the format, the dialog's

import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/export/registries.dart';

void main() {
  test(
      'X-1 the choice and the answer: ==, hashCode, copyWith, toString; the '
      'resolutions in order', () {
    const initial = PlanExportChoice.initial;
    expect(initial.dpi, PlanExportDpi.d150);
    expect(initial.toString(), 'PlanExportChoice(150 dpi)');
    expect(PlanExportDpi.values.map((d) => d.value), [96, 150, 300]);
    final d96 = initial.copyWith(dpi: PlanExportDpi.d96);
    // M-X-1a: PlanExportChoice.== ignores dpi.
    expect(d96 == initial, isFalse);
    expect(initial.copyWith(), initial);
    expect(const PlanExportChoice(dpi: PlanExportDpi.d150), initial);
    expect(initial.hashCode == d96.hashCode, isFalse);

    const answer = PlanExportAnswer.initial;
    expect(answer.exporter, 'plan.pdf');
    expect(answer.choice, initial);
    expect(answer.toString(), 'PlanExportAnswer(plan.pdf, 150 dpi)');
    final png = answer.copyWith(exporter: 'plan.png');
    final fine =
        answer.copyWith(choice: const PlanExportChoice(dpi: PlanExportDpi.d300));
    expect(png.choice, initial, reason: 'choice kept');
    expect(fine.exporter, 'plan.pdf', reason: 'exporter kept');
    // M-X-1b: PlanExportAnswer.== ignores the exporter.
    expect(png == answer, isFalse);
    expect(fine == answer, isFalse);
    expect(png == fine, isFalse);
    expect(answer.copyWith(), answer);
    expect(
        const PlanExportAnswer(
            exporter: 'plan.png', choice: PlanExportChoice.initial),
        png);
    expect(png.hashCode == answer.hashCode, isFalse);
  });
}
```

```dart
PlanPageFlows flowsOver(DraftDocument doc,
        {List<PlanExporter> exporters = const [],
        List<PlanImporter> importers = const []}) =>
    PlanPageFlows(
        exporters: exporters,
        importers: importers,

        load: (_) {});

          <PlanImporter>[], 'exporters'),

        throwsA(isA<ArgumentError>()));

      'X-8 export settles pending input before it copies the plan: what a '
      'settler commits is in the exporter\'s copy', (tester) async {
    final acme = RecordingExporter('acme.json', 'json', 'application/json');
    final c = PlanController(
        kits: [markKit()], json: exportPlanJson(), exporters: [acme]);
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    final before = DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(c.document);
    var runs = 0;
    final release = c.registerSettle(() {
      if (runs++ == 0) {
        addLineOn(c.document, ReservedHandles.layerZero, 400.5, 220.25,
            1300.75, 980.5);
      }
    });
    addTearDown(release);
    await tester.runAsync(() => c.export('acme.json', PlanExportChoice.initial));
    // M-X-8: `guarded` does not call `_settle()`.
    expect(runs, greaterThan(0));
    expect(acme.seen.single, isNot(before));
    expect(acme.seen.single, DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(c.document));
  });
}
```

```dart
// Spec P5: the export and import registries' types. A host adds its own
// exporters and importers through PlanController(exporters:, importers:);
// the plan library builds in `plan.pdf` and `plan.png`.
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:meta/meta.dart';

/// What makes an export's bytes. Its [id] names the format in the dialog's
/// answer and in `PlanController.export`: the built-ins are `plan.pdf` and
/// `plan.png`, a host's its own (`acme.dxf`).
abstract interface class PlanExporter {
  String get id;

  /// The file name's extension, without the dot.
  String get extension;

  /// The bytes' MIME type.
  String get mimeType;

  /// The bytes of [request]'s document. An error completes the export's
  /// `Future` with it.
  Future<Uint8List> export(PlanExportRequest request);
}

/// An exporter that plots the plan's page (the built-ins do): for a plan
/// without a page the controller answers null and never calls it, and its
/// request's page is never null (spec P2: "a plan with no page where the
/// choice needs one").
abstract interface class PlanPageExporter implements PlanExporter {}

/// What turns a file into a plan's text (spec P5, decision 4). A text
/// without a manifest gets an empty one before it is loaded, so an imported
/// drawing opens as plain geometry.
abstract interface class PlanImporter {
  String get id;

  /// The file extensions it reads, without the dot.
  List<String> get extensions;

  Future<String> import(Uint8List bytes);
}

/// The resolutions an image export offers.
enum PlanExportDpi {
  d96,
  d150,
  d300;

  /// Dots per inch.
  int get value => switch (this) {
        PlanExportDpi.d96 => 96,
        PlanExportDpi.d150 => 150,
        PlanExportDpi.d300 => 300,
      };
}

/// An export's settings: today's export choice without the format, which
/// the exporter's id now names (spec P2). A PDF ignores the resolution.
@immutable
final class PlanExportChoice {
  const PlanExportChoice({this.dpi = PlanExportDpi.d150});

  /// The first choice of a controller's life: 150 dpi.
  static const PlanExportChoice initial = PlanExportChoice();

  final PlanExportDpi dpi;

  PlanExportChoice copyWith({PlanExportDpi? dpi}) =>
      PlanExportChoice(dpi: dpi ?? this.dpi);

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is PlanExportChoice && other.dpi == dpi;

  @override
  int get hashCode => dpi.hashCode;

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanExportChoice(${dpi.value} dpi)';
}

/// The export dialog's answer, the host's dialog's too: the exporter's id
/// and the choice. Remembered per controller as the next dialog's initial.
@immutable
final class PlanExportAnswer {
  const PlanExportAnswer({required this.exporter, required this.choice});

  /// The first answer of a controller's life: PDF, 150 dpi, as today's
  /// dialog's.
  static const PlanExportAnswer initial =
      PlanExportAnswer(exporter: 'plan.pdf', choice: PlanExportChoice.initial);

  final String exporter;
  final PlanExportChoice choice;

  PlanExportAnswer copyWith({String? exporter, PlanExportChoice? choice}) =>
      PlanExportAnswer(
          exporter: exporter ?? this.exporter, choice: choice ?? this.choice);

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is PlanExportAnswer &&
      other.exporter == exporter &&
      other.choice == choice;

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(exporter, choice);

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanExportAnswer($exporter, ${choice.dpi.value} dpi)';
}

/// The plan's fonts, for an exporter that embeds text.
abstract interface class PlanExportFonts {
  /// The bundled Roboto's bytes: the face the screen lays text out in.
  Future<Uint8List> get bytes;
}

/// What an exporter is handed (spec P5).
final class PlanExportRequest {
  PlanExportRequest({
    required this.document,
    required this.page,
    required this.choice,
    required Set<Handle> omitted,
    required this.fonts,
  }) : omitted = Set.unmodifiable(omitted);

  /// A copy of the plan made when the export started, so edits made while
  /// the export runs cannot race with it. Disposed once the bytes are back:
  /// keep nothing of it.
  final DraftDocument document;

  /// The plan's page, or null for a plan without one (never null for a
  /// [PlanPageExporter]).
  final PageComponent? page;

  final PlanExportChoice choice;

  /// The objects of types with `exported: false`: their leaves are not
  /// drawn.
  final Set<Handle> omitted;

  final PlanExportFonts fonts;
}

/// An export's bytes, its file name and its MIME type.
@immutable
final class PlanExport {
  const PlanExport(
      {required this.bytes, required this.name, required this.mimeType});

  final Uint8List bytes;

  /// `<name>.<extension>`.
  final String name;

  final String mimeType;
}
```

```dart
// Spec P5: the built-in exporters, `plan.pdf` and `plan.png`, and the page
// helpers the flows read. Ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/export/export_bytes.dart without the table
// colours (2b): an empty underlay writes today's bytes.
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ExportDpi, exportPagePdf, exportPagePng;
import 'package:pdf/pdf.dart' show PdfPageFormat;

import 'registries.dart';

/// The page [document]'s root carries, or null when it has none. Read from
/// the document, never from the screen (export_bytes.dart:18-24).
PageComponent? exportPageOf(DraftDocument document) =>
    document.components.isRegistered<PageComponent>()
        ? document.components.get<PageComponent>(document.rootHandle)
        : null;

/// [page]'s paper in pt, as laid out: the size the print dialog opens on
/// (export_bytes.dart:68-72).
PdfPageFormat printPageFormat(PageComponent page) => PdfPageFormat(
    page.effectiveWidthMm * 72 / 25.4, page.effectiveHeightMm * 72 / 25.4);

ExportDpi _dpiOf(PlanExportDpi dpi) => switch (dpi) {
      PlanExportDpi.d96 => ExportDpi.d96,
      PlanExportDpi.d150 => ExportDpi.d150,
      PlanExportDpi.d300 => ExportDpi.d300,
    };

/// `plan.pdf`: the page as a one-page vector PDF with the plan's font
/// embedded, the omitted objects not drawn.
final class PlanPdfExporter implements PlanPageExporter {
  const PlanPdfExporter();

  static const String exporterId = 'plan.pdf';

  @override
  String get id => exporterId;

  @override
  String get extension => 'pdf';

  @override
  String get mimeType => 'application/pdf';

  @override
  Future<Uint8List> export(PlanExportRequest request) async => exportPagePdf(
      document: request.document,
      page: request.page!,
      fontBytes: await request.fonts.bytes,
      omitOwners: request.omitted);
}

/// `plan.png`: the page as a PNG at the choice's resolution, the omitted
/// objects not drawn.
final class PlanPngExporter implements PlanPageExporter {
  const PlanPngExporter();

  static const String exporterId = 'plan.png';

  @override
  String get id => exporterId;

  @override
  String get extension => 'png';

  @override
  String get mimeType => 'image/png';

  @override
  Future<Uint8List> export(PlanExportRequest request) => exportPagePng(
      document: request.document,
      page: request.page!,
      dpi: _dpiOf(request.choice.dpi),
      omitOwners: request.omitted);
}
```

- [ ] **Step 7: The controller's flows.** Create `lib/src/export/page_flows.dart`:

```dart
// Spec P2 (the export rules) and P5 (the registries): the controller's
// export, print and import, one export or print at a time. Ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/page_flows.dart (exportOnce, printOnce,
// :73-120) and floor_plan_controller.dart (_pageFlow, :1376-1388).
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable, ValueNotifier;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show FlutterTextMeasurer;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_kit/jet_cad_2d_kit.dart' show registerKitComponents;

import '../file/plan_file.dart' show ensureManifest;
import 'builtin_exporters.dart';
import 'export_font.dart';
import 'page_printer.dart';
import 'registries.dart';

bool _never() => false;

/// The export, print and import flows of one controller: the registries,
/// the one-flow guard its views share, the remembered dialog answer and
/// the font.
final class PlanPageFlows {
  /// [exporters] and [importers] are the host's; [unexported] the ids of
  /// the types with `exported: false`; [document], [catalog], [settle] and
  /// [load] read and act on the controller at each call.
  PlanPageFlows({
    required List<PlanExporter> exporters,
    required List<PlanImporter> importers,
    required Set<String> unexported,
    required DraftDocument Function() document,
    required ParametricCatalog Function() catalog,
    required void Function() settle,
    required void Function(String json) load,
    PlanExportFonts? fonts,
  })  : exporters = List.unmodifiable(<PlanExporter>[
          const PlanPdfExporter(),
          const PlanPngExporter(),
          ...exporters,
        ]),
        importers = List.unmodifiable(importers),
        fonts = fonts ?? ExportFontCache(),
        _unexported = Set.unmodifiable(unexported),
        _document = document,
        _catalog = catalog,
        _settle = settle,
        _load = load {
    checkRegistry(exporters: exporters, importers: importers);
  }

  /// Throws an [ArgumentError] naming `exporters` (or `importers`) when two
  /// of them, the built-ins included, share an id. The controller's factory
  /// calls it before it builds anything.
  static void checkRegistry(
      {required List<PlanExporter> exporters,
      required List<PlanImporter> importers}) {
    _unique([
      PlanPdfExporter.exporterId,
      PlanPngExporter.exporterId,
      for (final e in exporters) e.id,
    ], 'exporters');
    _unique([for (final i in importers) i.id], 'importers');
  }

  static void _unique(List<String> ids, String name) {
    final seen = <String>{};
    for (final id in ids) {
      if (!seen.add(id)) {
        throw ArgumentError.value(ids, name, 'lists the id "$id" twice');
      }
    }
  }

  /// `plan.pdf`, `plan.png`, then the host's, in its order.
  final List<PlanExporter> exporters;
  final List<PlanImporter> importers;
  final PlanExportFonts fonts;
  final Set<String> _unexported;
  final DraftDocument Function() _document;
  final ParametricCatalog Function() _catalog;
  final void Function() _settle;
  final void Function(String json) _load;

  final ValueNotifier<bool> _ready = ValueNotifier(true);
  bool _disposed = false;

  /// False while an export or a print runs, for this controller and every
  /// view of it.
  ValueListenable<bool> get ready => _ready;

  /// The export dialog's last answer: the next dialog's initial.
  PlanExportAnswer dialogAnswer = PlanExportAnswer.initial;

  bool get isDisposed => _disposed;

  /// Takes the guard: false when a flow runs or the flows are disposed.
  bool acquire() {
    if (_disposed || !_ready.value) return false;
    _ready.value = false;
    return true;
  }

  /// Gives the guard back, unless the flows are disposed.
  void release() {
    if (!_disposed) _ready.value = true;
  }

  PlanExporter exporterOf(String id) {
    for (final e in exporters) {
      if (e.id == id) return e;
    }
    throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'exporterId', 'names no exporter');
  }

  PlanImporter importerOf(String id) {
    for (final i in importers) {
      if (i.id == id) return i;
    }
    throw ArgumentError.value(id, 'importerId', 'names no importer');
  }

  /// The live objects of [document] whose type has `exported: false`.
  Set<Handle> omittedOf(DraftDocument document) {
    if (_unexported.isEmpty) return const {};
    final catalog = _catalog();
    return {
      for (final node in document.tree.nodes)
        if (node is GroupNode)
          if (catalog.typeIdOf(document, node.handle) case final id?
              when _unexported.contains(id))
            node.handle,
    };
  }

  /// A copy of [live]: its codec JSON decoded with a measurer of its own
  /// and the controller's registrations.
  ({DraftDocument document, FlutterTextMeasurer measurer}) _copyOf(
      DraftDocument live) {
    final measurer = FlutterTextMeasurer();
    final catalog = _catalog();
    final copy = DraftDocumentCodec.decodeString(
        DraftDocumentCodec.encodeToString(live),
        measurer: measurer,
        registerComponents: (r) {
          PageComponent.register(r);
          registerKitComponents(r);
          catalog.registerComponents(r);
        },
        diagnostics: <Diagnostic>[]);
    return (document: copy, measurer: measurer);
  }

  /// [flow] under the guard, after the settle; [busy] when another flow
  /// runs or the flows are disposed, before or after it.
  Future<T> guarded<T>(T busy, Future<T> Function() flow) async {
    if (!acquire()) return busy;
    try {
      _settle();
      final result = await flow();
      return _disposed ? busy : result;
    } finally {
      release();
    }
  }

  /// Export's one body (page_flows.dart:73-97): [document] (the
  /// controller's plan when null) by [exporterId] as [choice] says, named
  /// `<name>.<extension>`. Null when the plan shown is no longer
  /// [document], before or after the bytes; when the exporter plots the
  /// page and the plan has none; or when [cancelled] says so after the
  /// bytes. The exporter gets a copy, disposed when its bytes are back.
  Future<PlanExport?> exportOnce(
      String exporterId, PlanExportChoice choice, String name,
      {DraftDocument? document, bool Function() cancelled = _never}) async {
    final exporter = exporterOf(exporterId);
    final live = document ?? _document();
    if (!identical(live, _document())) return null;
    if (exportPageOf(live) == null && exporter is PlanPageExporter) {
      return null;
    }
    final copy = _copyOf(live);
    final Uint8List bytes;
    try {
      bytes = await exporter.export(PlanExportRequest(
          document: copy.document,
          page: exportPageOf(copy.document),
          choice: choice,
          omitted: omittedOf(copy.document),
          fonts: fonts));
    } finally {
      copy.document.dispose();
      copy.measurer.clear();
    }
    if (cancelled() || !identical(live, _document())) return null;
    return PlanExport(
        bytes: bytes,
        name: '$name.${exporter.extension}',
        mimeType: exporter.mimeType);
  }

  /// Print's one body (page_flows.dart:99-120): the plan's page as
  /// `plan.pdf`'s bytes to [printer], named [name]. False when it has no
  /// page, when the plan shown changed while the bytes were made, or when
  /// [cancelled] says so after them; true once the printer is done.
  Future<bool> printOnce(PagePrinter printer, String name,
      {PlanExportChoice choice = PlanExportChoice.initial,
      bool Function() cancelled = _never}) async {
    final live = _document();
    final page = exportPageOf(live);
    if (page == null) return false;
    final copy = _copyOf(live);
    final Uint8List bytes;
    try {
      bytes = await const PlanPdfExporter().export(PlanExportRequest(
          document: copy.document,
          page: exportPageOf(copy.document),
          choice: choice,
          omitted: omittedOf(copy.document),
          fonts: fonts));
    } finally {
      copy.document.dispose();
      copy.measurer.clear();
    }
    if (cancelled() || !identical(live, _document())) return false;
    await printer.print(bytes, name, printPageFormat(page));
    return true;
  }

  /// `PlanController.export`: an unknown id throws at once.
  Future<PlanExport?> export(String exporterId, PlanExportChoice choice,
      {required String name}) {
    exporterOf(exporterId);
    return guarded<PlanExport?>(
        null,
        () => exportOnce(exporterId, choice, name,
            cancelled: () => _disposed));
  }

  /// `PlanController.print`.
  Future<bool> print(PlanExportChoice choice,
          {required PagePrinter printer, required String name}) =>
      guarded<bool>(
          false,
          () => printOnce(printer, name,
              choice: choice, cancelled: () => _disposed));

  /// `PlanController.import`: an unknown id throws at once; the importer's
  /// text, with an empty manifest added when it has none, is loaded.
  Future<void> import(String importerId, Uint8List bytes) {
    final importer = importerOf(importerId);
    return _import(importer, bytes);
  }

  Future<void> _import(PlanImporter importer, Uint8List bytes) async {
    final text = await importer.import(bytes);
    if (_disposed) return;
    _load(ensureManifest(text));
  }

  void dispose() {
    _disposed = true;
    _ready.dispose();
  }
}
```

```dart
// The Export dialog over the registry (spec P5): the format, one segment
// per exporter, and for an image format its resolution; Export or Cancel.
// Escape cancels (a dismissible route pops on Escape). Ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/export/export_dialog.dart.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../l10n/strings.dart';
import 'registries.dart';

/// A host's export dialog (`PlanEditor.onExportDialog`): it starts from
/// [initial] over [exporters] and answers null to cancel.
typedef PlanExportDialog = Future<PlanExportAnswer?> Function(
    BuildContext context,
    PlanExportAnswer initial,
    List<PlanExporter> exporters);

/// Whether [exporter] writes a raster image, whose resolution the dialog
/// asks for.
bool isRasterExporter(PlanExporter exporter) =>
    exporter.mimeType.startsWith('image/');

/// Asks for the export's exporter and resolution, starting from [initial]
/// (from the first exporter when [initial] names none of [exporters]).
/// Null when cancelled (Cancel, Escape or a tap outside).
Future<PlanExportAnswer?> showPlanExportDialog(BuildContext context,
        PlanExportAnswer initial, List<PlanExporter> exporters) =>
    showDialog<PlanExportAnswer>(
      context: context,
      builder: (_) => _ExportDialog(initial: initial, exporters: exporters),
    );

class _ExportDialog extends StatefulWidget {
  const _ExportDialog({required this.initial, required this.exporters});

  final PlanExportAnswer initial;
  final List<PlanExporter> exporters;

  @override
  State<_ExportDialog> createState() => _ExportDialogState();
}

class _ExportDialogState extends State<_ExportDialog> {
  late PlanExportAnswer _answer =
      widget.exporters.any((e) => e.id == widget.initial.exporter)
          ? widget.initial
          : widget.initial.copyWith(exporter: widget.exporters.first.id);

  PlanExporter get _exporter =>
      widget.exporters.firstWhere((e) => e.id == _answer.exporter);

  void _cancel() => Navigator.of(context).pop();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final strings = PlanStrings.of(context);
    return AlertDialog(
      key: const Key('export-dialog'),
      title: Text(strings.exportTitle),
      content: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          SegmentedButton<String>(
            key: const Key('export-format'),
            showSelectedIcon: false,
            segments: [
              for (final e in widget.exporters)
                ButtonSegment(
                    value: e.id,
                    label: Text(e.extension.toUpperCase(),
                        key: Key('export-format-${e.id}'))),
            ],
            selected: {_answer.exporter},
            onSelectionChanged: (s) =>
                setState(() => _answer = _answer.copyWith(exporter: s.single)),
          ),
          if (isRasterExporter(_exporter)) ...[
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            SegmentedButton<PlanExportDpi>(
              key: const Key('export-dpi'),
              showSelectedIcon: false,
              segments: [
                for (final d in PlanExportDpi.values)
                  ButtonSegment(
                      value: d,
                      label: Text(strings.dpi(d.value),
                          key: Key('export-dpi-${d.value}'))),
              ],
              selected: {_answer.choice.dpi},
              onSelectionChanged: (s) => setState(() => _answer = _answer
                  .copyWith(choice: _answer.choice.copyWith(dpi: s.single))),
            ),
          ],
        ],
      ),
      actions: [
        TextButton(
          key: const Key('export-cancel'),
          onPressed: _cancel,
          child: Text(strings.cancel),
        ),
        FilledButton(
          key: const Key('export-ok'),
          autofocus: true,
          onPressed: () => Navigator.of(context).pop(_answer),
          child: Text(strings.exportAction),
        ),
      ],
    );
  }
}
```

Create `lib/src/export/editor_page_flows.dart` (port of `packages/jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/page_flows.dart:20-41` and `:122-231`; the conversions of `:45-71` are gone with the closed format enum):

```dart
// Export and Print from an editor's bar and chords (2a spec P2, P5): the
// dialog (the host's when it gave one), the remembered answer, the bytes
// to the host's onExport, the PDF to the printer. Under the controller's
// one-flow guard; the host's hooks and settings are read at each call;
// `permissions.export` and `.print` are read again after the dialog and
// after the bytes, so a flow started before the host refused it does not
// run to its end. Ported from jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/page_flows.dart.
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show ValueListenable;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show BuildContext;

import '../controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'builtin_exporters.dart' show exportPageOf;
import 'export_dialog.dart';
import 'page_flows.dart';
import 'page_printer.dart';
import 'registries.dart';

/// What the flows read from the view at call time.
typedef PageFlowSettings = ({
  void Function(PlanExport export)? onExport,
  PagePrinter printer,
  String exportName,
});

/// The view's hooks, read at each call: the host's export dialog, in place
/// of the Material one, and where a flow's error goes.
typedef PageFlowHooks = ({
  PlanExportDialog? exportDialog,
  void Function(Object error)? onError,
});

PageFlowHooks _noHooks() => const (exportDialog: null, onError: null);

/// The two flows of one editor view, for its controller.
class EditorPageFlows {
  EditorPageFlows(
      {required this.controller, required this.settings, this.hooks = _noHooks});

  final PlanController controller;

  /// The view's current settings, read at each call.
  final PageFlowSettings Function() settings;

  /// The view's current hooks, read at each call.
  final PageFlowHooks Function() hooks;

  bool _disposed = false;

  PlanPageFlows get _flows => controller.pageFlows;

  /// False while a flow runs (this view's, another view's or the host's
  /// own call): a second press does nothing.
  ValueListenable<bool> get ready => _flows.ready;

  /// Export is offered only with an `onExport`.
  bool get canExport => settings().onExport != null;

  bool _exportAllowed() => controller.permissions.export;
  bool _printAllowed() => controller.permissions.print;

  Future<void> export(BuildContext context) => _run(() async {
        final sink = settings().onExport;
        if (sink == null) return;
        final flows = _flows;
        final document = controller.document;
        final paged = exportPageOf(document) != null;
        if (!paged && flows.exporters.every((e) => e is PlanPageExporter)) {
          return;
        }
        if (!context.mounted) return;
        // The host's dialog when it gave one, the Material one otherwise;
        // either way from the remembered answer, and null cancels.
        final dialog = hooks().exportDialog;
        final answer = dialog != null
            ? await dialog(context, flows.dialogAnswer, flows.exporters)
            : await showPlanExportDialog(
                context, flows.dialogAnswer, flows.exporters);
        // A view gone meanwhile is the bytes' cancel, below.
        if (answer == null || (!_disposed && !_exportAllowed())) return;
        flows.dialogAnswer = answer;
        final export = await flows.exportOnce(
            answer.exporter, answer.choice, settings().exportName,
            document: document,
            cancelled: () => _disposed || !_exportAllowed());
        if (export != null) sink(export);
      });

  Future<void> print(BuildContext context) => _run(() async {
        final s = settings();
        await _flows.printOnce(s.printer, s.exportName,
            choice: _flows.dialogAnswer.choice,
            cancelled: () => _disposed || !_printAllowed());
      });

  Future<void> _run(Future<void> Function() flow) async {
    final flows = _flows;
    if (_disposed || !flows.acquire()) return;
    try {
      controller.settlePendingInput();
      await flow();
    } catch (error) {
      // Without the host's callback the error propagates, as it always
      // did, out of a Future the caller drops.
      final report = hooks().onError;
      if (report == null) rethrow;
      report(error);
    } finally {
      // The view may have gone while the flow awaited; the controller's
      // guard is released all the same, unless the controller went too.
      flows.release();
    }
  }

  void dispose() => _disposed = true;
}
```

  - Shared interfaces: `PlanController` (Task 8), `PlanPermissions` (`export`, `print`, `undo`, `allowsTool`; Task 12).
  - Task 15: `PlanCanvas({required controller, rulers, grid, snapping, autofocus})`; `PlanShortcutGuard`, `PlanTextKeys`, the chords (`kNewChords`, `kOpenChords`, `kSaveChords`, `kSaveAsChords`, `kExportChords`, `kPrintChords`, `kUndoChords`, `kRedoChords`) in `lib/src/shortcuts/plan_shortcut_guard.dart` (re-exporting `chords.dart`).
  - Task 13: `PlanSymbolGallery({required controller, bool Function(PlanSymbol)? filter, TextEditingController? query})`, `PlanSymbol`.
  - Task 18: `PlanLayerPanel`, `PlanPagePanel`; `test/support/mark_kit.dart`. Task 19: `EditorPageFlows`, `PlanExportDialog`, `PagePrinter`, `PrintingPagePrinter`, `PlanExport`; `test/support/fake_page_printer.dart`, `test/support/recording_exporters.dart`.
  - Task 9: `PlanStrings` (`toolSymbol`, `tabTools`, `tabSymbols`, `objectSnapOn`, `objectSnapOff`, `undo`, `redo`, `exportEllipsis`, `printEllipsis`, `controlKey`, `shiftKey`, `selectedCount`, `planDamaged`), `PlanThemeScope`, `PlanTheme`, `formatPanelNumber`, `PlanLocaleScope`, `ensurePlanFonts`, `registerFontLicences`, `planSupportedLocales`, `planLocalizationsDelegates`.
  - The engine: `zoomOf` (`jet_cad_2d/lib/src/document/page_geometry.dart:15`); the Flutter layer: `kLogicalPixelsPerMm` (`draft_canvas.dart:23`).
  - The names in "Assumed from earlier tasks" (Tasks 8, 11, 12, 16, 17).
- Produces (exported from the barrel):
  - `enum PlanEditorAction { export, print, undo, redo, snap, zoom }` (today's `FloorPlanEditorAction`, `bars.dart:17`).
  - `final class PlanEditorBar` — `const PlanEditorBar({bool visible = true, List<PlanEditorAction> actions = PlanEditorAction.values, List<Widget> leading = const [], List<Widget> trailing = const []})`; `==`, `hashCode`, `toString` (today's `FloorPlanEditorBar`, `bars.dart:93-127`).
  - `typedef PlanFileCallback = Future<void> Function();`
  - `class PlanEditor extends StatefulWidget` — `const PlanEditor({Key? key, required PlanController controller, bool toolPalette = true, bool gallery = true, bool Function(PlanSymbol symbol)? symbolFilter, bool propertyPanel = true, bool layerPanel = true, bool pagePanel = true, bool rulers = true, bool grid = true, bool snapping = true, PlanEditorBar bar = const PlanEditorBar(), PlanFileCallback? onNew, PlanFileCallback? onOpen, PlanFileCallback? onSave, PlanFileCallback? onSaveAs, void Function(PlanExport export)? onExport, PlanExportDialog? onExportDialog, void Function(Object error)? onPageFlowError, PagePrinter? printer, String exportName = 'plan', bool shortcuts = true, bool autofocus = true, PlanTheme? theme})`.
  - Package-internal: `void validatePlanEditorBar(PlanEditorBar bar)`; `PlanStrings.newDocument`, `.open`, `.save`, `.saveAs`.

Plan decision: **the options are spec P2's table and P7's rows, one to one.** Today's `FloorPlanEditorCapabilities` flags that are widgets' choices become `PlanEditor` options (`selectionPanel` → `propertyPanel`, `layerPanel`, `pagePanel`, `symbolPalette` → `gallery`, `symbolFilter`, `rulers`, `grid`, `snapping`); the editing flags live in `controller.permissions` (Task 12) and the editor reads them at each build: `export`, `print` and `undo` decide which bar buttons exist (today's `planner_shell.dart:1427-1440`). `toolPalette` is new: P2's "which panels show" names the palette too.

Plan decision: **the host's file callbacks.** `onNew`, `onOpen`, `onSave` and `onSaveAs` are today's bare shell's file commands (`planner_shell.dart` with `fileCommands:`; `bars_test.dart:85-96` lists them), offered as toolbar buttons `toolbar-new`, `toolbar-open`, `toolbar-save`, `toolbar-save-as` before Export and Print, and as their chords through `PlanShortcuts`, only when given. Each settles pending input before it calls the host (spec P2: pending input is settled before a flow reads the plan; today's app flows settled through `DocumentHost` before New, Open and Save, spec 12a D2) and is enabled while no tool is part-way through a shape (`planner_shell.dart:769-778`, `_idle`). `Open sample` (the app's) is not a library command. The words are the app's (`apps/floor_planner/lib/app_strings.dart:77-89`, `:135-147`, `:198-210`), moved into `PlanStrings`.

Plan decision: **Export and Print are the view's flows** (`EditorPageFlows`, Task 19) under the controller's guard: enabled while the flows are ready, no tool is part-way through a shape and the plan has a page (today's `_fileEnabled` for `kPageCommandIds`, `planner_shell.dart:769-778`); Export exists only with `onExport` and `permissions.export`, Print only with `permissions.print`.

Plan decision: **what is not ported.** The document name and its dirty mark (`planner_shell.dart:1174-1191`, the app's), the table inspector (`:1555-1566`, 2b), the table colour layer (`:1518-1524`, 2b), the room and dimension notices in the status line (`:1007-1011`, sub-project 3), the canvas measuring for mode switches (`floor_plan_view.dart`'s `_measureAfterFrame`, `_keepPlanInPlace`, `_chromeOrigin`: 2b's service mode). The canvas's paper and resolver are `PlanCanvas`'s own (Task 15).

Plan decision: **the damaged warning sits in the bar** (Task 9 added `planDamaged` for it): while `controller.damaged` is true a warning icon (`plan-damaged`, the scheme's error colour, the word as its tooltip) stands before the status line (spec P4: "It marks the plan `damaged`, shows a warning").

Plan decision: **the barrel shows exactly the public API.** Every export carries a `show` list, as `jet_cad_floor_plan`'s barrel does (`test/host/barrel_test.dart:10-26`); the expected set in ED-9 is the union of the **Produces (exported)** blocks of Tasks 6-20 as this plan states them. Where an earlier task's block and this list differ, that task's block wins and the difference is reported in this task's report.

```dart
// The editor's fixture: the embedding fixture's page (originX 37000,
// originY -36200, as `jet_cad_floor_plan/test/host/embedding_fixture.dart:
// 131-132`), two turned marks and a line around the sheet's centre, saved;
// the camera the bar tests measured under (`embeddingCamera`, `:160-161`);
// and the editor pumped at 1440 x 900.
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d/jet_cad_2d.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_flutter/jet_cad_2d_flutter.dart'
    show ViewportTransform;
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/controller/plan_controller.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/src/editor/plan_editor.dart';
import 'package:vector_math/vector_math_64.dart' show Vector2;

import 'mark_kit.dart';

/// The marks of [editorPlanJson], in order.
const int kEditorMarks = 2;

String editorPlanJson() {
  final scratch = PlanController(kits: [markKit()]);
  final doc = scratch.document;
  final root = doc.rootHandle;
  doc.commands.execute(SetComponentCommand<PageComponent>(
      root, PageComponent(originX: 37000, originY: -36200)));
  final sheet = sheetWorldRect(doc.components.get<PageComponent>(root)!);
  final cx = (sheet.minX + sheet.maxX) / 2, cy = (sheet.minY + sheet.maxY) / 2;
  addMark(doc, ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      at: Transform2.translation(cx - 2600.5, cy + 900.25)
          .multiply(Transform2.rotation(0.4)),
      size: 700.5);
  addMark(doc, ReservedHandles.layerZero,
      at: Transform2.translation(cx + 2100.25, cy - 700.5)
          .multiply(Transform2.rotation(-1.1)),
      size: 520.25);
  doc.commands.execute(addDrafted(
      doc,
      EntityKind.line,
      linePayload(Vector2(cx - 3900.5, cy - 2100.25),
          Vector2(cx + 3300.75, cy + 1800.5)),
      layer: ReservedHandles.layerZero));
  final json = scratch.save();
  scratch.dispose();
  return json;
}

ViewportTransform embeddingCamera() => ViewportTransform(
    worldToScreenMatrix: Transform2(0.37, 0, 0, -0.37, -14612.25, -9431.5));

/// A controller over [editorPlanJson] (or [json]), disposed at tear-down.
PlanController editorController({String? json}) {
  final c = PlanController(kits: [markKit()], json: json ?? editorPlanJson());
  addTearDown(c.dispose);
  return c;
}

/// [editor] in a 1440 x 900 window, two frames, then [editor]'s controller
/// under [embeddingCamera]. Pump again with another editor to change its
/// options at runtime (the same element is updated).
Future<void> pumpEditor(WidgetTester tester, PlanEditor editor,
    {ThemeData? theme}) async {
  await tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(const Size(1440, 900));
  addTearDown(() => tester.binding.setSurfaceSize(null));
  await tester.pumpWidget(
      MaterialApp(theme: theme, home: Scaffold(body: editor)));
  await tester.pump();
  await tester.pump();
  editor.controller.camera.value = embeddingCamera();
  await tester.pump();
}

Finder byKey(String k) => find.byKey(Key(k));

double left(WidgetTester tester, String k) => tester.getTopLeft(byKey(k)).dx;
double right(WidgetTester tester, String k) => tester.getTopRight(byKey(k)).dx;
```

```dart
// 2a spec P2, P7: the barrel exports exactly the plan library's public API,
// every export through a `show` list, and the editor's names are usable
// through the barrel alone (this file imports nothing else of the package).
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';
import 'package:jet_cad_2d_plan/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart';

/// The names the barrel's `show` lists name, read as text.
Set<String> barrelNames() {
  final text = File('lib/jet_cad_2d_plan.dart').readAsStringSync();
  final exports = RegExp(r'^export\s[^;]*;', multiLine: true)
      .allMatches(text)
      .map((m) => m.group(0)!.replaceAll(RegExp(r'\s+'), ' '))
      .toList();
  final names = <String>{};
  for (final e in exports) {
    // M-ED-9: an export without `show`.
    expect(e.contains(' show '), isTrue, reason: 'every export shows: $e');
    final list = e.substring(e.indexOf(' show ') + 6, e.length - 1);
    names.addAll(list.split(',').map((n) => n.trim()));
  }
  return names;
}

void main() {
  test('ED-9 the barrel shows exactly the plan library\'s API', () {
    expect(barrelNames(), {
      // Task 6
      'KitSet', 'validateKitSet', 'KitSetError', 'reservedKitIds',
      // Task 7
      'PlanFormatException', 'PlanFormatCode', 'PlanManifest',
      'ManifestCheck', 'checkManifest', 'kPlanFormat', 'manifestOf',
      'manifestToWrite', 'usedKits', 'decodePlan', 'encodePlan',
      'ensureManifest',
      // Task 8
      'kPlanMinScale', 'kPlanMaxScale', 'kPlanThumbnailCapacity',
      'PlanController', 'PlanChange', 'PlanObjectAdded', 'PlanObjectChanged',
      'PlanObjectRemoved', 'PlanReplaced', 'PlanSymbolsState',
      // Task 9
      'PlanStrings', 'PlanStringsEn', 'PlanStringsDe', 'PlanStringsTr',
      'PlanLocalizations', 'planSupportedLocales',
      'planLocalizationsDelegates', 'PlanTheme', 'kPlanFontFamily',
      'ensurePlanFonts', 'registerFontLicences',
      // Task 10, 11, 12
      'PlanLocked', 'KitHookFailure', 'PlanPermissions',
      // Task 13
      'PlanSymbol', 'PlanSymbolLoader', 'PlanSymbolLoad',
      'PlanSymbolGallery', 'SymbolThumbnails',
      // Task 15, 16, 17, 18
      'PlanCanvas', 'kLockHintDuration', 'PlanToolPalette', 'PlanShortcuts',
      'PlanShortcutGuard',
      'PlanPropertyPanel', 'PlanLayerPanel', 'PlanPagePanel',
      // Task 19
      'PlanExport', 'PlanExportAnswer', 'PlanExportChoice', 'PlanExportDpi',
      'PlanExportFonts', 'PlanExportRequest', 'PlanExporter', 'PlanImporter',
      'PlanPageExporter', 'PlanExportDialog', 'PagePrinter',
      'PrintingPagePrinter',
      // Task 20
      'PlanEditor', 'PlanEditorBar', 'PlanEditorAction', 'PlanFileCallback',
    });
  });

  testWidgets('ED-9b the editor\'s names, through the barrel alone',
      (tester) async {
    final c = PlanController(kits: const []);
    addTearDown(c.dispose);
    PlanExport? last;
    const PagePrinter printer = PrintingPagePrinter();
    await tester.pumpWidget(MaterialApp(
        home: Scaffold(
            body: PlanEditor(
                controller: c,
                printer: printer,
                onExport: (e) => last = e,
                bar: const PlanEditorBar(
                    actions: [PlanEditorAction.undo, PlanEditorAction.zoom]),
                theme: const PlanTheme(selectionWidth: 2)))));
    await tester.pump();
    expect(last, isNull);
    expect(c.permissions, PlanPermissions.full);
    expect(PlanExportChoice.initial.dpi, PlanExportDpi.d150);
    expect(find.byType(PlanEditor), findsOneWidget);
  });
```

```dart
// 2a spec P2 (`PlanEditor(bar:)`, today's `editorBar`): the editor's top
// bar a host may keep, reorder, cut down, extend or hide. Ported from
// jet_cad_floor_plan/lib/src/host/bars.dart (the editor half, :13-17,
// :73-159; the service bar is 2b's).
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart' show immutable, listEquals;
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart' show Widget;

/// The editor's top bar items, in today's left-to-right order: the buttons
/// Export, Print, Undo and Redo at the left; the read-outs at the right,
/// the object snap's (`snap`, which F3 toggles) and the zoom's (`zoom`).
/// The status line keeps the flexible middle.
enum PlanEditorAction { export, print, undo, redo, snap, zoom }

/// The editor's top bar.
///
/// - [visible]: false removes the bar; the canvas takes its height and the
///   tools stay in the left panel.
/// - [actions]: the items shown, in this order. The buttons lie at the
///   left, after the host's file commands, with 12 logical pixels between
///   a file button and an edit button; the read-outs lie at the right, 16
///   pixels apart. Export shows only with `PlanEditor.onExport`. An action
///   listed twice is an [ArgumentError] when the editor builds.
/// - [leading], [trailing]: the host's widgets at the bar's two ends, laid
///   out in its row at its height (each needs a bounded width). A host
///   text field there takes the focus and its keystrokes: the tool
///   letters, Undo, Redo and Escape stay in the field; the file chords and
///   F3 still act on the plan from it.
///
/// [actions] shapes the bar only: the chords and keys stay bound whatever
/// it lists.
@immutable
final class PlanEditorBar {
  const PlanEditorBar({
    this.visible = true,
    this.actions = PlanEditorAction.values,
    this.leading = const <Widget>[],
    this.trailing = const <Widget>[],
  });

  final bool visible;
  final List<PlanEditorAction> actions;
  final List<Widget> leading;
  final List<Widget> trailing;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      other is PlanEditorBar &&
      other.visible == visible &&
      listEquals(other.actions, actions) &&
      listEquals(other.leading, leading) &&
      listEquals(other.trailing, trailing);

  @override
  int get hashCode => Object.hash(visible, Object.hashAll(actions),
      Object.hashAll(leading), Object.hashAll(trailing));

  @override
  String toString() => 'PlanEditorBar(${[
        if (!visible) 'visible: false',
        if (!listEquals(actions, PlanEditorAction.values))
          'actions: [${actions.map((a) => a.name).join(', ')}]',
        if (leading.isNotEmpty)
          'leading: [${leading.map((w) => w.toStringShort()).join(', ')}]',
        if (trailing.isNotEmpty)
          'trailing: [${trailing.map((w) => w.toStringShort()).join(', ')}]',
      ].join(', ')})';
}

/// Throws an [ArgumentError] naming `actions` for a bar that lists an
/// action twice; called when the editor builds (bars.dart:146-159).
void validatePlanEditorBar(PlanEditorBar bar) {
  if (bar.actions.toSet().length != bar.actions.length) {
    throw ArgumentError.value(
        bar.actions, 'actions', 'must not list an action twice');
  }
}
```
